Berakhot 34a:6-13: Amar rav huna: taa beshalosh rishonot — chozer larosh. beemtzaiyyot — chozer leatta chonen". beacharonot — chozer laavoda".
Verav assi amar: emtzaiyyot en lahen seder.
Metiv rav sheshet: mehechan hu chozer — mittechillat habberacha shettaa ze. teyuveta derav huna.
Amar lecha rav huna: emtzaiyyot kullehu chada bircheta ninhu.

Amar rav yehuda: leolam al yishal adam tzerachav lo beshalosh rishonot, velo beshalosh acharonot, ella beemtzaiyyot. deamar rabbi chanina: rishonot — dome leeved shemmesadder shevach lifne rabbo. emtzaiyyot — dome leeved shemvakkesh peras merabbo. acharonot — dome leeved shekkibbel peras merabbo, veniftar veholech lo.

Tanu rabbanan: maase betalmid echad sheyyarad lifne hatteva bifne rabbi eliezer, vehaya maarich yoter midday. amru lo talmidav: kamma archan hu ze! amar lahem: kelum maarich yoter mimmoshe rabbenu, dichtiv beh: "et arbaim hayyom veet arbaim hallayla vegomer"?!

Shuv maase betalmid echad sheyyarad lifne hatteva bifne rabbi eliezer, vehaya mekatztzer yoter midday. amru lo talmidav: kamma katzran hu ze! amar lahem: kelum mekatztzer yoter mimmoshe rabbenu, dichtiv: "el na refa na lah".
Amar rabbi yaakov amar rav chisda: kol hamevakkesh rachamim al chavero — en tzarich lehazekir shemo, shenneemar: "el na refa na lah", vela kamadkar shema demiryam.
Chullin 105a:13-105b:10: Amar rav idi bar avin, amar rav yitzchak bar ashyayn: mayim rishonim mitzva, veacharonim chova.
Metivi: mayim rishonim veacharonim chova, emtzaiyyim reshut. mitzva legabbe reshut – chova kare la.
Gufa: mayim rishonim veacharonim – chova, emtzaiyyim – reshut. rishonim – notlin ben bichli ben al gabbe karka, acharonim – en notlin ella bichli, veamri lah: en notlin al gabbe karka.

Mayim rishonim notlin ben bechammin ben betzonen, acharonim en notlin ella betzonen, mippene shechammin mefapein et hayyadayim veen maavirin et hazzuhama. mayim rishonim notlin ben bechammin ben betzonen, amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella sheen hayyad
Soledet bahen, aval hayyad soledet bahen en notlin bahen.

Veikka dematne la assefa, acharonim en notlin ella betzonen, aval bechammin – lo. amar rav yitzchak bar yosef amar rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella shehayyad soledet bahen, aval en hayyad soledet bahen – notlin. mikkelal derishonim, af al pi shehayyad soledet bahen – muttar.
Emtzaiyyim reshut. amar rav nachman: lo shanu ella ben tavshil letavshil, aval ben tavshil ligvina – chova.

Amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi chiyyay: mippene ma amru mayim acharonim chova? shemmelach sedomit yesh, shemmesamme et haenayim. amar abbaye: umishtechach ki kureta bechora. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: kol milcha may? amar leh: la mibbaya.
Amar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay dela mashu mayya batrae al ara – mishshum zuhama. amar li mar: mishshum desharya ruach raa alayyhu.
Veamar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay dela shakel midde mippatura ki naket inish kasa lemishte, shemma yeera devar kalkala basseuda. amar li mar: mishshum dekashe leruach tzerada.

Vela amaran, ella deshakel vela mahdar, aval mishkal veahdore – let lan ba. vela amaran ella chutz learba ammot, aval toch arba ammot – let lan ba. vela amaran ella midde ditzrich lisodta, aval midde dela tzerich lisodta – let lan ba.
Mar bar rav ashe kafed afillu aasita uvuchena detavle, midde ditzrichi lisudeta.
Veamar abbaye: meresh hava amena, hay dechanshi nishvavraa – mishshum menakkeruta. amar li mar: mishshum dekashe leanyuta.

Hahu gavra dahava mehaddar aleh sara deanyuta, vela hava yachel leh, deka zehir annishvavra tuva. yoma chad kerach lifta ayyavle, amar: hasheta vadday nafel biday. batar deachel, ayyti mara akrinhu leyavle, shedinhu lenahara. shameh dekaamar: vavy deappekeh hahu gavra mibbeteh.
Gittin 31b:6-32a:1: Rabbi yehuda omer, bishlosha perakim kulei: tana: bekiddum shel motzae hachag shel tekufa.

Tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: bishlosha perakim mochrin et hattevua – lifne hazzera, uvishat hazzera, uvifros happesach. uvishlosha perakim mochrin et hayyayin – bifros happesach, uvifros atzeret, uvifros hachag. veshemen – meatzeret veelach. lemay hilcheta? amar rava, veittema rav pappa: leshuttafin. mikkan veelach, may? amar rava: kol yoma pirkeh hu.
"Vayhi kizroach hashshemesh vayman elohim ruach kadim charishit" – may "charishit"? amar rav yehuda: beshaa shemmenashshevet, ose telamim telamim bayyam.

Amar leh rabba: i hachi, hayeynu dichtiv: "vattach hashshemesh al rosh yona vayyitallaf"?! ella amar rabba: beshaa shemmenashshevet, meshatteket kol haruchot mippaneha. vehayeynu dichtiv: "asher begadecha chammim behashekit eretz middarom". amar rabbi tachlifa bar rav chisda, amar rav chisda: ematay begadecha chammim? beshaa shehishkit eretz middarom. shebbeshaa shemmenashshevet meshatteket kol haruchot mippaneha.

Rav huna verav chisda havo yatvi. chalef veazel geniva alayyhu, amar chad lechavreh: nekum mikkammeh, devar oryayn hu. amar leh iddach: mikkamme palgaa nekum?! addehachi ata ihu legabbayyhu, amar lehu: bemay askitu? amaru leh: beruchot.

Amar lehu: hachi amar rav chanan bar rava, amar rav: arba ruchot menashshevot bechol yom, veruach tzefonit menashshevet im kullan; sheilmale ken, en haolam mitkayyem afillu shaa achat. veruach deromit kasha mikkullan, veilmale ben netz maamidah, machrevet kol haolam kullo mippaneha, shenneemar: "hamibbinatcha yaaver netz yifros kenafav leteman".

Rava verav nachman bar yitzchak havo yatvi; hava chalef veazel rav nachman bar yaakov, deyatev beguharka dedahava uferis aleh sarbala decharate. rava azal legabbeh, rav nachman bar yitzchak la azal legabbeh. amar: dilma meinashe deve resh galuta ninhu; rava tzarich lehu, ana la tzerichna lehu.

Kedachaza derav nachman bar yaakov hava, azel legabbeh. galli lidraeh, amar: shadya nashev! amar rava, hachi amar rav: ishsha mappelet bo; ushemuel amar: afillu margalit shebbayyam markevet bo; rabbi yochanan amar: afillu shichvat zera shebbime ishsha masrachat bo.

Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, usheloshtan mikra echad darshu: "ki hu ben achim yafri yavo kadim ruach Adonai mimmidbar ole veyevosh mekoro vegomer". "yevosh mekoro" – zo mekorah shel ishsha. "veyecherav mayayno" – ze shichvat zera shebbime ishsha. "hu yishse otzar kol keli chemda" – zo margalit shebbayyam.
Amar rava: ade suraa hu, dedayyki kerae! may "ki hu ben achim yafri"? amar rava: afillu
Shufeta bekofina demara – rafya. rav yosef amar: afillu sikketa bedafna – rafya. rav acha bar yaakov amar: afillu kanya bechufeta – rafya.
Mishnah Parah 2:5-3:3:
Hayu vah shete searot shechorot o levanot betoch gumma achat, pesula. rabbi yehuda omer, afillu vetoch kos echad. hayu vetoch shene chosot vehen mochichot zo et zo, pesula. rabbi akiva omer, afillu arba, afillu chamesh, vehen mefuzzarot, yitlosh. rabbi eliezer omer, afillu chamishshim. rabbi yehoshua ben betera omer, afillu achat beroshah veachat biznavah, pesula. hayu vah shete searot, ikkaran mashchir veroshan madim, ikkaran madim veroshan mashchir, hakkol holech achar hannire, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, achar haikkar: 
Shivat yamim kodem lisrefat happara mafrishin kohen hassoref et happara mibbeto lallishka sheal pene habbira, tzafona mizracha, uvet even hayta nikret, umazzin alav kol shivat hayyamim mikkol chattaot shehayu sham. rabbi yose omer, lo hayu mazzin alav ella vashshelishi uvashshevii bilvad. rabbi chanina segan hakkohanim omer, al hakkohen hassoref et happara, mazzin kol shivat hayyamim. veal shel yom hakkippurim, lo hayu mazzin alav ella vashshelishi uvashshevii bilvad: 
Chatzerot hayu virushalayim benuyot al gabbe sela vetachtehem chalul, mippene kever hattehom. umeviim nashim ubbarot veyoldot sham umegaddelot sham et benehen. umeviim shevarim veal gabbehen delatot, vetinokot yoshvin al gabbehen vechosot shel even beyadam. higgiu lashshilloach, yardu umilum, vealu veyashvu al gabbehen. rabbi yose omer, mimmekomo haya meshalshel umemalle: 
Bau lehar habbayit veyardu. har habbayit vehaazarot, tachtehem chalul, mippene kever hattehom. uvefetach haazara haya metukkan kalal shel chattat, umeviin zachar shel rechelim vekoshrim chevel ben karnav, vekoshrim makkel umesabbech berosho shel chevel, vezorko letoch hakkalal, umakke et hazzachar venirta laachorav, venotel umekaddesh, kede sheyyerae al pene hammayim. rabbi yose omer, al tittenu makom latztzedokim lirdot, ella hu notel umekaddesh:
Mishnah Parah 3:4-7:
Lo hayu osin, lo chattat al gabbe chattat, velo tinok al gabbe chavero. utzerichin hayu hattinokot lehazzot, divre rabbi yose haggelili. rabbi akiva omer, lo hayu tzerichin lehazzot: 
Lo matzu mishsheva, osin mishshesh, mechamesh, mearba, mishshalosh, mishshetayim umeechat. umi asaam. harishona asa moshe, vehashsheniyya asa ezra, vechamesh, meezra vaelach, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, sheva meezra vaelach. umi asaan. shimon hatztzaddik veyochanan kohen gadol asu shetayim shetayim, elyehoenay ben hakkof vachanamel hammitzri veyishmael ben piavi asu achat echat: 
Vechevesh hayu osim mehar habbayit lehar hammishcha, kippin al gabbe chippin, vechippa cheneged haotem, mippene kever hattehom, shebbo chohen hassoref et happara, ufara vechol mesaadeha, yotzin lehar hammishcha: 
Lo hayta fara rotza latzet, en motziin immah shechora, shello yomru, shechora shachatu. velo adumma, shello yomru, shetayim shachatu. rabbi yose omer, lo mishshum ze, ella mishshum shenneemar (Bamidbar 19), vehotzi otah, levaddah. vezikne yisrael hayu makdimim beraglehem lehar hammishcha, uvet tevila haya sham. umetammeim hayu et hakkohen hassoref et happara, mippene hatztzedokim, shello yihyu omrim, bimorve shemesh hayta naaset:
Mishnah Parah 3:8-4:1:
Samchu yedehem alav veamru lo, ishi kohen gadol, tevol echat. yarad vetaval veala venistappeg. veetzim hayu mesuddarim sham, atze arazim vooranim uveroshim vaatze teena chalaka. veosin otah kemin migdal, umefattechin bah challonot, vachazitah maarava: 
Kefatuha vechevel shel megeg unetanuha al gav hammaaracha, roshah baddarom ufaneha lammaarav. hakkohen omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav. shachat bimino vekibbel bismolo. rabbi yehuda omer, bimino haya mekabbel venoten lismolo, umazze vimino. taval vehizza sheva peamim keneged bet kodesh hakkodashim. al kol hazzaya, tevila. gamar millehazzot, kinnach et yado begufah shel para. yarad vehitztzit et haesh baalitot. rabbi akiva omer, bachariyyot: 
Nivkea, veamad chutz miggittah. natal etz erez veezov usheni tolaat. amar lahen, etz erez ze, etz erez ze. ezov ze, ezov ze. sheni tolaat ze, sheni tolaat ze. shalosh peamim al kol davar vedavar. vehem omrim lo, hen vehen, shalosh peamim al kol davar vedavar: 
Kerachan bishyare hallashon vehishlich letoch serefatah. nisrefa, chovtin otah bemaklot, vechovrin otah bichvarot. rabbi yishmael omer, bemakkavot shel even uvichvarot shel even hayta naaset. shachor sheyyesh bo efer, kotshin oto. vesheen bo, mannichin oto. haetzem, ben kach uven kach haya nichtash. vecholkim oto lishlosha chalakim, echad nittan bachel, veechad nittan behar hammishcha, veechad haya mitchallek lechol hammishmarot: 
Parat chattat sheshshechatah shello lishmah, kibbel vehizza shello lishmah, o lishmah veshello lishmah, o shello lishmah velishmah, pesula. rabbi eliezer machshir. veshello rechutz yadayim veraglayim, pesula. rabbi eliezer machshir. veshello vechohen gadol, pesula. rabbi yehuda machshir. umechussar begadim, pesula. uvichle lavan hayta naaset:
Mishnah Parah 4:2-5:1:
Serafah chutz miggittah, o vishte gittot, o shessaraf shetayim begat achat, pesula. hizza velo chivven keneged happetach, pesula. hizza mishshishshit sheviit, chazar vehizza sheviit, pesula. mishsheviit sheminit vechazar vehizza sheminit, keshera: 
Serafah shello veetzim, o vechol etzim, afillu vekash o vigvava, keshera. hifshitah venittechah, keshera. shechatah al menat leechol mibbesarah velishtot middamah, keshera. rabbi eliezer omer, en machashava foselet bappara: 
Kol haasukin bappara mittechilla vead sof, metammein begadim, ufoslim otah bimlacha. era bah pesul bishchitatah, enah metammea vegadim. era bah behazzayatah, kol haosek bah lifne fesulah, metammea vegadim. leachar pesulah, enah metammea vegadim. nimtzea chumrah, kullah. leolam moalim bah, umarbin lah etzim, umaaseha vayyom, uvechohen, hammelacha foselet bah, ad shettease efer, vehammelacha foselet bammayim, ad sheyyattilu et haefer: 
Hammevi keli cheres lechattat, tovel velan al hakkivshan. rabbi yehuda omer, af min habbayit hu mevi vechasher, shehakkol neemanim al hachattat. uvatteruma, poteach et hakkivshan venotel. rabbi shimon omer, min hasseder hashsheni. rabbi yose omer, min hasseder hashshelishi:
Mishnah Parah 5:2-5:
Hammatbil keli lechattat bemayim sheenam reuyim lekaddesh, tzarich lenaggev. bemayim shehem reuyim lekaddesh, eno tzarich lenaggev. im lehosif letocho mayim mekuddashin, ben kach uven kach tzarich lenaggev: 
Keruya shehitbiluha vemayim sheen reuyin lekaddesh, mekaddeshin bah ad shettitma. nitmea, en mekaddeshin bah. rabbi yehoshua omer, im mekaddesh hu vah battechilla, af bassof yekaddesh bah. im eno mekaddesh bah bassof, af lo vattechilla. ben kach uven kach, lo yosif letochah mayim mekuddashim: 
Shefoferet shechatachah lechattat, rabbi eliezer omer, yatbil miyyad. rabbi yehoshua omer, yetamme veyatbil. hakkol kesherim lekaddesh, chutz mecheresh shote vekatan. rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan, ufosel beishsha uveanderoginos: 
Bechol hakkelim mekaddeshim, afillu vichle gelalim, bichle avanim, uvichle adama. uvisfina, mekaddeshin bah. en mekaddeshin lo vedafnot hakkelim, velo veshule hammachatz, velo vimgufat hechavit, velo vechafnav, mippene sheen memallein veen mekaddeshin veen mazzin me chattat ella vecheli. en matztzilin betzamid patil ella chelim, sheen matztzilim miyyad kele cheres ella chelim:
Mishnah Parah 5:6-6:1:
Betzat hayyotzrim, keshera. rabbi yose fosel. betzat hattarnegolet, rabbi meir verabbi yehuda machshirin, vachachamim poslin: 
Hashshoket shebbassela, en memallein bah veen mekaddeshin bah veen mazzin mimmenna, veenah tzericha tzamid patil, veenah poselet et hammikve. hayta cheli vechibberah besid, memallein bah umekaddeshin bah umazzin mimmenna, utzericha tzamid patil, ufoselet et hammikve. nikkeva millemattan, ufekakah bismartut, hammayim shebbetochah pesulin, mippene sheenan agullim keli. min hatztzad ufekakah bismartut, hammayim shebbetochah kesherim, mippene shehem agullim keli. asu lah atara shel tit, vehalchu hammayim lesham, pesulin. im haya vari kede sheyyinnatel immah, kesherim: 
Shete shekatot shebbeeven achat, kiddesh achat mehem, hammayim shebbashsheniyya enan mekuddashin. hayu nekuvot zo lazo kishfoferet hannod, o shehayu hammayim tzafin al gabbehen afillu chiklippat hashshum, vekiddesh et achat mehen, hammayim shebbashsheniyya mekuddashin: 
Shete avanim shehikkifan zo lazo vaasaan shoket, vechen shete arevot, vechen hashshoket shennechleka, hammayim shebbenehem enan mekuddashin. asaan besid o vegifsim vehen yecholot lehinnatel keachat, hammayim shebbenehem mekuddashin: 
Hamekaddesh venafal hakkiddush al yado o al hatztzad veachar kach nafal al hashshoket, pasul. nafal min hashshefoferet lashshoket, pasul. natal mishshefoferet vechissa, o shehegif et haddelet, hakkiddush kasher, vehammayim pesulim. zekafah baaretz, pasul. letoch yado, kasher, mippene sheefshar:
Mishnah Pesachim 3:1-4: Ellu ovrin befesach, kuttach habbavli, veshechar hammadi, vechometz haadomi, vezetom hammitzri, vezoman shel tzabbaim, vaamilan shel tabbachim, vekolan shel sofrim. rabbi eliezer omer, af tachshite nashim. ze hakkelal, kol shehu mimmin dagan, hare ze over befesach. hare ellu veazhara, veen bahen mishshum karet:

Batzek shebbesidke areva, im yesh kazzayit bemakom echad, chayyav levaer. veim lo, batel bemiuto. vechen leinyan hattuma, im makpid alav, chotzetz. veim rotze vekiyyumo, hare hu chaareva. batzek hacheresh, im yesh kayyotze vo shehechemitz, hare ze asur:

Ketzad mafrishin challa vetuma veyom tov, rabbi eliezer omer, lo tikra lah shem ad shetteafe. rabbi yehuda ben betera omer, tattil betzonen. amar rabbi yehoshua, lo ze hu chametz shemmuzharim alav beval yerae uveval yimmatze, ella mafrashtah umannachta ad haerev, veim hechemitza, hechemitza:

Rabban gamliel omer, shalosh nashim lashot keachat veofot betannur echad, zo achar zo. vachachamim omrim, shalosh nashim oskot babbatzek, achat lasha veachat orechet veachat ofa. rabbi akiva omer, lo chol hannashim velo chol haetzim velo chol hattannurim shavin. ze hakkelal, tafach, tiltosh betzonen:
Mishnah Pesachim 3:5-4:1: Siur, yissaref, vehaochlo fatur. saduk, yissaref, vehaochlo chayyav karet. ezehu siur, kekarne chagavim. saduk, shennitarvu sedakav ze vaze, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, ze vaze, haochlo chayyav karet. veezehu siur, kol shehichsifu fanav keadam sheamdu saarotav:

Arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat, mevaarim et hakkol millifne hashshabbat, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, bizmannan. rabbi elazar bar tzadok omer, teruma millifne hashshabbat, vechullin bizmannan:

Haholech lishchot et pischo, velamul et beno, veleechol seuddat erusin bevet chamiv, venizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betoch beto, im yachol lachazor ulevaer velachazor lemitzvato, yachazor vivaer. veim lav, mevattelo velibbo. lehatztzil min hannachrim, umin hannahar, umin hallistim, umin haddeleka, umin hammappolet, yevattel belibbo. velishbot shevitat harshut, yachazor miyyad:

Vechen mi sheyyatza mirushalayim venizkar sheyyesh beyado besar kodesh, im avar tzofim, sorfo vimkomo. veim lav, chozer vesorfo lifne habbira meatze hammaaracha. vead kamma hen chozrin, rabbi meir omer, ze vaze vechabbetza. rabbi yehuda omer, ze vaze vechazzayit. vachachamim omrim, besar kodesh bechazzayit, vechametz bechabbetza:

Makom shennahagu laasot melacha bearve fesachim ad chatzot, osin. makom shennahagu shello laasot, en osin. haholech mimmakom sheosin lemakom sheen osin, o mimmakom sheen osin lemakom sheosin, notnin alav chumre makom sheyyatza mishsham vechumre makom shehalach lesham. veal yeshanne adam, mippene hammachaloket:
Mishnah Pesachim 4:2-5: Kayyotze vo, hammolich perot sheviit mimmakom shekkalu lemakom shello chalu, o mimmakom shello chalu lemakom shekkalu, chayyav levaer. rabbi yehuda omer, omrim lo, tze vehave lecha af atta:

Makom shennahagu limkor behema dakka laggoyim, mochrin. makom shennahagu shello limkor, en mochrin. uvechol makom en mochrin lahem behema gassa, agalim useyachim shelemin ushevurin. rabbi yehuda mattir bishvura. ben betera mattir besus:

Makom shennahagu leechol tzali velele fesachim, ochlin. makom shennahagu shello leechol, en ochlin. makom shennahagu lehadelik et hanner belele yom hakkippurim, madlikin. makom shennahagu shello lehadelik, en madlikin. umadlikin bevatte chenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot, uvammevoot haafelim, veal gabbe hacholim:

Makom shennahagu laasot melacha vetisha veav, osin. makom shennahagu shello laasot melacha, en osin. uvechol makom talmide chachamim betelim. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, leolam yaase adam atzmo talmid chacham. vachachamim omrim, bihuda hayu osin melacha vearve fesachim ad chatzot, uvaggalil lo hayu osin kol ikkar. vehallayla, bet shammay osrin, uvet hillel mattirin ad hanetz hachamma:
Mishnah Pesachim 4:6-9: Rabbi meir omer, kol melacha shehitchil bah kodem learbaa asar, gomrah bearbaa asar. aval lo yatchil bah battechilla vearbaa asar, af al pi sheyyachol legamrah. vachachamim omrim, shalosh ummanuyyot osin melacha vearve fesachim ad chatzot, veellu hen, hachayyatim, hassapparim vehakkovsin. rabbi yose bar yehuda omer, af haratzanim:

Moshivin shovachin lattarnegolim bearbaa asar. vetarnegolet shebbarcha, machazirin otah limkomah. veim meta, moshivin acheret tachteha. gorfin mittachat ragle vehema vearbaa asar, uvammoed mesallekin latztzedadin. molichin umeviin kelim mibbet haumman, af al pi sheenam letzorech hammoed:

Shishsha devarim asu anshe yericho, al shelosha michu veyadam, veal shelosha lo michu veyadam. veellu hen shello michu veyadam, markivin dekalim kol hayyom, vechorchin et shema, vekotzrin vegodshin lifne haomer, velo michu veyadam. veellu shemmichu veyadam, mattirin gimziyyot shel hekdesh, veochlin mittachat hannesharim beshabbat, venotnim pea layyarak, umichu veyadam chachamim:

Shishsha devarim asa chizkiyya hammelech, al shelosha hodu lo, veal shelosha lo hodu lo. gerar atzmot aviv al mitta shel chavalim, vehodu lo. kittet nechash hannechoshet, vehodu lo. ganaz sefer refuot, vehodu lo. al shelosha lo hodu lo, kitztzetz delatot shel hechol veshiggeran lemelech ashshur, velo hodu lo. satam me gichon haelyon, velo hodu lo. ibber nisan benisan, velo hodu lo:
Mishnah Pesachim 5:1-5:
Tamid nishchat bishmone umechetza vekarev betesha umechetza. bearve fesachim nishchat besheva umechetza vekarev bishmone umechetza, ben bechol ben beshabbat. chal erev pesach lihyot beerev shabbat, nishchat beshesh umechetza vekarev besheva umechetza, vehappesach acharav: 
Happesach sheshshechato shello lishmo, vekibbel vehillech vezarak shello lishmo, o lishmo veshello lishmo, o shello lishmo velishmo, pasul. ketzad lishmo veshello lishmo, leshem pesach uleshem shelamim. shello lishmo velishmo, leshem shelamim uleshem pasach: 
Shechato shello leochlav veshello limnuyav, laarelim velitmeim, pasul. leochlav veshello leochlav, limnuyav veshello limnuyav, lemulim velaarelim, litmeim velithorim, kasher. shechato kodem chatzot, pasul, mishshum shenneemar (Shemot 12) ben haarbayim. shechato kodem lattamid, kasher, uvilvad sheyyehe echad memares bedamo ad sheyyizzarek dam hattamid. veim nizrak, kasher: 
Hashshochet et happesach al hechametz, over belo taase. rabbi yehuda omer, af hattamid. rabbi shimon omer, happesach bearbaa asar, lishmo chayyav, veshello lishmo patur. ushear kol hazzevachim, ben lishman uven shello lishman, patur. uvammoed, lishmo patur, veshello lishmo chayyav, ushear kol hazzevachim, ben lishman uven shello lishman, chayyav, chutz min hachattat sheshshechatah shello lishmah: 
Happesach nishchat beshalosh kittot, shenneemar veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael, (Shemot 12) kahal veeda veyisrael. nichnesa chat harishona, nitmallet haazara, naalu daltot haazara. taku, heriu vetakau. hakkohanim omdim shurot shurot, uvidehem baziche chesef uvaziche zahav. shura shekkullah kesef kesef, veshura shekkullah zahav zahav. lo hayu meoravin. velo hayu labbazichin shulayim, shemma yannichum veyikrash haddam:
Mishnah Pesachim 5:6-9:
Shachat yisrael vekibbel hakkohen, notno lachavero vachavero lachavero, umekabbel et hammale umachazir et harekan. kohen hakkarov etzel hammizbeach zorko zerika achat keneged hayesod: 
Yatzta chat rishona venichnesa chat sheniyya. yatzta sheniyya, nichnesa shelishit. kemaase harishona kach maase hashsheniyya vehashshelishit. karu et hahallel. im gamru shanu, veim shanu shilleshu, af al pi shello shilleshu mimehem. rabbi yehuda omer, mimehem shel kat shelishit lo higgia leahavti ki yishma Adonai, mippene sheammah muatin: 
Kemaasehu vechol kach maasehu veshabbat, ella shehakkohanim medichim et haazara shello virtzon chachamim. rabbi yehuda omer, kos haya memalle middam hattaarovot, zerako zerika achat al gabbe hammizbeach, velo hodu lo chachamim: 
Ketzad tolin umafshitin, unkelayot shel barzel hayu kevuim bakketalim uvaammudim, shebbahen tolin umafshitin. vechol mi sheen lo makom litlot ulehafshit, maklot dakkim chalakim hayu sham, umeniach al ketefo veal ketef chavero, vetole umafshit. rabbi eliezer omer, arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat, meniach yado al ketef chavero, veyad chavero al ketefo, vetole umafshit:
Mishnah Shevuot 3:11-4:3: Shevuat shav noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokim uvikrovim, bichsherim uvifsulim, bifne vet din veshello bifne vet din, umippi atzmo. vechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah patur. achat zo, veachat zo, hammushba mippi acherim, chayyav. ketzad. amar, lo achalti hayyom velo henachti tefillin hayyom, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav:

Shevuat haedut noheget baanashim velo venashim, birchokin velo vikrovin, bichsherim velo vifsulin. veenah noheget ella varuyin lehaid, bifne vet din veshello bifne vet din, mippi atzmo, umippi acherim, en chayyavin ad sheyyichperu vahen bevet din, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ben mippi atzmo uven mippi acherim, enan chayyavin ad sheyyichperu vahen bevet din:
Vechayyavin al zedon hashshevua, veal shiggatah im zedon haedut, veenan chayyavin al shiggatah. uma hen chayyavin al zedon hashshevua, karban ole veyored:

Shevuat haedut ketzad. amar lishnayim bou vahaiduni. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut, o sheamru lo en anu yodin lecha edut, mashbia ani alechem veamru amen, hare ellu chayyavin. hishbia alehen chamishsha feamim chutz levet din uvau levet din vehodu, peturim. kafru, chayyavim al kol achat veechat. hishbia alehen chamishsha feamim bifne vet din vechafru, enan chayyavin ella achat. amar rabbi shimon, ma taam, hoil veenam yecholin lachazor ulehodot:
Mishnah Shevuot 3:7-10:
Shevua shello ochal kikkar zo, shevua shello ochalenna, shevua shello ochalenna, vaachalah, eno chayyav ella achat. zo hi shevuat bittuy, shechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah karban ole veyored. shevuat shav, chayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah patur: 
Ezo hi shevuat shav, nishba leshannot et hayyadua laadam, amar al haammud shel even shehu shel zahav, veal haish shehu ishsha, veal haishsha shehi ish. nishba al davar shei efshar, im lo raiti gamal shepporeach baavir, veim lo raiti nachash kekorat bet habbad. amar leedim bou vahaiduni, shevua shello neidecha. nishba levattel et hammitzva, shello laasot sukka, veshello littol lulav, veshello lehaniach tefillin, zo hi shevuat shav, shechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah patur: 
Shevua sheochal kikkar zo, shevua shello ochalenna, harishona shevuat bittuy vehashsheniyya shevuat shav. achalah, avar al shevuat shav. lo achalah, avar al shevuat bittuy: 
Shevuat bittuy noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokim uvikrovim, bichsherim uvifsulin, bifne vet din veshello bifne vet din, mippi atzmo. vechayyavin al zedonah makkot veal shiggatah karban ole veyored:
Mishnah Shevuot 4:13-5:3:
Mashbia ani alechem, metzavve ani alechem, oserchem ani, hare ellu chayyavin. bashshamayim uvaaretz, hare ellu feturin. beAlef dalet, beYod hei, beshadday, bitzvaot, bechannun verachum, beerech appayim verav chesed, uvechol hakkinnuyin, hare ellu chayyavin. hamekallel bechullan, chayyav, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim potrin. hamekallel aviv veimmo bechullan, chayyav, divre rabbi meir, vachachamim potrin. hamekallel atzmo vachavero bechullan, over belo taase. yakkecha elohim, vechen yakkecha elohim, zo hi ala hakketuva vattora. al yakkecha, vivarechcha, veyetiv lecha, rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin:  
Shevuat happikkadon noheget baanashim uvenashim, birchokim uvikrovim, bichsherim uvifsulim, bifne vet din veshello bifne vet din, mippi atzmo. umippi acherim, eno chayyav ad sheyyichpor bo bevet din, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, ben mippi atzmo ben mippi acherim, kevan shekkafar bo, chayyav. vechayyav al zedon hashshevua veal shiggatah im zedon happikkadon, veeno chayyav al shiggatah. uma chayyav al zedonah, asham bechesef shekalim: 
Shevuat happikkadon ketzad. amar lo, ten li fikdoni sheyyesh li veyadecha, shevua sheen lecha veyadi, o sheamar lo en lecha veyadi, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, hare ze chayyav. hishbia alav chamishsha feamim, ben bifne vet din uven shello bifne vet din, vechafar, chayyav al kol achat veechat. amar rabbi shimon, ma taam, mippene sheyyachol lachazor ulehodot: 
Hayu chamishsha tovin oto, amru lo ten lanu fikkadon sheyyesh lanu veyadecha, shevua sheen lachem beyadi, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua sheen lecha veyadi velo lecha velo lecha, chayyav al kol achat veechat. rabbi eliezer omer, ad sheyyomar shevua vaacharona. rabbi shimon omer, ad sheyyomar shevua lechol echad veechad. ten li fikkadon utesumet yad gazel vaaveda sheyyesh li veyadecha, shevua sheen lecha veyadi, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua sheen lecha veyadi fikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda, chayyav al kol achat veechat. ten li chittin useorin vechussemin sheyyesh li veyadecha, shevua sheen lecha veyadi, eno chayyav ella achat. shevua sheen lecha veyadi chittin useorin vechussemim, chayyav al kol achat veechat. rabbi meir omer, afillu amar chitta useora vechussemet, chayyav al kol achat veechat:
Mishnah Shevuot 4:4-7: Kafru shenehen keachat, shenehen chayyavin. baze achar ze, harishon chayyav vehashsheni fatur. kafar echad vehoda echad, hakkofer chayyav. hayu shete chitte edim, kafra harishona veachar kach kafra hashsheniyya, shetehem chayyavot, mippene shehaedut yechola lehitkayyem bishtehen:

Mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou uteiduni sheyyesh li veyad peloni pikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut, en chayyavin ella achat. shevua sheen anu yodin sheyyesh lecha veyad peloni pikkadon utesumet yad vegazel vaaveda, chayyavin al kol achat veechat. mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou uteiduni sheyyesh li veyad peloni pikdon chittin useorin vechussemin. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut, en chayyavin ella achat. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut sheyyesh lecha veyad peloni chittin useorin vechussemin, chayyavin al kol achat veechat:

Mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou uteiduni sheyyesh li veyad peloni nezek vachatzi nezek, tashlume chefel, tashlume arbaa vachamishsha, vesheanas ish peloni et bitti, ufitta et bitti, veshehikkani veni, veshechaval bi chaveri, veshehidlik et gedishi veyom hakkippurim, hare ellu chayyavin:

Mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou uteiduni sheani chohen, sheani levi, sheeni ven gerusha, sheeni ven chalutza, sheish peloni chohen, sheish peloni levi, sheeno ven gerusha, sheeno ven chalutza, sheanas ish peloni et bitto, ufitta et bitto, veshechaval bi veni, veshechaval bi chaveri, veshehidlik gedishi veshabbat, hare ellu feturin:
Mishnah Shevuot 4:8-12: Mashbia ani alechem, im lo tavou uteiduni sheamar ish peloni litten li matayim zuz velo natan li, hare ellu feturim, sheen chayyavin ella al teviat mamon kefikkadon:
Mashbia ani alechem, keshettedun li edut shettavou uteiduni, hare ellu feturim, mippene shekkadma shevua laedut:
Amad bevet hakkeneset veamar, mashbia ani alechem sheim attem yodim li edut shettavou uteiduni, hare ellu feturin, ad sheyyihye mitkavven lahem:

Amar lishnayim, mashbia ani alechem ish peloni ufeloni, sheim attem yodin li edut shettavou uteiduni, shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut, vehem yodin lo edut ed mippi ed o shehaya echad mehen karov o fasul, hare ellu feturin:
Shillach beyad avdo, o sheamar lahen hannitba mashbia ani alechem sheim attem yodin lo edut shettavou uteiduhu, hare ellu feturin ad sheyyishmeu mippi hattovea:
Mishnah Shevuot 5:4-6:2:
Anasta ufittita et bitti, vehu omer lo anasti velo fittiti. mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. rabbi shimon poter, sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo. amru lo, af al pi sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo, meshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo: 
Ganavta et shori, vehu omer lo ganavti, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. hemit shorcha et shori, vehu omer lo hemit, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. hemit shorcha et avdi, vehu omer lo hemit, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. amar lo, chavalta vi veasita bi chabbura, vehu omer lo chavalti velo asiti vecha chabbura, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, chayyav. amar lo avdo, hippalta et shinni vesimmita et eni, vehu omer lo hippalti velo simmiti, mashbiacha ani, veamar amen, patur. ze hakkelal, kol hameshallem al pi atzmo, chayyav. vesheeno meshallem al pi atzmo, patur: 
Shevuat haddayyanin, hattaana shete chesef, vehahodaa beshave feruta. veim en hahodaa mimmin hattaana, patur. ketzad, shete chesef li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella feruta, patur. shete chesef uferuta li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella feruta, chayyav. mane li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi, patur. mane li veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella chamishshim dinar, chayyav. mane leabba veyadecha, en lecha veyadi ella chamishshim dinar, patur, mippene shehu chemeshiv aveda: 
Mane li veyadecha, amar lo bifne edim hen. lemachar amar lo tenehu li. netattiv lach, patur. en lecha veyadi, chayyav. mane li veyadecha, amar lo hen, al tittenehu li ella veedim. lemachar amar lo tenehu li, netattiv lach, chayyav, mippene shetztzarich litteno lo veedim:
Mishneh Torah, Prayer and the Priestly B: Seder tefillot kach hu. bashshachar mashkim adam umevarech berachot ellu. vekore hazzemirot umevarech lifnehem uleacharehem. vekore achar kach shema umevarech lefaneha uleachareha. umedalleg kedushsha min habberacha rishona shellefaneha sheen hayyachid omer kedushsha. ucheshehu chotem gaal yisrael miyyad yaamod kede sheyyismoch geulla litfilla umitpallel meummad kemo sheamarnu. uchesheyyashlim yeshev veyippol al panav umitchannen umagbiah rosho umitchannen meat vehu yoshev bedivre tachanunim. veachar kach yikra <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" (meyushshav) veyitchannen kefi kocho veyippater lemaasav:

Uvitfillat hammincha matchil likro <small>(Tehillim 145 1)</small> "tehilla ledavid" meyushshav veachar kach omed umitpallel tefillat hammincha ucheshemmashlim nofel al panav umitchannen umagbiah rosho veyitchannen kefi kocho veyippater lemaasav. uvitfillat haerev kore keriat shema umevarech lefaneha uleachareha vesomech geulla litfilla umitpallel meummad uchesheyyashlim yeshev meat veyippater. vehammitchannen achar tefillat arvit hare ze meshubbach. veaf al pi shemmevarech hashekivenu achar gaal yisrael enah hefsek ben geulla litfilla vahare shetehen kivracha achat arukka:

Tefillat hatztzibbur nishmaat tamid vaafillu hayu bahen chotim en hakkadosh baruch hu moes bitfillatan shel rabbim. lefichach tzarich adam leshattef atzmo im hatztzibbur. velo yitpallel beyachid kol zeman sheyyachol lehitpallel im hatztzibbur. uleolam yashkim adam veyaariv levet hakkeneset sheen tefillato nishmaat bechol et ella bevet hakkeneset. vechol mi sheyyesh lo bet hakkeneset beiro veeno mitpallel bo im hatztzibbur nikra shachen ra:

Umitzva larutz levet hakkeneset shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 6 3)</small> "veneda nirdefa ladaat et Adonai". uchesheyyetze mibbet hakkeneset al yafsia pesia gassa ella yelech meat meat. uchesheyyikkanes bevet hakkeneset yikkanes shiur shene petachim veachar kach yitpallel lekayyem ma shenneemar <small>(Mishlei 8 led)</small> "lishmor mezuzot petachay":

Bet hammidrash gadol mibbet hakkeneset. vachachamim gedolim af al pi shehayu lahem beiram batte kenesiyyot harebe lo hayu mitpallelin ella bemakom shehayu oskin sham battora vehu sheyyitpallel sham tefillat hatztzibbur:

Vechetzad hi tefillat hatztzibbur. yihye echad mitpallel bekol ram vehakkol shomim. veen osin ken befachot measara gedolim uvene chorin. usheliach tzibbur echad mehem. vaafillu hayu miktzatan shekkevar hitpallelu veyatzu yede chovatan mashlimin lahem laasara. vehu sheyyihyu rov haasara shello hitpallelu. vechen en omrim kedushsha velo korin battora umevarchin lefaneha uleachareha velo maftirin banneviim ella baasara:

Vechen lo yihye echad mevarech birkat shema vehakkol shomim veonin acharav amen ella baasara. veze hu hannikra pores al shema. veen omrim kaddish ella baasara. veen hakkohanim nosim yedehem ella baasara vehakkohanim min hamminyan. shekkol asara miyyisrael hem hannikraim eda shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 14 27)</small> "ad matay laeda haraa hazzot" vegomer vehayu asara shehare yatzu yehoshua vechalev:

Vechol devar kedushsha lo yehe ella betoch haeda miyyisrael shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 22 32)</small> "venikdashti betoch bene yisrael". vechol ellu haddevarim im hitchilu bahem baasara vehalchu miktzatam af al pi sheen rashshain yigmeru hashshear:

Vetzarich lihyot kullam bemakom echad usheliach tzibbur immahem bemakom echad. chatzer ketanna shennifretza bimloah lechatzer gedola vehayu tisha baggedola veyachid bakketanna mitztarfin. tisha bakketanna veyachid baggedola en mitztarfin. tzibbur baggedola usheliach tzibbur bakketanna yotzin yede chovatan. tzibbur bakketanna usheliach tzibbur baggedola en yotzin yede chovatan shehare hu muflag mehem veeno immahem bemakom echad mippene sheyyesh baggedola passin mikkan umikkan hare hi kemo mufleget min hakketanna veen hakketanna mufleget min haggedola ella hare hi kekeren zavit shellah:

Vechen im hayta tzoa baggedola asur lehitpallel velikrot keriat shema bakketanna. hayta tzoa bakketanna muttar lehitpallel velikrot keriat shema baggedola im lo haya sham reach ra mippene shehi mufleget mimmenna:

Sheliach tzibbur motzi et harabbim yede chovatan. ketzad. beshaa shehu mitpallel vehem shomin veonin amen achar kol beracha uveracha hare hen kemitpallelin. bamme devarim amurim kesheeno yodea lehitpallel aval hayyodea eno yotze yede chovato ella bitfillat atzmo:

Bamme devarim amurim bishar yemot hashshana chutz merosh hashshana veyom hakkippurim shel shenat hayyovel. aval bishne yamim ellu sheliach tzibbur motzi et hayyodea keshem shemmotzi mi sheeno yodea mippene shehem berachot arukkot veen rov hayyodim otan yecholin lechavven datan kishliach tzibbur. lefichach im ratza hayyodea lismoch bishne yamim ellu al tefillat shatz lehotzio yede chovato harshut beyado:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9:4-5:
Echad natan et haur veechad natan et haetzim veechad natan et hakkedera veechad natan et hammayim veechad natan et habbasar veechad natan et hattavlin uva acher vehegis kullam chayyavim mishshum mevashshel. shekkol haose davar mitztzarche habbishshul hare ze mevashshel. aval im shafat echad et hakkedera techilla uva acher venatan et hammayim uva acher venatan et habbasar uva acher venatan et hattavlin uva acher venatan et haur uva acher venatan etzim al haur uva acher vehegis. shenayim haacharonim bilvad chayyavin mishshum mevashshel: 
Hinniach basar al gabbe gechalim im nitzla bo kigrogeret afillu bishnayim ushelosha mekomot chayyav. lo nitzla bo kigrogeret aval nitbashshel kullo chatzi bishshul chayyav. nitbashshel chatzi bishshul mitztzad echad patur. ad sheyyahafoch bo veyitbashshel chatzi bishshul mishshene tzedadin. shachach vehidbik pat battannur beshabbat venizkar muttar lo lirdota kodem shetteafe veyavo lide melacha:
Niddah 21b:16-19: Bea minneh rabbi yirmeya merabbi zera: haroa dam bishfoferet mahu? "bivsarah" amar rachamana, velo bishfoferet, o dilma hay "bivsarah" mibbee leh shemmetammea mibbifnim kevachutz?
Amar leh: "bivsarah" amar rachamana velo bishfoferet, dei "bivsarah" mibbae leh shemmetammea mibbifnim kevachutz, im ken nema kera "babbasar", may "bivsarah"? shema minna tarte.
Veha amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: hammappelet chaticha — korah, im yesh bah dam agur — temea, veim lav — tehora!
Hachi hasheta? hatam darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bachaticha, hacha en darkah shel ishsha lirot dam bishfoferet.
Pesachim 30b:5-11: Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: hane sakkine befischa hechi avdinan lehu? amar leh: ledidi chadta ka avdinan. amar leh: tinach mar deefshar leh, dela efshar leh may? amar leh: ana, keen chadta kaamena: kattayyhu betina, ufarzelayyhu benura, vahadar meayyelna lekattayyhu berotchin. vehilcheta: idde veidde berotchin uvichli rishon.
Amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: etz parur magilo berotchin uvichli rishon. kasavar: kevolo kach polto.

Beo minneh meammemar: hane mane dekuneya, mahu leishtammoshe behu befischa? yerukka la tibbee lach — devadday asiri. ki tibbee lach ukkame vechivvare, may? vehecha deit behu kartufane, la tibbee lach, devadday asiri. ki tibbee lach deshii, may?
Amar leh: chazena lehu demidayyeyte, alma bali, vaasiri. vehattora heida al keli cheres sheeno yotze mide dofyo leolam.

Umay shena leinyan yen nesech, dedaresh marimar: mane dekuneya, ben ukkame ben chivvare uven yerukke — shere? vechi tema: yen nesech — derabbanan, chametz — deorayyta, kol detakkun rabbanan — keen deorayyta takkun. amar leh: ze tashmisho al yede chammin, veze tashmisho al yede tzonen.

Amar rava bar abba amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar shemuel: kol hakkelim shennishtammeshu bahen chametz betzonen — mishtammesh bahen matztza, chutz min bet seor, hoil shechimmutzo kashe. amar rav ashe: uvet charoset — kevet seor shechimmutzo kashe dame.

Amar rava: hane aggane demachoza, hoil utediri lemelash behu chamira, umeshahu behu chamira — kevet seor shechimmutzo kashe dame. peshita? mahu detema: kevan dirvicha, shalet behu avvera vela bali, ka mashma lan.

Sanhedrin 43b:1-44b:7: Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol hazzoveach et yitzro umitvadde alav, maale alav hakkatuv keillu kibbedo lehakkadosh baruch hu bishne olamim – haolam hazze vehaolam habba, dichtiv: "zoveach toda yechabbedanni".

Veamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, adam makriv ola – sechar ola beyado, mincha – sechar mincha beyado. aval mi sheddato shefala, maale alav hakkatuv keillu hikriv kol hakkarbanot kullan, shenneemar: "zivche elohim ruach nishbara". velo od, ella sheen tefillato nimeset, shenneemar: "lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze".

Mishna haya rachok mibbet hassekila keeser ammot, omrim lo: "hitvadde", shekken derech kol hammumatin mitvaddin. shekkol hammitvadde yesh lo chelek laolam habba, shekken matzinu beachan sheamar lo yehoshua: "beni sim na chavod laAdonai elohe yisrael veten lo toda". "vayyaan achan et yehoshua vayyomar omna anochi chatati vechazot vechazot vegomer". uminnayin shekkipper lo vidduyo? shenneemar: "vayyomer yehoshua me achartanu yakorcha Adonai bayyom hazze". beyom hazze atta achur, vei atta achur laolam habba.

Veim eno yodea lehitvavdot, omrim lo, emor: "tehe mitati kappara al kol avonotay". rabbi yehuda omer: im haya yodea shehu mezummam, omer: "tehe mitati kappara al kol avonotay chutz meavon ze". amru lo: im ken, yehu kol adam omrin ken kede lenakkot atzman.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "na" – en "na" ella leshon bakkasha.

Beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu lihoshua: "chata yisrael", amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mi chata? amar leh: vechi delator ani? lech happel goralot. halach vehippil goralot, venafal haggoral al achan. amar lo: yehoshua, begoral atta ba alay? atta veelazar hakkohen shene gedole haddor attem. im ani mappil alechem goral, al echad mikkem hu nofel. amar lo: bevakkasha mimmecha, al totzi laaz al haggoralot, sheatida eretz yisrael shettitchallek begoral, shenneemar: "ach begoral yechalek et haaretz".

"Ten toda". amar ravina, shachode shachadeh bemille: kelum nevakkesh mimmecha ella hodaa? ten lo toda vehippater. miyyad: "vayyaan achan et yehoshua vayyomar omna anochi chatati laAdonai elohe yisrael vechazot vechazot asiti".

Amar rav assi amar rabbi chanina: melammed shemmaal achan bishlosha charamim, shenayim bime moshe veechad bime yehoshua, shenneemar: "kazot vechazot asiti". rabbi yochanan amar mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: chamishsha, arbaa bime moshe veechad bime yehoshua, shenneemar: "anochi chatati vechazot vechazot asiti".
Vead hasheta, may tama la ianush? amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: lefi shello anash al hannistarot ad sheavru yisrael et hayyarden.

Ketannae: "hannistarot laAdonai elohenu vehanniglot lanu ulevanenu ad olam". lamma nakud al "lanu ulevanenu" veal ayin shebbead"? melammed shello anash al hannistarot ad sheavru yisrael et hayyarden, divre rabbi yehuda.

Amar lo rabbi nechemya: vechi anash al hannistarot leolam? vahalo kevar neemar "ad olam"! ella, keshem shello anash al hannistarot, kach lo anash al onashin shebbaggaluy ad sheavru yisrael et hayyarden. ella
Achan, may tama ianush? mishshum dahavo yadi beh ishto uvanav.
"Chata yisrael". amar rabbi abba bar zavda: af al pi shechata, yisrael hu. amar rabbi abba: hayeynu deamri inashe: asa dekae bene chilfe, asa shemeh, veasa karu leh.

"Vegam avru et beriti asher tzivviti otam gam lakchu min hacherem gam ganvu gam kichashu gam samu bichlehem". amar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi yehuda bar masparta: melammed sheavar achan al chamishsha chumeshe tora, shenneemar chamishsha "gam".
Veamar rabbi ila mishshum rabbi yehuda bar masparta: achan moshech beorlato haya. ketiv hacha "vegam avru et beriti", uchetiv hatam "et beriti hefar".
Peshita! mahu detema: bemitzva gufeh la pekar? ka mashma lan.
Vechi asa nevala beyisrael. amar rabbi abba bar zavda: melammed shebbaal achan naara hameorasa. ketiv hacha "vechi asa nevala", uchetiv hatam "ki asta nevala beyisrael".
Peshita! mahu detema kulle hay la pekar nafsheh, ka mashma lan. ravina amar: dineh kenaara hameorasa, deviskila.

Amar leh resh galuta lerav huna: ketiv: "vayyikkach yehoshua et achan ben zerach veet hakkesef veet haadderet veet leshon hazzahav veet banav veet benotav veet shoro veet chamoro veet tzono veet oholo veet kol asher lo". im hu chata, banav uvenotav me chatu?
Amar leh: velitamaych, im hu chata – kol yisrael me chatu? dichtiv: "vechol yisrael immo". ella lirdotan. hachi name, kede lirdotan.
"Vayyisrefu otam baesh vayyiskelu otam baavanim". betarte? amar ravina: harauy lisrefa – lisrefa, harauy liskila – liskila.
"Vaere vashshalal adderet shinar achat tova umatayim shekalim kesef". rav amar: itztela demelata, ushemuel amar: sarbala ditzrifa.

"Vayyatztzikum lifne Adonai". amar rav nachman: ba vachavatam lifne hammakom. amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, al ellu tehareg rubbah shel sanhedrin? dichtiv: "vayyakku mehem anshe haay kishloshim veshishsha ish". vetanya: sheloshim veshishsha mammash, divre rabbi yehuda. amar lo rabbi nechemya: vechi sheloshim veshishsha hayu? vahalo lo neemar ella "kishloshim veshishsha ish"! ella ze yair ben menashshe sheshshakul keneged rubbah shel sanhedrin.
Amar rav nachman amar rav: may dichtiv "tachanunim yedabber rash veashir yaane azzot"? "tachanunim yedabber rash" – ze moshe, "veashir yaane azzot" – ze yehoshua.

May tama? illema mishshum dichtiv "vayyatztzikum lifne Adonai", veamar rav nachman: ba vachavatan lifne hammakom. attu pinchas la avad hachi? dichtiv: "vayyaamod pinchas vayfallel vatteatzar hammaggefa", veamar rabbi elazar: "vayyitpallel" lo neemar ella "vayfallel", melammed sheasa pelilut im kono. ba vachavatan lifne hammakom, amar lefanav: ribbono shel olam, al ellu yippelu esrim vearbaa elef miyyisrael? dichtiv: "veyihyu hammetim bammaggefa arbaa veesrim alef".
Veella mehacha: "lamma heavarta haavir et haam hazze et hayyarden". moshe name memar amar: "lema hareota laam hazze". ella mehacha: "velu hoalnu vanneshev beever hayyarden".

"Vayyomer Adonai el yehoshua kum lach". daresh rabbi shela: amar leh hakkadosh baruch hu: shellecha kasha mishshellahem. ani amarti "vehaya beovrechem et hayyarden takimu", veattem richaktem shishshim mil.
Batar dinfak, okem rav amora aleh uderash: "kaasher tzivva Adonai et moshe avdo ken tzivva moshe et yehoshua vechen asa yehoshua lo hesir davar mikkol asher tzivva Adonai et moshe".
Im ken, ma talmud lomar "kum lach"? amar lo: atta garamta lahem. vehayeynu dekaamar leh beay: "veasita laay ulemalkah kaasher asita liricho ulemalkah vegomer".

"Vayhi bihyot yehoshua biricho vayyissa enav vayyar vegomer vayyomer lo ki ani sar tzeva Adonai atta vati [vayyippol yehoshua el panav artza vayyishtachu]". hechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: asur lo leadam sheyyitten shalom lachavero ballayla, chayyshinan shemma shed hu!
Shane hatam, dekaamar leh: "ani sar tzeva Adonai atta vati vegomer". vedilma meshakkeri? gemiri dela mappeki shem shamayim levattala.
Amar leh: emesh bittaltem tamid shel ben haarbayim, veachshav bittaltem talmud tora. al eze mehen bata? amar leh: "atta bati".
Miyyad "vayyalen yehoshua ballayla hahu betoch haemek", veamar rabbi yochanan: melammed shellan beumekah shel halacha.
Amar shemuel bar inya mishshemeh derav: gadol talmud tora yoter mehakeravat temidin, shenneemar: "atta vati".
Amar leh abbaye lerav dimi: hay kera bemareva bemay mokmitu leh: "al tetze lariv maher pen ma taase beacharitah behachelim otcha reecha. rivcha riv et reecha vesod acher al tegal"?

Beshaa sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu lichezkel: lech emor lahem leyisrael "avich haemori veimmech chittit", amra ruach piskonit lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, im yavou avraham vesara veyaamdu lefanecha, atta omer lahem umachlim otam? "rivcha riv et reecha vesod acher al tegal"!

Umi it leh reshuta kulle hay? in, deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: shalosh shemot yesh lo – piskon, itmon, sigron. piskon – shepposek devarim kelappe mala, itmon – sheotem avonotehen shel yisrael, sigron – kevan shessoger shuv eno poteach.

"Hayaaroch shuacha lo vetzar", amar rabbi elazar: leolam yakdim adam tefilla latztzara, sheilmale lo hikdim avraham tefilla latztzara ben bet el uven haay, lo nishtayyer missonehen shel yisrael sarid ufalit. resh lakish amar: kol hameammetz atzmo bitfilla millematta, en lo tzarim millemala. rabbi yochanan amar: leolam yevakkesh adam rachamim sheyyehu hakkol meammetzin et kocho, veal yehu lo tzarim millemala.

Zohar, Beha'alotcha 10: (Bamidbar 8:6) kach et haleviyyim vegomer, ha ukemuha devae ledakkea (sefer acher ledabbera) lon, uleamshacha lon, leitkashshera beatrayyhu, begin deinnun deroa semala, vesitra dedina, vechol man deate missitra dedina, bae dela yarbe saara, begin deasge dina bealma. veal da itteta kehay gavvna, dela yitchaze saara levar, uvayay leitchappeyay reshe, ulechasse saraha, veokimna, veha ittemar. ucheden itbarchan kol innun deatyayn missitra dedina. veal da belevae ketiv, vecho taase lahem letaharam vegomer, veheeviru taar vegomer. veittemar levae la sallekin leatrayyhu, ad deyarim lon kahana, begin dimina madbar tadir lismala.

Rabbi shimon amar, beyoma desallekin levae beduchetayyhu, bitren parim. may tama parim. ella inhu kefarim, lekabbela bismala lehay para deikre para aduma. kahana kol chela vechol tikkuna beh talyay, begin dechol chela degufa bidroa yemina kayyeyma. veal da kahana deroa deyisrael kullehu havi. uveh kayyeyma leatkena kolla uleatkena alma (sefer acher may tama parim ella inhu semala kefarim lekabbela bismala. ta chaze kahana deroa yemina deyisrael kullehu hava uveh kayyeyma leittakna alma uleittakkana kolla begin dechol chela degufa bidroa yemina kayyeyma vechol tikkuna beh talyay) veim kol da, la ishtechach bilchodoy, ella begufa usemala, vegufa ikkara hu decholla.
Zohar, Beha'alotcha 12: (Bamidbar 9:1) vaydabber Adonai el moshe bemidbar sinay vegomer. amar ribbi abba, may tama azhar lehon hacha al pischa, veha ittemar lehu bemitzrayim. ella bashshana hashshenit hava, deyisrael chashivu deha pesach lav ihu ella bemitzrayim, vechevan deavdu leh zimna chada bemitzrayim, chashivu dela itzterich yatir. ata kudesha berich hu veazhar lon aleh, dela yachshevun deha ka avar zimneh bemitzrayim, velo yitzterich. begin kach bemidbar sinay bashshana hashshenit, leatkena lehu ledare darin.

Veaf al gav deha azhar lehu bemitzrayim, hasheta pakid lon zimna achara, behahu atar dechol pikudin deorayyta beh ityehivu. veal da bashshana hashshenit. may bashshana hashshenit bachodesh harishon. ella raza illaa hi, chad shana. vechad chodesh. ma ben hay lehay. chodesh: da sihara. shana: da shimsha, denahir lesihara. ucheden hava bezimna dechol pikudin deorayyta itmesaru beh.

Rabbi shimon amar, vavy lehahu bar nash deamar, deha orayyta ata leachazaa sippurin bealma, umillin dehedyote. dei hachi, afillu bezimna da, anan yachlin lemebad orayyta, bemillin dehedyote, uvishvacha yatir mikkullehu. i leachazaa milla dealma, afillu innun kafsire dealma, it benayyhu millin illain yatir. i hachi nezil abbatrayyhu, venabed minnayyhu orayyta, kehay gavvna. ella kol millin deorayyta, millin illain innun, verazin illain.

Ta chaze, alma illaa vealma tattaa bechad matkela itkalu. yisrael letatta, malache illae leella. malache illae ketiv behu, (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot. (hay baatar illaa) beshaata denachtin letatta (af al gav denachtin), mitlabbeshe bilvusha dehay alma. vei lav mitlabbeshe bilvusha kegavvna dehay alma, la yachlin lemekam behay alma, vela savil lon alma. vei bemalache kach, orayyta devara lehu, uvara almin kullehu, vekayymin beginah, al achat kamma vechamma kevan denachtat lehay alma, i lav demitlabbesha behane levushin dehay alma, la yachil alma lemisbal.

Veal da hay sippur deorayyta, levusha deorayyta. ihu. man dechashiv dehahu levusha ihu orayyta mammash, vela milla achara, tippach rucheh, vela yehe leh chulaka bealma deate. begin kach amar david, (Tehillim 119:18) gal enay veabbita niflaot mittoratecha. ma ditchot levusha deorayyta.
Ta chaze, it levusha deitchaze lecholla, veinnun tippeshin kad chaman levar nash bilvusha deitchaze lon shappira, la mistakkelin yattir. chashivu dehahu levusha, gufa, vachashivu degufa, nishmeta.

Kehay gavvna orayyta, it lah gufa, veinnun pikkude orayyta, deikrun gufe tora. hay gufa mitlabbesha bilvushin, deinnun sippurin dehay alma. tippeshin dealma, la mistakkele ella behahu levusha, deihu sippur deorayyta, vela yade yattir, vela mistakkele bema deihu techot hahu levusha. innun deyadin yattir, la mistakkelan bilvusha, ella begufa, deihu techot hahu levusha. chakkimin avde demalka illaa, innun dekayymu betura desinay, la mistakkele ella benishmeta, deihi ikkara decholla orayyta mammash. (ulealma) ulezimna deate, zeminin leistakkela benishmeta denishmeta deorayyta.

Ta chaze, hachi name leella, it levusha, vegufa, venishmeta, venishmeta lenishmeta. shemayya vechelehon. illen innun levusha. ucheneset yisrael, da gufa, dimkabbela lenishmeta, deihi tiferet yisrael. veal da ihu gufa lenishmeta. nishmeta deamaran da tiferet yisrael, deihi orayyta mammash. venishmeta lenishmeta, da ihu attika kaddisha. vecholla achid da beda.

Vavy leinnun chayyayvayya, deamre deorayyta lav ihi ella sippura bealma, veinnun mistakkele bilvusha da vela yattir. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, demistakkele beorayyta kaddeka yeut. chamra la yativ ella bekankan. kach orayyta la yetiv ella bilvusha da. veal da la bae leistakkela, ella bema deit techot levusha. veal da kol innun millin, vechol innun sippurin, levushin innun.
Zohar, Beha'alotcha 18: (Bamidbar 10:2) ase lecha shete chatzotzrot kesef vegomer. ribbi shimon patach, (yechezkel 1:19) uvelechet hachayyot yelchu haofannim etzlam uvehinnase hachayyot meal haaretz yinnasu haofannim. uvelechet hachayyot, bekuzefira dilella havo azle. dei tema dehay leella leella. lav, letatta. ella kegavvna hay mikkamme anpin, vehay levatar anpin.

Zika mearba zikin, bed madorin, uved sitrin, bezivavn deitberun bekolmitin deanpin nehirin. begin kach keen (551) kemare hachayyot, deinnun arva zivyayn, degalin perisan, arye. nesher. shor. adam. dechalil kullehu 4 malachin deshaltin uchelilan kolla.

Digla kadmaa, mashirya mizzayyna, arye. michael, rashim bifrishu digla perisha limina. mizrach sheruta deshimsha, azil bematlanoy, binhiru. teren memanan techot yedeh, yofiel, tzadkiel. chad leureta (nusach acher leorayyta). vechad, lemehach beshuka deazil

Kad illen natlin, natlin kama mashshiryayn mezayyeynin, missitra dimina, vecholla chad. lesitra semala, shimsha azil (sefer acher natal kad chad listar shimsha, shimsha azil) venahir, umeatter lehu. elef verivvavn memanan techotoy. vechullehu bidchilu beemata bezia beretet.
Arye oshit yedeh yemina, kanish lechol cheloy legabbeh, telat mea veshivin elef aryevavta, socharaneh dehahu arye, veihu benayyhu beemtzaita.

Kad gae hay arye, mizdazean rekiin, vechol chayyalin umashiryayn mizdazein, middechilu dileh. mehahu kala, nehar di nur mitlahata, venachit beelef vachamesh mea dargin degehinnam letatta, keden kullehu chayyayvin degehinnam mizdazean, umelahatan eshsha, veal da ketiv, (Amos 3:8) arye shaag mi lo yira.

Gae tinyaynut, telat mea veshivin elef aryevavta, kullehu gaan. oshit yedeh semala, kol marehon dedina letatta dachalin, veitkafyayn techot hahu yeda. vehahu yeda pashit alayyhu, vechullehu techoteh. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 49:8) yadcha beoref oyvecha.
Arba gadpin lechol chad vechad, meeshsha chivvavra. kullehu melahatin. kol appin dechizzur veshushan bechivavrta dehahu eshsha shekian.

Arba anpin lechol chad vechad learba sitrin, kullehu nehirin bechivvavra deshimsha. chad listar mizrach, nahir bechedu. vechad listar maarav, (sefer acher da kanish) deitkenish nehoreh. vechad listar tzafon, chashuch bela nehiru, ketzila deshimsha legabbe shimsha. tzilla chashuch, shimsha nahir. begin deshimsha vetzila, yemina usemala, veazla kachada. chashochan (sefer acher chusheban) deazlin immeh, kol innun denatlin zayyna.

Vechullehu mimina umissemala bitlat reshin. resha chada dileh, shivin vearba elef, veshit mea. illen innun resha chad. nafke chela bimina, deihu arim alayyhu. bar kol innun memanan diltatta, techot illen. shiltonin illen al illen, dargin tattain im illain, delet lon chushebana.

Resha tinyayna, deazil beresha kadmaa, chusheban dileh chamshin vearba elef, vearba mea. bar kol illen memanan ditchot led sitrin, delet lon chushebana. resha telitaa, deazil batrayyhu, chamshin veshiva elef, vearba mea. kegavvna denatil yemina, hachi name natil semala, hachi name mikkammayyhu, hachi name mibbatrayyhu.
Kevan denatil hay kadmaa, vehurad hammishkan. vechullehu levave amre shirata, mare detushebchan kullehu missitreh. keden (yechezkel 1:21) ki ruach hachayya baofannim ketiv.
Zohar, Beha'alotcha 2: Ribbi abba patach, (Tehillim 89:16) ashre haam yode terua Adonai beor panecha yehallechun. hay kera ukemuha, aval ta chaze, zakkain innun yisrael, dekudesha berich hu yahav lon orayyta kaddisha, veolif lon archoy, leitdabbeka beh, ulemetar pikkude deorayyta, lemizke behu lealma deate. vekariv lehu beshaata denafku mimmitzrayim, deha keden appik lon mershuta achara, vesalik lon leitachada bishmeh, ucheden ikrun bene yisrael, bene chorin mikkolla. dela yatvu techot reshuta achara, vesalik lon leachada bishmeh, desalik al kolla, deshallit al illain vetattain.

Umiggo rechimuta dilhon, kara lon (Shemot 4) beni vechori yisrael, kegavvna (dikdushsha) illaa (veal da). katal (sefer acher uketal) kol bechor dilella vetatta, veshara ketirin veassirin deillain vetattain, begin leappaka lon, veavid lon bene chorin mikkolla. veal da la baa kudesha berich hu, la malach, vela saraf, ella ihu. veod, deha ihu yada leavchana uleminda kolla, ulemishre asirin, velav innun birshuta dishlicha achara ella bideh.

Ta chaze, behahu lelya devaa kudesha berich hu lekatla kol innun bechore kema deittemar, beshaata deramash lelya, atu mezammerin lezammera kammeh, amar lon, lav iddan hu deha shirata achara, mezammerin banay beara. beshaata deitpelig lelya, ittear ruach tzafon, vekudesha berich hu keden avad nukemin, veyisrael avdin shirata bekol ram, (sefer acher veyisrael mezammerin veamrin haleylea bekol ram) ucheden avad lon bene chorin mikkolla, umalachin illae, vechol mashiryayn kullehu, havo tzayytin lehon lekalehon deyisrael. batar deitgezaru, reshimu levattehon, mehahu dama, umiddama defischa, bitlat reshimin. (Shemot 12:23) al hammashkof veal shete hammezuzot.

May tama. ha ukemuha begin deihu reshima kaddisha, umechabbela kad ihu nafik, vechame hahu dama dehava rashim al hahu pitcha, chayis alayyhu deyisrael, hada hu dichtiv ufasach Adonai al happetach vegomer. hacha it leistakkela, i kudesha berich hu ate vekatil beara demitzrayim, velo sheliach achara, reshima da deal pitcha lamma, veha kolla gale kammeh. vetu, mahu velo yitten hammashchit, velo yashchit mibbae leh.

Ella vadday hachi hu, dichtiv, (Shemot 12:29) vaAdonai hikka chol bechor. vaAdonai: hu uvet dino. vehahu be dina hacha ishtechach. (sefer acher mikkan divcholla) uvecholla bae leachazaa ovada, begin leishtezava. deha kegavvna da al gabbe madbecha, begin dela ishtechach mechabbela.

Hay beovada, uvezimna dela itzterich hay, kegon rosh hashshana, deihu yoma dedina, umarehon delishana bisha kayymin alayyhu deyisrael, baenan millin, tzelotin uvautin, uvaenan leachazaa ovada (sefer acher berucha venafsha) kema deokimna. veha ittemar, uvema. bashshofar. (leachazaa shofar) leatteara shofra achara. vaanan mefikin behahu kala, rachame vedina kachada, kolla kadka yaut. kema dehahu shofar illaa, appik kala deihu kelala kachada. uleatara rachame kaazlenan, uletabbera marehon dedina, dela yishletun behay yoma. vechad rachame mitarin, kullehu butzinin illain naharin mehay gisa umehay gisa. keden (Mishlei 16:15) beor pene melech chayyim.

Ta chaze, beshaata dechahana (Rava) itkevavn leadleka butzinin letatta, vahava kariv ketoret busemin, behahu shaata keden butzinin illain naharin, veitketar kolla kachada, vechidu vechedvavta ishtechach bechullehu almin, hada hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:9) shemen uketoret yesammach lev, veal da behaalotcha et hannerot.
Zohar, Beha'alotcha 6: (Bamidbar 21:18) beer chafaruha sarim karuha nedive haam, beer, da keneset yisrael. chafaruha sarim, da abba veima, deolidu lah. karuha nedive haam, illen avahan. dichtiv, (Tehillim 47:10) nedive ammim neesafu am elohe avraham vegomer. begin leitbarcha minnehon, al yede dedarga chad, umanno. tzaddik dekaim ala. veal da amrenan, kad hay beer natla, besiua daavahan natla.

Veikre beer, veikkere yam. ikre beer, beshaata deyitzchak nafik mizzayyna missitra deima, veate leamshacha abbatra deda, umalle lah, keden ikre beer deyitzchak. beer demiryam. veha ukemuha. yam kad itnahara minnahara illaa deabba, keden ikre yam, denachalin azlin legavvav, kema deat amer (Kohelet 1:7) kol hannechalim holchim el hayyam vehayyam enennu male.

Umiyyoma degalta keneset yisrael begaluta, ketiv (iyyov 14:11) azlu mayim minni yam, da cheneset yisrael. venahar yecherav veyavesh, da tzaddik. veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzadik avad vegomer. dehu hava nahar illaa veyakira, deayil begavav, vehu kanish kol innun naharin unachalin, denagdin minnegidu dehahu nahar kaddisha, dela paskin memoy lealmin, denagid venafik meeden illaa, vehu ayel begavvav umalle agmaha, umittamman yartin almin kullehu (ittezanu veyartin) birkan becholla.
Zohar, Vayakhel 12: Lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem, hacha it raza derazin, leinnun deyade chachmeta illaa, raza deshabbat ha ukemuha chavrayyay. aval raza da, itmesar lechakkime elyonin, deha shabbat raza illaa hu.

Ta chaze (sefer acher beyoma shetitaa beshaata demate) beshaata deyoma shetitaa mata zimna deerev, keden, kochava chad missitra detzafon nahir, veimmeh shivin kochavin acharanin, vehahu kochava batash beinnun kochavin acharanin, veitkalylu kullehu behahu kochava, veitavid chad kelala deshivin. vehahu kochava itpashat, veitavid kemadura chada, lehita bechol sitrin. keden itpashat hahu madura sacharanayyhu deelef turin, vekayyeyma kechad chuta desachara.

Vehay madura deeshsha, mashich legabbeh gavvnin acharanin dilgo minneh. gon kadmaa yeroka. kevan dekayyeyma hay gavvna, salleka hahu madura deeshsha, vedalig leella al hahu gon yeroka, veal lego minneh, veshadde lehahu gon yeroka levar, vekayyeyma yeroka levar, vehahu madura deeshsha dechochava kelila lego.

Levatar, amshich avatreh gon achara tinyayna chivvavra, vehahu chivvavra al lego, kevan dekayyeyma hay gon, salleka hahu madura deeshsha dehahu kochava, veshadde lehahu chivvavra levar, veal ihu lego. vechen kol innun gavvnin, ad deshade lon levar, veayil ihu lego, vekariv legabbe hahi nekuda temira, lemetal nehora.

Patach veamar, (yechezkel 1:4) vaere vehinni ruach seara baa min hatztzafon vegomer. yechezkel chama lehay chezu, betikkuna dela kayyeyma, bar beshaata deshallit hahu kochava kidkaamran, aval hay kera ukemuha. vehinne ruach seara, ukemuha, dehava ate lemichbash kol alma, lekammeh dinvuchadnetzar chayyayva. aval ruach seara da, ihu hahu kochava dekaamran, devala shivin kochavin acharanin, veda ihu ruach seara dechama eliyyahu, (Melachim 1 19:11) mefarek harim umeshabber selaim, veda dekayyeyma tadir kodam kolla, lemetar hahu dilgo, kiklifa lemocha.

Vaamay ikre seara. desair kolla, ella vetatta. baa min hatztzafon, deha min hahu sitra ka atya, vesimanich, (Yirmeyahu 1:14) mitztzafon tippatach haraa, deha kama sitrin acharanin itachadan behahu ruach seara, ubbegin kach nafka min hatztzafon.

Anan, begin deihi susefita dedahava. umissitra detzafon itachada da. vehay ihi nekuda (184 amud bet) emtzaita, dekayyeyma bechureba. uvegin deyada limfatte, shallit bego nekuda dishuva, vechol millin dishuva. bar ara deyisrael, kad sharan yisrael begavvah, ihu (davar acher lo) shalta alayyhu, ulevatar (141 amud alef) dechavu yisrael (davar acher lo) shalta al ara kaddisha, begin dichtiv, (Eicha 2:3) heshiv achor yemino mippene oyev.

Anan gadol da, ihu anana dechashocha, deachashich kol alma. ta chaze, ma ben anana laanana. hahu anana dichtiv (Bamidbar 10:34) vaanan Adonai alehem yomam. (Bamidbar 14:14) vaanancha omed alehem. (Vayikra 103 amud alef, 3 amud bet) hay ihu anana denahir vezahir, vechol nehorin itchazun go hahu anana. aval anana da, anana chashuch, dela nahir kelal, aval mana kol nehorin, dela yachlin leitchazaa kammeh.

Gadol, amay ikre gadol, veha zeer ihu. ella gadol ihu, kevan deshallit. davar acher gadol, hahu chashocha gadol, kevan dechasse kol nehorin vela itchazun kammeh, veihu gadol (nusach acher shallit) al kol ovadin dealma.

Veesh mitlakkachat, deha eshsha dedina kashya, la ade mineh lealmin. venoga lo saviv, af al gav dechol hay kayyeyma beh, noga lo saviv. mehacha olifna, deaf al gav delet sitra da, ella sitra (69 amud alef) dimsoovu, noga lo saviv, vela itzterich leh levar nash, ledachyay leh levar. may tama. begin denoga lo saviv, sitra dikdushsha dimhemnuta it leh, vela itzterich leanhaga beh kelana. veal da itzterich lemehav leh chulaka, besitra dikdushsha dimhemnuta.

Rav hamenuna sava, hachi amar, vechi noga lo saviv, veitzterich leanhaga beh kelana, hay noga lo, lego ihu, vela kayyeyma levar. uvegin dekayyeyma hahu noga lo miggo, ketiv umittochah keen hachashmal mittoch haesh. mittocha deman. mittocha dehahu noga. keen hachashmal: chash, mal, ha ukemuha, chevavn deeshsha (81 amud bet) memallela.

Aval mibbutzina kaddisha shemana ala raza derazin. kad arla share al kayyeyma kaddisha lesaava makdesha, keden hahu makdesha, itakkav millegallaa raza deat kayyayma, miggo arla. vechad hay noga al lego, veafrish ben arla, uven makdesha, keden ikre chashmal chash veitgalya. mal, mahu mal. kema deat amer (yehoshua Adonai:4) mal yehoshua. raza deat kayyayma, itakkav milleitgallaa miggo arla.
Veit raza achara, deha nehora dileh, itchaze vela itchaze, vechad itgalya chashmal itabbar nehoreh. aval raza kadmaa, ihu beraza dikra kedka yeot, vecholla shappir ihu, veyaut hu.

Behay noga, mefatte leitteta, lenatla nehora. veal da ketiv, (Mishlei Adonai:3) vechalak mishshemen chikkah, shavve hahu nehora lokovleh divrit. uvegine kach mefatte leh, venatla nehoreh. veda ihu pittuya dimfatte leitteta, dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:3) nofet tittofna sifte zara vegomer.

Ta chaze, beyoma shetitaa kad mata zimna deerev, dalig lego hahu (nusach acher madora) nehora deeshsha, vesalleka leella leaala go gavvnin. keden mettakkenin yisrael letatta, umesadderin seudatin, umatkenin patorin, kol chad vechad patoreh. keden chad shalhova nafik uvatash behahu madura, kevan devatash beh, mitgalgelan hahu shalhova, vehahu maddura vealin benukeba dithoma rabba, veittammeran veyatvat taman.

Vehahu shalhova ihu missitra dimina, uvegin dehu missitra dimina, abar lehahu maddura, veail leh lenukeba dithoma rabba, veyativ tamman ad denafik shabbeta. kevan denafak shabbeta, itzterich lehu leamma deyisrael levarcha al eshsha, venafka hahu shalhova, bevircheta diltatta, veshalit al hahu maddura kol hahu lelya, veitkafya hahu maddura.

ohc: Utekatem terua shenit. velo haya maspik bitkia achat lechullan, kederech shettokea lemaarav vetzafon tekia achat lishnehem, keamram besifre (2 73). hattaam letzad shehayu moridim hammishkan venosim bene gershon kodem sheyyisu degel bene reuven temana, laze tzarich tekia bifne atzmah achar nesiat hammishkan:

Lamma hareota vegomer velamma vegomer. kashe lamma hitchil betaromet hannezek veachar kach betaromet meniat hattoelet, shehaya tzarich lomar "lamma lo matzati chen" vegomer velamma hareota" vegomer? achen hakkavvana hi al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sifre 1,91) befasuk "lech neche et haam", sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe: "banay sarvanim hem, tarchanim hem vechulei, mekallelim etchem, soklim etchem baavanim" vechulei, ad kan leshonam. veal ze ba maamar moshe kan lamma hareota, perush, hittalta alay haraa hazzot lisbol raot banecha, veachar shekkibbalti haya min harauy limtzo chen beenecha latet li ozer lissa immi baol haggadol, velo chen asita shennatatta alay kol hammassa. veamar lo matzati chaser 1, lomar afillu mitztzuy, perush, davar muat mehachen lo hissagti.

O yirtze al ze hadderech: lamma hareota kemo shepperashti, veamro velamma lo matzati perush, kevan shennatatta alay ol haddavar hazze yesh li liton lamma lo matzati chen letzad shessamta alay massa kol haam, uferush lamed shel lasum hi lamed hassibba. veamar ze moshe, letzad sheraa ki bikkesh shello yitten lahem basar velo yahargem kedivre hammidrash shekkatavnu besamuch velo matza chen beene Adonai lekabbel tefillato. gam raa hammesubbav mehem, shehem garmu lo mita bammidbar vechamma anfe hayyagon asher subbav lo mehem asher lo chen haya min harauy lehishtallem al yegio vesivlotav.

Kach et haleviyyim vegomer. peresh Rashi kachem bidvarim. venire shennitkavven lomar sheyyavdilem miyyisrael velaasot lahem machane leviyya letzad hatztzorech betaharatam yoter mibbene yisrael, vehaed ma sheggamar omer vetiharta otam, hare shebbetzarche tahara hakkatuv medabber.

rashi: Ki kinneti bahollim. bimarbeve darchehem asher hayiti roe et shelomam:
Bahollim. mearbevim, kemo (Yeshayahu 1:22) "savech mahul bammayim" (sefer acher eno):
targum: Arum tenanet bimtalavaya beidan di shelam rashiaya echeme:

rashi: Ze devar Adonai el zerubbavel. ze siman lecha lehavetiach et zerubbavel, keshem shehazzetim vehashshemen hazze nigmar meelav lechol devarav, kach lo vechayil velo vechoach shebbachem taasu et binyan beti:

Ki im beruchi. ani etten ruchi al daryavesh veyanniach lachem (sefarim acherim: vitzavve lachem) livnot velaasot kol tzarche yetziat habbinyan mishshello, velaazor etchem bechittin veyayin veshemen veetzim, kemo shemmeforash beezra (Ezra 6:8-9). velo titztarchu leezrat adam:
targum: Vaativ vaamar li lememar den pitgama dayya im zerubbavel lememar la vechela vela bigvura elahen bememri amar Adonai tzevaot:

ohc: Vehaish asher hu tahor vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma lo katav onesh hammevattel pesach bizmanno ad atta velo keshekkatav mitzvat happesach, ulefi ma shennechleku beinyan ze (fesachim 93.) veze leshonam: tanu rabbanan chayyav al harishon vechayyav al hashsheni divre rabbi, rabbi natan omer chayyav al harishon ufatur al hashsheni, rabbi chanina ben akiva omer af al harishon eno chayyav ella im ken lo asa hashsheni, veamru sham bifsachim ushelashtam mikra echad darshu, yeuyyan sham. meatta lechol achat mehassevarot hinniach hakkatuv lomar ad kan lechol echad mehassevarot kedarko, ma shello hayinu shomin ken im haya metzavve bimkomo.

rashi: Ma elle adoni. ma ze shehazzetim nimsakim mealehem, vehashshemen ba el hannerot meelav:
targum: Vaativet vaamaret lemalacha demalel imi lememar ma ilen ribboni:

rashi: Vaani. mitterem sumi zot el libbi:
Kimat natayu raglay vshuppechu ashuray. lintot meachare hammakom:
targum: Vaana kizer itmotata rigle kilma deizdazea istavray:

ohc: Vehinne metzoraat. lo haya tzarich lomar haddavar achar shekkevar amar "vehinne miryam metzoraat" vegomer, ulefi divrehem zichronam livracha (sifre) sheamru sheggam aharon nitztara, yirtze lomar hinne hi adayin metzoraat velo parcha mimmenna keaharon. veamru od chachamenu zichronam livracha (sham) sheddavka keshehaya pone hayta metzoraat, ucheshehaya machzir panav hayta porachat mimmenna, uledivrehem tzarich lomar ki moshe lo haya mabbit bemiryam ladaat ma hi, sheim lo chen mimma nafshach kashe, vehaven:

Harak ach bemoshe. razal amru (Bereshit Rabba 1,14) akkin verakkin miutin, vechan nitkavvenu lomar baze shemmaase moshe yirshom happegam bahem gam baavot haolam asher dibber immahem Adonai, vechen hu bammidrash (sifre) veze leshonam: vahalo gam im haavot dibber, ad kan. veod efshar shennitkavvenu lirmoz shene miutim shehayu binvuat moshe, 1 shello nitnabbe ad shehaya ben shemonim shana dichtiv (Shemot 7:7) "umoshe ben shemonim shana... bedabberam el paro" uveoto zeman hu sheddibber elav Adonai, veaharon umiryam nitnabbeu bene shalosh vechamesh kodem shennolad moshe, umiut sheni shebbayyom shennitnabba nitztara, dichtiv (sham 4): "vehinne yado metzoraat: vegomer ma shello haya ken lahem, ucheneged ze amar "harak ach".

Vayyishma Adonai. hutzrach lomar vayyishma Adonai, lomar shello shama ella Adonai, hakkavvana baze shello dibberu bifne beriyya. od nitkavven lomar shemmehem shama velo mimmoshe, shello kaval lifne Adonai kederech hanneelavin mizzulatam.

rashi: Keayyal taarog al afike mayim. leshon arog nofel al kol haayyal, kaasher yippol leshon naham laari veshakok laddov ugea lashshevarim, vetziftzuf laofot. amru rabbotenu : haayyala hazzot chasida shebbachayyot, ucheshehachayyot tzemeot lammayim hem mitkannesot eleha shettitle eneha lammarom, uma hi osa? choferet guma umachneset karneha letochah vegoa, vehakkadosh baruch hu merachem aleha vehattehom maala lah mayim:

Keayyal taarog. keayyelet taarog lo neemar vechayyal yaarog lo neemar, ella keayyal taarog. dibber hakkatuv bezachar uvinkeva: hazzachar oreg al esek hammayim kemo shepperashnu, hannekeva keshehi koraat leled vehi tzoeket, hakkadosh baruch hu merachem aleha. umenachem chibber taarog im "lechayav kaarugat habbosem" (Shir HaShirim 5:13), achen lo yittachnu devarav. gam donash patar oto leshon kol shel ayyal (sefer acher eno):
targum: Hech ayala di merageg al patzide maya hechna nafshi meragga levatach Adonai:

rashi: Ma shene hazzetim. ma remez hem, uma remez shene shibbale zetim teroka belaaz, kevutzot zetim beanaf keen shibbolet:
targum: Vaativet vaamaret leh ma teren zetaya hailen al yemin menarta veal semala:

ohc: Vayhi binsoa haaron vegomer kuma Adonai vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat hammaamar. veyitbaer hakkatuv al pi divrehem (etz chayyim sear 32 perek 1) sherashamnu bechamma mekomot, shettaam halichat yisrael bammidbar hayta levarer nitzotze hakkedushsha hashshevuyot birshut shochen midbar tziyya. vetzarich atta ladaat ki hachitzonim yeshnam bishte haderagot: 1 hu bechinat hammesit vehamefatte lannidbak bo lehara ulehashchit, 2 bechinat hammazzik vehamechabbel veen betivo lefattot. uva hammaamar kan vayhi binsoa haaron ki keshennosea umitdabbekim bo kol nitzotze hakkedushsha ucheshemmitbarrim nitzotze hakkedushsha mitpotztzim umishtabberim hakkelippot, vehu maamar kuma Adonai, veyafutzu oyvecha shehem hakkelippot hanneechazot benitzotze hakkedushsha yitpotztzu, vaalehem ramaz betevat vayhi leshon tzaar, ucheneged bechinat hara hamefatte et haadam amar veyanusu mesanecha mippanecha perush, otam bechinot hammasniim derech Adonai belibbot bene adam yanusu. veamro leshon rabbim letzad heyotam rabbim hamefattim, kemaamaram zichronam livracha beyoma (yoma 69:) sheyyesh yetzer hara shel avoda zara veshel zenut vechulei.

Vechol ze binsoa, perush bederech nesia, ucheshehaya chone haya omer beofen acher, ki Adonai keshechone bemakom echad yaggid baze ki hammekomot shello chana sham lo haya sham berur nitzotze hakkedushsha sheyyitztarech lachanot shamma veyaspik maavar derech sham, uvemakom asher yachane sham yaggid ki sham yesh nitzotze hakkedushsha shetztzarich lehitakkev bishvilam sham. veal ze haya mechavven moshe veomer benucho shuva Adonai rivvot alfe yisrael, perush sheyyashiv nitzotze hakkedushsha lekabbetz kol harvavot vaalafim hannikraim yisrael ki chol nitzotze hakkedushsha yikkaru yisrael. veulay sheramaz betevat alfe leshon maala verabbanut, vetimtza ki nitzotze hakkedushsha asher shava 100 harasha hayu rabbim venichbadim, vetze ulemad rut minnayin yatzta, vichavven moshe baze lehitpallel lehitatztzem koach kedushshat yisrael beezer Adonai lenatztzeach ulevarer kol asher yimmatze bammakom hahu.

rashi: Venilvu. venitchabberu:
targum: Veyittosfun ammin sagiin al ameh dayya beidana hahi vihon kodamay leam veashre shechinti begavich vetedun are Adonai tzevaot shalchani leitnabbaa alach:

rashi: Im bidrachay telech. vegam ani zot eese lecha:
Atta tadin et beti. tishpot vetihye pakid al bet mikdashi:
Venatatti lecha mahlechim. ketargumo: "uvaachayut metayya achayyenach veetten lach raglin dimhallechin ben serafayya haillen". ulefi feshuto: mevassero al banav sheyyizku leatid:
Haomdim. serafim umalache hashsharet sheen lahem yeshiva (Shemot Rabba 25):
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai tzevaot im beorchan detaknan kodamay tehach veim yat matrat memri titar veaf at tadin ledimshamshin bevet mikdeshi veaf titar yat ezrati uvaachayut metay achayinach veetten lach riglin mehalechan bet sarfaya hailen:

ohc: Vayyitzak vegomer lemor. taam amro lemor, ba betaana kede shello yomru shehikpid veyachzikuhu kenoter eva, vedivre aharon yaggidu lamo, laze amar betzooko laAdonai bishvil shello yomru devarim hanneemarim besamuch mippi aharon:
Od yirtze, ki amar lifne Adonai kodem hitpallo shehu mochel al kevodo, veachar kach hitpallel "el na" vegomer:
El na. nitkavven lishol mimmiddat hachesed, keamro (tehillim 52:3) "chesed el". na, leshon bakkasha ufiyyus leorer harachamim. refa na – perush atta velo yitakkev.

Vehaam lo nasa. tala haddavar baam velo amar "velo nasa haam", lehodia ki haam hiskimu leval yisu ad heasef miryam, vahagam shehaddavar haya taluy binsiat heanan, hattora meida ki gam bizchutah hem hayu chafetzim baakkava lechabbedah, uma gam im haya yadua lahem ki bizchutah haya hammayim lahem (taanit 9.) bevadday sheyyeshev sham haam al hammayim.
Chassalat parashat behaalotcha

Vechi yagur. amar betosefet vav, nitkavven baze lehattil al yisrael mishpat haggerim leval yezalzelu bammitzvot, velaze amar vechi yagur mosif al inyan rishon, uma inyan rishon livne yisrael gam ze leyisrael.

Veasa vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma katav "veasa" betosefet vav bitchillat inyan. od lamma hutzrach lachzor lomar ken yaase, vehaya nire lomar shebba lishlol ger toshav, velaze amar vechi yagur ittechem ger veyihye meotam sheosim pesach, dehaynu ger shemmekayyem hattora, al ze ani metzavvecha kechukkat happesach vegomer ken yaase. veen perush ze maspik, ki muvan hu haddavar sheeno medabber ella beger gamur.

Veyitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha besifre (Bamidbar 9:14) veze leshonam: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, hare shennitgayyer ben shene pesachim, shomea ani yaase sheni, talmud lomar "uleezrach", ma ezrach shello asa vechulei, ad kan. vehu maamar hakkatuv "veasa" betosefet vav, lomar im haya ben maase harishon az yitchayyev laasot sheni keshello huchshar. uchefi ze amro veasa tenay hu, az hu kechukkat happesach vegomer yaase, perush chukkat happesach hu sheyyeshno gam ken betashlumin, aval im eno befesach rishon eno befesach sheni.

Od nire lefaresh, behair od lamma perat hakkatuv hagger bemitzva zo mikkol hammitzvot. vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (sifre) veze leshonam: en li ella pesach shehishva hagger laezrach, kol hammitzvot shebbattora minnayin? talmud lomar "chukka achat" vegomer, ad kan, im kol ze lamma lo bachar lefaret ella bemitzvat pesach? achen letzad sheyyesh makom lomar sheen hagger chayyav befesach, lefi shello haya lo hu velo avotav bemitzrayim, veen makom lemaase pesach etzlam ki lo pasach Adonai al battehem bemitzrayim. veze dome lemaamaram zichronam livracha sheamru (Bikkurim 1,4) ger mevi veeno kore sheeno yachol lomar vechulei, kemo chen haddavar hazze. laze chiddesh hakkatuv din ze kan veamar vechi yagur ittechem ger veasa fesach, hosif bo tosefet perush, shehagam sheeno mehayyotzim mimmitzrayim, af al pi chen millevad shetztzarich laasot kol hammitzvot, veaf gam zot "veasa fesach" vegomer:

Vedikdek lomar ittechem, lomar shehagam sheattem roim ze chadash mikkarov ba, im kol ze ittechem hu keechad mimmennu, vitziatenu mimmitzrayim hayta geullat olam gam lenefesh hagger, hagam shello haya bannigle haya bannistar, ki shoresh hakkedushsha echad hu, ucheshehayu avotenu bemitzrayim hayta kelalut hakkedushsha tevua betumat mitzrayim, veim chas veshalom haya kelalut hakkedushsha nitba en terufa laanafim, ki hakkol holech achar haikkar, vehatztzalat haikkar nogaat gam laanafim.
