Veamar kechukkat happesach, chash hakkatuv sheyyomar haomer: hen haemet ki aso yaase kol mishpete fesach, aval devarim shehem mammash divre sheker, kemo shettomar lehaggid "avadim hayinu lefaro bemitzrayim vayyotzienu" vegomer vechaddome, adayin dan anochi ki lo yishu bedivre shaker, talmud lomar "kechukkat happesach", ki yachol yuchal dabber kaddevarim haelle, ki hayo haya gam hu bemitzrayim bivchinat hashsharashim. veayyen ma shepperashti befasuk (Shemot 23:9) "veattem yedatem et nefesh hagger".
Veamro ken yaase ba lechova, shello tomar shello ba hakkatuv ella lirshut sheyyachol lomar ken, talmud lomar "ken yaase" chova, umaamar chukka achat ba lehashevot kol hattora kullah:

rashi: Yigar Adonai becha hassatan. yigar hakkadosh baruch hu becha atta hassatan, vechozer veomer veyigar Adonai becha hu habbocher birushalim, shello tikkanes lefanav lekatreg al hatztzaddik hazze. halo rauy hu vezacha lechach shehutztzal meesh hasserefa:
Halo ze ud mutztzal meesh. meforash beaggadat chelek (sanhedrin 93.) shehushlach im achav ben kolaya vachavero laur:
targum: Vaamar Adonai leyachata yezif Adonai bach yachata vizif Adonai bach deitree leashraa shechinteh birushelem hala den ud meshezev mikeda:

rashi: Mi atta har haggadol. sare ever hannahar "tattenay pachat ever nahara ushetar boznay uchenavathon" (Ezra 5:3), shebbittaltem hammelacha ad ko; meatta tihye lifne zerubbavel lemishor, en lachem serara ugedulla od alav:
Vehotzi et haeven harosha. haadrichol yikkach et even habbedil beyado (Zecharya 4:10) lihyot adrichol berosh habbonim, vehem yivnu hakkol kefi devarav asher yetzavve bevinyan nae umefoar:

Teshuot chen chen. yihye lah leotah haeven shehakkol yomru ma nae binyan ze heasuy al yede even hammishkolet hazzot, teshuot chen kemo teshuot noy kemo "teshuot melea ir homiyya" (Yeshayahu 22:2), "kol shaon" (Yeshayahu 66:6) kullam leshon hashemaat kol hem:
targum: Ma at chashiva malchuta tippeshata kodam zerubbavel hala chemeshra veyigle yat meshicheh daamir shemeh milkadmin veyishlot bechol malkevata:

ohc: Vehaya ki telech vegomer vehaya vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar vehaya paam sheniyya. od, kol hakkatuv meyuttar, shehen hen haddevarim hanneemarim bemaamar rishon. veyitbaer lishte hassevarot: lisvarat rabbi eliezer tevat "vehaya" vegomer nimshechet im ma shellemala al ze hadderech – "vehayita lanu leenayim", vehaya kemo chen ki telech immanu techashev bemadrega zo, velo tihye begeder ner lifne chamma ulevana kemaamarcha ledivre rabbi eliezer, uledivre rabbi yehoshua yirtze shettaamod bematztzav ze gadol beenenu.

Veamro vehaya hattov hahu vegomer, perush, ledivre rabbi eliezer sheratza lalechet velachzor, amar elav en nachon lalechet velachzor, ki ani rotze shettehe matzuy beet asher Adonai yitten hattov leammo, kede shennetiv lecha bachelek hayyafe mimmennu, asher lo chen im lo tihye matzuy beet chilluk haaretz. venitratztza al haddavar, ella sheachar zeman kesheraa shennigzera gezera al yisrael lehitakkev bammidbar arbaim shana, halach laasot devaro hattov legayyer bene iro vechazar, venimtza beet hatavat Adonai leyisrael kemaamar moshe. uledivre rabbi yehoshua gam ken nitkavven lomar lo shello yire beene atzmo heyoto ger sheyyihye bemadrega shefela mehaam, kemaamar "ki im el artzi veel moladti" sheyyore shechafetz lalechet bemakom sheyyesh lo makkirin. laze amar lo chen hu, ella vehaya hattov hahu asher yetiv Adonai yihye immanu, perush, im kullanu yachad, shello yachshevuhu bemadrega shefela mehem. veod sheyyihye lecha chelek hattov vehammuvchar shebbachalakim, vehu maamar "vehetavnu lach".

Hamekanne atta li vegomer. lisvarat haomer shehayu mehashshivim, yirtze al ze hadderech: "hamekanne atta bishvil kevodi shello ratzu haanashim lavo lekabbel hannevua mimmenni? mi yitten kol am Adonai neviim velo yihyu mekabbelim hannevua mimmenni ella meAdonai", keillu. vehu maamar ki yitten Adonai et rucho alehem belo emtzaut moshe, ki sham mekor haanava vehechlet heder hahakpada. velisvarat haomer mehappetakin yirtze al ze hadderech: "hamekanne atta li", perush lemaamari sheamarti shivim venibbeu shivim ushenayim, "mi yitten et" vegomer, vehattaam "ki yitten Adonai et" vegomer – perush shehashshivim sheamar Adonai sheyyushpeu merucho shel moshe hu bitchilla kodem shehitchil Adonai lenabbeot et acherim zulat moshe. aval achar sheheetzil Adonai rucho shel moshe venatan lashshivim, huttera nevua lakkol "ki yitten Adonai et rucho alehem", veen kan hachechasha binvuat moshe.

Umaddua yeretem vegomer. perush, chozer Adonai vetoen shehaya lahem leshaer bedatam ki hu omed umeshammesh lifne Adonai, veim haya ose avel lo haya Adonai maskim al yado, emor meatta baAdonai dibbartem shehiskim al yado, vehu amro maddua vegomer beavdi. veamro vemoshe perush, adam shehu muvchan legadol beene Adonai tachsheduhu bedavar megunne. veefshar sheramaz od lahem beamro vemoshe al sheddibberu befanav vehichlimuhu bedivrehem kemaamar razal shekkatavti (Bamidbar 12:1).

Behaarich heanan vegomer. perush, yesapper kan beshevach yisrael sheafilu kol kach nitakkev heanan shana achat yachanu birtzonam, uvehealoto afilu lo yitakkev ella meerev ad boker venaala heanan – nosim. vehishva hakkatuv shenehem, retzon hannesia shehayta lahem beshello haya mitakkev ella layla achat laratzon shehaya lahem linsoa achar shana achat, ki vadday yachpetzu lissa, vehishva hakkatuv ratzon shehaya lahem binsia achar shana achat linsia achar layla achat lachaniyyatam shello hayu katzim beakkavat hachaniyya letzad hazzeman shello haya kol kach aroch kemo chen bachaniyyatam shana achat, vegamar omer hattaam, al pi Adonai shello hayu chafetzim ella laasot maamar Adonai. veamro shamru et mishmeret Adonai perush, hayu mamtinim kashshiur asher yamtin Adonai lissa im meat veim harebe.

Veim tomar im ken lamma hutzrach lehakedim shene pesukim rishonim, pasuk uvehaarich ufasuk veyesh asher yihye vegomer, im lehaggid shivchan shel yisrael hinne hu beyeter shevach begamran shel devarim kemo shepperashnu. hinne im lo kadam maamar uvehaarich heanan al hammishkan vegomer veyesh vegomer lo hayinu mefarshim bemaamar "uvehaarich al hammishkan vegomer al pi Adonai" vegomer kederech shepperashti, ella hayinu omrim shehayu mamtinim bazzeman haaroch vehayu nosim bazzeman hammuat velo echaru velo kadmu, aval yediat haratzon hashshalem kederech shepperashti lo hayinu yodim, ella achar shehikdim shello kadmu velo echaru bappesukim harishonim kederech shepperashnu sheafillu kechoshev lo chashvu lehakedim uleacher, ba hakkatuv veheiranu begamran shel devarim lehavin ma shepperashnu bahem. uma sheamar od al pi Adonai beyad moshe, razal kevar darshu (sifre chelek 1 perek 4) shehaya heanan mitaggel velo haya mizdakkef ad shehaya moshe omer "kuma Adonai" vegomer.

rashi: Ach tov leyisrael elohim. lefi sheinyan hammizmor medabber batztzarot habbaot al ovde hammakom, lechach patach bo kach. vezehu perusho: af al pi sheani tzoek umitmeah al tzarotehem shel yisrael, yadati ki hakkadosh baruch hu tov lahem, uletovatam hu mevi alehem et haraa kede lezakkotam lechayye haolam habba:
targum: Tushebachta al yede deasaf beram tav leyisrael elaha livrire libba:

rashi: Hayta li dimati lechem. mikkan shehatztzara masbaat et haadam, veeno mevakkesh leechol. vechen hu omer bechanna: "vattivke velo tochal" (Shmuel 1 1:7):
targum: Havat li dimati lemivre yemam velele bidyemar li sana kol yoma an hu elahach:

ohc: Veatzalti min haruach vegomer. taam seder ze, lehareoto ki Adonai natan bo koach sheyyachol seet massa kol haam, ucheshemmeen chazar venatal mimmennu ma shetztzarich labbaim laset immo bemassa haam.

Velo tissa atta levaddecha. kan hechlit mimmennu hachazara, perush shehagam sheyyachzor moshe lomar essa levaddi, amar Adonai elav lo tissa atta levaddecha. od ramaz lo shebbeemtzaut haddavar lo tishshaer hannesiut vehammaala lemoshe levaddo, vehu maamar velo tissa leshon nesiut rosh – lo tihye levaddecha kevattechilla. shuv ba leyadi maamar chazal (Bamidbar Rabba 95) veze leshonam: amar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe, ani natatti lecha bina vadaat lefarnes et banay vetityached atta beotah gedulla, achshav mishshellecha hem notlim, ad kan. od yitbaer lisvarat haomrim (sanhedrin 17.) "velo yasafu" – lo pasku, uvaze velo tissa leshon nevua, keamro (Malachi 1:1) "massa devar Adonai", perush lo tihye atta navi levaddecha ella yihyu kol hazzekenim neviim gam ken.

rashi: Al ken vegomer. davuk hu lammikra shel acharav:
targum: Metul hechna la yizkun rashie beyoma rabba vechayavin besiat tzadikaya:

ohc: Vayyishshaaru shene anashim vegomer. tzarich ladaat: 1 kavvanat maamar "vayyishshaaru" minnayin nisharu. 2 lamma hutzrach lehazekir shemam. 3 amro vattanach alehem vegomer, mimma nafshach – im hem mehashshivim hare kevar hizkiram hakkatuv bichlal hashshivim, dichtiv "vayyatzel vegomer vayyitten al shivim", ki meamro "vattanach" mashma davar chadash shello huzkar ad atta, veim enam mehashshivim halo lo amar Adonai el moshe ella shivim. 4 amro vehemma bakketuvim en yadua hakkavvana baze. Adonai amro velo yatzu halo meamro "vayyishshaaru bammachane" muvan haddavar shello yatzu. 6 amro vayyitnabbeu levassof shehaya lo lehasemich hannimshach lahem bifne atzmo vehannaase mehem bifne atzmo al ze hadderech: "vayyishshaaru shene anashim vegomer vehemma bakketuvim velo yatzu haohela vattanach alehem haruach vayyitnabbeu", velamma katav haddevarim shello kasseder hannachon?

Verazal nechleku (sifre Bamidbar 95:) minnayin nisharu. yesh omrim nisharu mehashshivim ushenayim shebberar moshe miyyisrael, shishsha mikkol shevet beshave, vehigril lehotzi hashshenayim hayyeterim al hashshivim sheamar lo Adonai, vehem hashshenayim shennisharu. verabbi shimon amar ki mehashshivim nisharu shello ratzu likkanes leohel moed letzad anava veshiflut venisharu bammachane, ad kan. lisvarat haomer mehashshivim nisharu yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: "vayyishshaaru shene anashim bammachane" letzad chashvam atzman keshirayim. shem haechad vegomer, perush yeduim hayu bemiddot yesharot umuchezakim beene yisrael, shellesibba zo nisharu bammachane, shezzulat ze yesh laam lerannen acharehem shemmaasu chas veshalom benachat haruach alehem venimtzeu mechallelim hashshem veyimasem elyon lesibba zo. ella letzad sheshshem haechad hammeyuchad eldad veshem hashsheni lo medad, laze lo danu bahem hammaase lehara, uvaze lo nimasu. vattanach alehem haruach atzmah shennacha al hashshivim, lo menaattam haharchaka shehayta ben ohel moed uven hammachane venacha gam alehem. vedikdek lomar vattanach, lomar sheshsham kanta mekomah haruach, keamram sheshshear hashshivim pasku veellu lo pasku nevua mehem. vekodem shehizkir hannevua hizkir devarim shebbahem yatzdiku haam ki divre nevua befihem emet, veamar vehemma bakketuvim perush meotam hashshivim shennichtevu. uchede shello tachshov shehakketuvim hem shennichtevu befitke haggoralot, laze amar "velo yatzu haohela", ha lamadta shehayu yecholin latzet. uvaze neemnu divrehem shehayu nevua, vehu amro vayyitnabbeu. vezulat hattenay hannizkar mi yachzik divrehem ledivre neviut. uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim.

Uledivre haomer mehashshivim ushenayim nisharu, yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech: vayyishshaaru perush, hagam shennisharu shene haanashim shehayu yeterim al hashshivim bammachane, shem haechad vegomer, af al pi chen "vattanach alehem haruach" gam ken, millevad shennacha al hashshivim kemo sheamar lemala "vayyatzel min haruach vegomer vayyitten al shivim ish". viduyyak al nachon lamma hutzrach lomar "vattanach alehem haruach", letzad shello hizkir befasuk rishon shennatan haruach ella al hashshivim, hodiacha Adonai sheggam nacha al hashshenayim. veamar vehemma bakketuvim vegomer, ba latet taam lehatzedakat nevuatam kemo shepperashti lemala, veamar "vehemma bakketuvim" perush, bappetakim shekkatav moshe shivim ushenayim zaken. umeatta hare reuyim hem linvua kayyotze bashshivim veyachol lihyot sheyyitnabbeu. uchede shello tavin shehemma bakketuvim shebbau haohela, laze berer hakkatuv veamar "velo yatzu" bappetakin lavo haohela.

Vederech derash, ulay sheyyodia hakkatuv shehashshenayim shello yatzu bappetakin nichlemu venichnesu bammachane, ma shello asu chen kol yisrael sheyyatzu kullam leohel moed, vehashshenayim nechbeu vammachane. vayyar Adonai bashtam uchelimatam "vayyitnabbeu", vehu amro vehemma bakketuvim shehen happetakin, umittaam ze velo yatzu mehammachane, vachananam Adonai umille taavatam "vayyitnabbeu".

Lamma niggara vegomer. tzarich ladaat taanat haanashim bemaamar "lamma niggara", halo tamam befihem yaanu "anachnu temeim", uma mevakshim litten lahem tora chadasha. veulay ki letzad shennitmeu birshuto yitbarach, ben leman deamar temee met mitzva ben leman deamar nose arono shel yosef, chashvu ki yadin Adonai otam kattehorim, ucheshem shemmatzinu (fesachim oz.) sheyyitratztze Adonai asot happesach betumea betzibbur, laze taanu lamma niggara, vechi bishvil sheasu mitzva yihyu nigraim mikkarban pesach? o yirtze lomar sheyyaasu lappesach tashlumin kachagiga sheyyesh lah tashlumin kol shiva, sheamru (chagiga 9.) chogeg veholech kol haregel, kemo chen yetzav Adonai lahem sheyyaasu pesach lemachar, vehu maamar bemoado shehu moed happesach.
Veulay ki laze dikdek hakkatuv lomar bayyom hahu, perush, ledivre haomer yom shevii shel tumatam haya, laze bau bayyom hahu kede sheyyomar lahem laasoto tashlumin lemachar.

Ulederech ze anu marvichim taam she amar mitzva zo shel pesach sheni achar sheshshaalu haanashim hahemma, lomar shehagam sheyyihyu tehorim betoch yeme happesach kanniddon shellefanenu, af al pi chen en lo tashlumin laasoto beshivat yeme happesach kachagiga ella bachodesh hashsheni.

Od yirtze amro lamma niggara, perush: kevan shehaya yom shevii letumatam, toanim sheyyecholin lishchot alehem pischehem kederech sheshshochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz, kevan shehem nitharim laerev veen lahem tuma ella bayyom hahu, vehu maamar bayyom hahu, verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru inyanim acherim, veellu vaellu divre elohim chayyim.

rashi: Ki mi vaz leyom. sheyyussad habbayit asher huktan beenehem, kemo shenneemar (Ezra 3:12) "verabbim mehakkohanim asher rau habbayit harishon beyasdo ze habbayit beenehem bochim bekol gadol", uvinvuat chaggay (Chagai 2:3) "halo chemohu keayin beenehem". vesamchu atta kesheyyiru et haeven habbedil hatteluya bechut hammishkolet beyad adrichal rosh habbonim, shemmechavven bah rosh happinna. vezo tihye beyad zerubbavel.
Shiva elle. al echad shiva bayyesod harishon shebbime koresh, vechen tirgem yonatan: "shiva nidbachin keillen":
Ene Adonai hemma meshottim. velo nire laasot ken, vehu raa et zerubbavel ze hagun laddavar:
targum: Are man hu dechi devasar yoma den al binyana dehu zeer hala yetuv veyechde kad yecheze yat even mashkolta vida dizrubbavel shava nidbechin keilen kodam Adonai gelan ovade bene enasha bechol ara:

ohc: Shimu na devaray. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar ken, vadday ki yishmeu et asher yedabber. od tzarich ladaat amro tevat na, ki lo yutzdak lomar haadon leavdo leshon bakkasha.

Achen yitkavven Adonai benoam amarav leharegisham bimniat hashshemia shekkodem lachen, ki atta hem reuyim lishmoa velo kodem letzad tumatam ledivrehem zichronam livracha. umimmotza davar atta yodea ki en nachon leeved sheyyihye meshullal hahachana beet asher adono yetzavve alav, veozen millin tivchan ki muchrach moshe bemaasav lifrosh meishto. ulederech ze hirvachnu terutz lekushya rishona, lamma lo natan Adonai taam happerishut bidvarav lahem ki hu haikkar hatztzarich lehashemiam, ulefi ze Adonai natan omer hamevasser tzava rav.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: shimu na, perush atta attem shomim letzad hahechreach leyasserchem ulehochichachem, veen ledabber lachem devarim ellu al yede moshe mishshene teamim: 1 ki hu nogea baddavar vealav bau haddevarim, veod mehattaam atzmo haamur bainyan shekkara Adonai leaharon umiryam ledabber immahem shello bifne moshe, aval kodem veachar kach en ani medabber immachem, vezo setira lemaamaram sheggam bahem dibber. vetimtza sheamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 14,19) shebbechol hammekomot sheamar hakkatuv "vaydabber Adonai el moshe veel aharon" en hakkavvana bedibbur gam im aharon ella lemoshe sheyyomar leaharon, vehem haddevarim sheramaz Adonai betevat "na".

Vedikdek lomar devaray, velo hispik lomar "shimu na" umuvan shemma sheyyishmeu hem devarav, nitkavven ken hagam shehayu mitnabbeim kodem, lo haya keseder ze sheyyishmeu haddevarim mippi el elyon, uchemo shepperesh Adonai devarav besamuch "im yihye neviachem Adonai" vegomer:
Od efshar sheramaz lahem shello yedabber immahem od ella atta, leval yachshevu bedatam ki huchsheru linvua elyona kazot vehaya chaze yom machar, laze amar atta.

Od yirtze bemaamar na, letzad shehayu temee keri, uvedine taharat tuma amra tora (Vayikra 22:6) sheen hattevila gomeret hattahara leechol bitruma ad haarev shemesh, veinyan hannevua kevan shemmatzinu ki tzarich haatzalat haruach hakkedosha kede sheyyucheshar lidvar Adonai immo, lo yaspik taharat mayim ad bo hashshemesh vetaher, shello yihye ze garua mittahara hatztzericha laachilat teruma. vechan matzinu shebbayyom atzmo shehayu temeim tumeat keri samuch litvilatam dibber Adonai immahem. laze amar Adonai shimu na devaray, perush, atta davka horaat shaa hi sheashmiachem devaray hagam sheadayin tzerichin haarev shemesh, lekayyem ma shenneemar (Bereshit Rabba 55:11) ahava mekalkelet hashshura, ahavat Adonai im moshe yedido lo yachol lehitappek ad lemachar.

Im yihye neviachem vegomer. velo dibber lenocheach alehem "im tihyu neviim", letzad shehem hizkiru betaanatam neviim acherim chutz mehem, uchemaamar hammidrash (sifre) sheamru: halo dibber gam im avraham velo peresh vechulei, laze ba devaro yitbarach laasot hefresh gam mehannirmaz bedivrehem lemoshe. veulay ki laze amar leshon yachid "im yihye".

Adonai bammara elav vegomer. ba lehodienu hefresh haderagat hanneviim mehaderagat moshe, uletzad sheyyesh shelosha devarim beinyan hannevua: 1 hassagat hammare, 2 zeman hassagatah, perush im yitnabbe bechol et sheyyirtze o en haddavar taluy birtzono ella bizman sheyyachpotz Adonai, 3 hassagat bechinat haddibbur kaasher avaer.

Vehitchil Adonai lomar bivchinat haderagat hassagat hariyya, veamar Adonai bammara elav etvadda, perush lefi sheyyesh shalosh haderagot kelaliyyot behakkarat Adonai: haachat lo hissigah adam binvua, vehu ma sheshshaal moshe (Shemot 33:18) "hareeni na et kevodecha", perush "na" – atta, ma sheatta atid lehareoteni leachar mita, ki yodea haya moshe hammussag latztzaddikim baolam haelyon, veheshivo Adonai "lo tuchal vegomer ki lo yirani haadam vachay" ella leachar mita. vehaderaga zo hi beatzmut oro yitbarach, vahagam shello yityaches elav maamar atzmut ella leshakkech ozen vechulei. haderaga sheniyya hi or hammeir mimmennu yitbarach sheyyityaches elav temuna, veen temuna zo doma leshum temuna mehahovim bannimtza, ki en lo temuna ella temuna lenelam meene chol chay sheen lah makkir zulat moshe asher hikkirah lo Adonai, dichtiv "utemunat Adonai yabbit", ma shello hissig zulato bechol hanneviim. haderaga shelishit hi havehakat oro yitbarach berichuk, ha lema ze dome – lener daluk asher yelech oro lemerachok veyire adam haor hahu, veze yikkare "mara", veze hu hassagat hanneviim zulat moshe, vehu maamar Adonai "bammara" vehaven, uchenegdah amar bemoshe "utemunat Adonai yabbit".

Ucheneged zeman hassagat hannevua amar elav etvadda, perush afillu madrega ketanna kazo enah etzlo bitmidut beet asher yachpotz yassigenna, ella kesheani rotze etvadda lo bah, uchesheyyachpotz hu lehassigah eno muvtach sheyyassigenna bechol et, kemo shehu muvtach moshe bechol et asher yachpotz dichtiv (Bamidbar 9:8) "imdu veeshmea ma yetzavve Adonai" belo shum safek baddavar. nimtzeta omer kol hanneviim en nevua betucha etzlam hagam shehi madrega ketanna mimmadregat moshe, umoshe nevuato hagam shehi gedola mehem, betucha etzlo bechol et sheyyirtze, vehu maamar bechol beti neeman hu, perush kanneeman hazze shehakkol beyado uvirshuto laasot kol asher yachpotz kemo chen moshe. vedikdek lomar bechol beti lichlol afillu behassagat nevua haggedola haddavar birshuto lehitnabbe, ma shello haya nishma im haya omer "beveti neeman hu", shehayiti omer sheen haddavar masur lecheftzo ella madrega hakketanna shel kol hanneviim, vehahefresh hu shehem en haddavar birshutam ma sheen ken hu, talmud lomar "bechol" vegomer.

Ucheneged hassagat bechinat haddibbur amar bachalom adabber bo, perush da ki shete middot behodaat hachalomot: ha – kesheyyishma haddevarim tihye dato meurbevet velo tivchan azno millin lehasekil hannidbar ki dato mevulbelet, 2 – kol hannidbar bachalom en haddevarim kifshatan ella mashal vedimyon. vetze ulemad mechalomot hakketuvim battora ufitronehem. vehu ma sheamar Adonai ki hanneviim beet bo devaro hattov lahem yitbalbel datam veyihyu keadam hashshochev belev yam veyithollu, gam lo yavo lahem haddibbur betzurato ella melubbash toch dimyon umashal kede sheyyuchelu seet haddibbur veaf al pi chen mithollim. uferush tevat bachalom hu begeder chalom beechut umahut, uleolam behakitz haya Adonai nigle el avadav hanneviim, ella keshehaya ba lahem haddibbur hayu mekabbelim oto kitchunat hachalom kannizkar vehayu noflim laaretz umittarefet datam mealehem, ma sheen ken moshe shehaya meshullal mizze, shello hayta dato mishtannet bevo devar Adonai vehaya shomea bedaat shelema, gam lo hayu baim elav haddevarim bederech mashal umelitza ella devarim mevoarim uverurim veenan tzerichin pitron. vehu maamar Adonai pe el pe adabber bo, perush, hinne ene chol yisrael root hachamishshim veshalosh parashiyyot asher dibber Adonai el moshe, shekkullan hem devarim sheyyavin peshatan shel devarim kol mevin leshon hakkodesh. gam otzrot chachma asher atzar Adonai bahem kullam nechochim lammevin habba leayyen ulehaamik, yargish bemashmaut hakketuvim atzman et asher chashav Adonai lomar bahem. veen derech ze baddevarim asher dibber Adonai beyad avadav hanneviim yirmeya vishaya, shekkullan mashal umelitza, kemaamar (Yechezkel 17:3) "hannesher haggadol baal hakkenafayim" vegomer, uveyoter mehemma nevuat zecharya hammesagger shaare hannevua asher sagar gam nevuato veen ittanu yodea kavvanat nevuato.

Veyesh lachkor zot, kevan shehammenabbe hu Adonai elohenu echad, lamma laze yedabber nechochot velaze devaro meukkashim. veamru anshe emet bema shekkadam lanu hayedia bidvar hammalach ledaniyyel, hahergesh shehaya poel bo, mizze taskil lirot ki harekavat min haenoshi tafsidenna haregashat haruchani, veenah yechola lisbol zulat hammurkav asher konen Adonai bechachmato hanniflaa sheyyuchelu shittuf yachad hannefesh vehagguf. vahalo tire afillu bammekorot hannirgashot venitpasot esh umayim ze mechalle et ze, zulat hashshamayim asher konnu yede yotzer. umizze teshaer ech yuchal amod bidvar elohim mekor haruchaniyyot veyachtzov kolo lehavat esh ech yuchal amod. velaze en adam massig laamod bechocho lishmoa kol elohim chayyim, zulat haish asher hafach chamro vaasao tzura kemo sherashamnu bimkomot acherim, shezze en lo guf veyachol seet devar melech. velachen behinnave Adonai leadam sheen gufo dome letzurato, yitchakkem Adonai asot al ze haofen, ki yetze devar melech mippi elyon vehaddibbur yitattef baavirim dakkim veachar kach yaggia leozen navi, uvaze yisbelennu hannavi. veaf gam ze yafil hergesh banneviim lehishtaggea, vedavar ze yesovev bo haddevarim derech mashal umelitza bivchinat hachalom. velaze kol hanneviim levad mimmoshe yedabberu meshalim umelitzot, veyoter mehemma zecharya shehaya acharon binviut haya haddibbur ba veniglad veniglam beyoter mishshear nevuot kede sheyyuchal lisbol, velaze nitrabbu bo hammelitzot veomek haddimyon ad sheen dorot acharonim yodim devarav.

Vehu ma shehodia Adonai kan bivchinat hammussag lemoshe, veamar pe el pe, perush, lo haya haddibbur nifsak mippi el elyon lefi moshe laavor baavir haolam, sheyyishtanne haddibbur behalebashat haavirim visovev ledabber divre meshalim vechidot, gam shalal hahitraggeshut asher tikre lanneviim kemaamar umare, perush, lo yeradem velo yitbahel, ella "umare", perush, baet uvashshaa atzmah sheani medabber bo pe el pe eno keseder hachalom, ella "umare", sheani mare lo or hammenabbe umabbit, veze yaggid haheara vehitkonnut hassechel.

Veamro velo vechidot, hu lehair betoledet haddavar ki letzad shehaya medabber pe el pe, baze haya gam ken haddibbur yotze belo chidot. vedikdek lomar el pe velo laozen, hammaskil al devar navi sheamar (Melachim 1 3:9) "lev shomea", yeda sod haddavar. vezo hi haderagat nevua sheen lemala mimmenna, sheyyikshor Adonai nefesh navi bammakor hammenabbe vishalshel hannevua pe el pe. uvaze gam ken tavin amro adabber bo velo amar itto o immo ella bo, vehaven. od nitkavven lehasekilcha shello haya haddibbur ella mippi Adonai lefi moshe velo haya roe pene olam, vehu maamar "bo".

Bi adoni al na tashet vegomer. hinne middivre aharon mashma ki moshe hikpid al divrehem, asher al ken mechalle panav sheyyimchol lahem chattatam. venire ki tamo shel aharon hu sheddan bemoshe din chacham, shekkefi haddin (kiddushin lev:) chacham shemmachal al kevodo kevodo machul, velaze amad bedato sheim yimchol sar hannega. veamar al na tashet vegomer, perush, hagam shehikpadta al haddevarim ad shebba haonesh, atta shebba haonesh yechuppar heavon velo tashet od alenu chattat. veachar haemet lo chen hu, ki moshe lo hikpid al haddavar, velaze nitchakkem hakkatuv vesamuch ledabberam bo amar "vehaish moshe anav meod", nitkavven lishlol divre aharon kan.

Vetaam haonesh hu lishte sibbot: haachat sheyyesh lanu ladun bemoshe mishpat melech, shekken ketiv (Devarim 33:5) "vayhi vishurun melech", umelech shemmachal al kevodo en kevodo machul (sham), veulay ki laze gam ken nitkavven Adonai bemaamaro lahem maddua lo yeretem ledabber beavdi, ki laAdonai hammelucha veeved melech melech (shavuot 47:).

Vesibba sheniyya: lefi ma shepperashti shehikpid Adonai al shechashdu sheasa moshe avel chas veshalom, vehiskim Adonai al yado velo hochicho, im ken millin letzad illaa hem, velaze heenisham hagam sheen kan hakepadat moshe, vehitzdik moshe ki lo hu hassovev behakepadato shehutzrach lehitpallel laAdonai, veaf al pi chen lo hoil lerappeot ad avor shivat yamim, veim haya haddavar bo lo haya tzarich litfilla ella yimchol vesar hannega. ha lamadta shehaonesh ba leechad mishshene hatteamim, o lishnehem yachad, veefshar sheim haya moshe makpid bedabberam haya haonesh beofen acher kaful umechuppal lahem chas veshalom.

Asher noalnu vaasher vegomer. hakkavvana bishne inyanim, hu al pi ma shepperashti betaromet Adonai alehem shehikpid al shehishvu nevuatam linvuat moshe, vehikpid al shennagu bichvod moshe lomar lo tov asa. laze amar keneged hashevaat nevuatam linvuato amar asher noalnu ki dibberu divre shetut baze, ucheneged ma sheamru alav lo tov asa amar vaasher chatanu.

rashi: Livne korach. assir veelkana vaaviasaf (Shemot 6:24) hem hayu techilla baatzat avihem, uvishat hammachaloket parshu. ucheshennivleu kol sevivotehem ufatcha haaretz et piha, nishar mekomam betoch pi haaretz, keinyan shenneemar "uvene korach lo metu" (Bamidbar 26:11). vesham amru shira, vesham yissedu hammizmorim hallalu, vealu mishsham, vesharta alehem ruach hakkodesh venitnabbeu al haggaluyyot veal churban habbayit veal malchut bet david:
targum: Leshabbacha besichla tava al yedehon divne korach:

ohc: Vayyered Adonai vegomer vaydabber elav. tzarich ladaat ma dibber Adonai elav. od tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lechol ze velo nibba otam mibbeli kol seder hammuchan. veyitbaer hainyan al pi maamaram zichronam livracha besefer hazzohar (pinchas 220.) befasuk "lachen emor hinni noten lo et beriti shalom", ki yetzav Adonai al moshe sheyyomar "hinni noten" vegomer, vehattaam mippene shezzacha kevar moshe bivrit hashshalom veshello yechashev, uchesheratza litteno lefinchas nimtza shekkevar netano lemoshe vezacha bo, veen hakkadosh baruch hu chozer venotel mattenotav. kemo chen hannevua natan lemoshe lemana, vechol habba lehitnabbe moshe hu hannoten mehattaam hannizkar, velaze yikkare adon hanneviim. vehu maamar Adonai kan shetztzivva leesof hazzekenim vehu immahem, vayyered Adonai beanan. veamro vaydabber elav perush leshon serara umemshala, kederech amro (tehillim 47:4) "yadber ammim tachtenu", sheasa Adonai hasserara bedavar ze elav, perush lemoshe, uvirshuto uvirtzono heetzil vegomer.

Vayyatzel min haruach. amro vayyatzel, ulay sheromez limkor ruach hannevua shebbivchina zo, uvederech ze yutzdak lemor vayyatzel, veamro min haruach asher alav, perush meotah habbechina shealav, aval hanneetzal ba mehammaatzil baruch hu velo sheyyotzi mimmoshe velitten al acherim. o yomar min haruach asher al moshe veamar vayyatzel letzad sheen hevdel laruach sheodennu alav laruach hannittan mimmennu lazzekenim. ulederech ze yechavven bemaamar asher alav al hachelek hanneetzal beatzmo sheodennu alav achar vayyatzel. uledivre hammidrash (Bamidbar Rabba 15,19) keshemmana hammaalot shehayu lashshenayim yoter mehashshivim, mana gam ken shehashshivim nevuatam mishshel moshe vehashshenayim mishshel hakkadosh baruch hu.

Vayhi kenoach. amar vayhi leshon tzaar, ledivrehem zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 19), shehazzekenim hitnabbeu maamar "hitkaddeshu lemachar", en lecha tzaar gadol mizze sheamru leyisrael bitchillat nevuatam yachinu atzman lefuranut.

Veamro "vayyitnabbeu" betosefet vav, lomar shemmillevad shehayu keli muchshar lanuach alehem haruach, od lahem shehitnabbeu. vehodia hakkatuv shennevuatam hayta techef umiyyad, keamro "kenoach alehem vegomer vayyitnabbeu". od yitbaer al pi sevarat haomrim "velo yasafu" shello nitnabbeu ella oto yom, al ze hadderech "vayhi kenoach" vegomer leshon tzaar kannizkar, veod tzaar acher lahem shehitnabbeu velo yasafu.

rashi: Yomru geule Adonai. kesheyyifdem miyyad tzar :
targum: Yemrun parikaya dayya di farkinun min yad meika:

rashi: Hodu laAdonai:
targum: Shabbachu kodam Adonai arum tav arum laalam tuveh:

rashi: Atta vereecha. chananya mishael vaazarya hayu (sanhedrin 93.):
Anshe mofet. "guvrin kashrin lemeavad lehon nissin", sheaf lahem naasa nes (sanhedrin 93.)

Ki hinni mevi et avdi tzemach. ki atta zerubbavel pachat yehuda katan bachatzar hammelech, ani matzmiach lo gedulla veshem. netattiv lechen beene hammelech lemallovt sheelato bevinyan habbayit vehair, kemo shemmeforash beezra divre nechemya ben chachalya, vehu zerubbavel, kedaamrinan besanhedrin (sanhedrin lach.):
targum: Shema kean yehoshua kahana rabba at vechavrach deyatvin kodamach are gavrin kashrin lemebad lehon nisin inun are ha ana mayte yat avdi meshicha veyitgele:

rashi: Zeramtam shena yihyu. achshav chataftam leotam hashshanim vahavetam leyamim muatim, sheenam ella keshenat tenuma; sheshshene haddorot shivim shana hem, kemo shemmeforash besof hainyan: yeme shenotenu vahem shivim shana, vehem chashuvim shena achat; keinyan (tehillim 126:1) "beshuv Adonai et shivat tziyyon hayinu kecholmim", veal shivim shana shel galut bavel neemar:
Zeramtam. leshon shetifa, kemo "zerem mayim" (Chavakuk 3:10):
Babboker kechatzir yachalof. hannolad ballayla met babboker, lesof hashshena; veim
targum: Vein la tayvin tete alehon mota hech demachin yehon ulealma deati hech isba demitparcha yitchalfun:

ohc: Lo uchal anochi levaddi vegomer. kan hechlit haratzon, ki lo taromet levad hu mitraem aval yaskim laset, ella gilla dato uretzono sheeno rotze lissa levaddo, venatan hattaam lo chas veshalom shemmemaen asot maamar Adonai ella sheshshier shehu massa kaved mimmennu velo yuchal seeto:

rashi: Has kol basar. kol shear haovde kochavim umazzalot:
Ki neor. leshon heara vehakkatza (tehillim 35:23):
targum: Safu chol rashiaya min kodam Adonai are itgele mimdor kudesheh:

rashi: Beterem harim yulladu. nivreu, uveterem cholalta eretz vetevel. umeolam rishon vead olam acharon atta el:
targum: Kad itgele kodamach deamach atidin lemechov atkenta tetuva ad dela turaya itnatalu veitberiat ara veyatve tevel min alma haden ad alma deate at hu elaha:

ohc: Ulefi healot. amar vav bitchillat inyan, lomar ki inyan heanan asher al hammishkan haya meshammesh shene devarim: echad hu lemichse al haohel lechavod uletifaret, vehu maamar kissa heanan et hammishkan leohel (al) haedut, vehosif od veamar ulefi vegomer, perush veod haya heanan letzorech ze, shellefi healoto yisu bene yisrael kede sheyyedu zeman hannesia uzeman hachaniyya.

Veachare chen yisu vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma hu amro veachare chen vegomer, shehaya tzarich laasot gezera bammaamar al ze hadderech: "ulefi healot vegomer yisu", keshiur maamar hassamuch "uvimkom asher yishkan vegomer sham yachanu". venire sheim haya omer "achare chen yisu" haya nishma shezze hu gezerat hakkatuv, velo chen hu hakkavvana, ella shehaggezera hu bammaamar habba achar kach al pi Adonai vegomer, veze hu shiur hakkatuv ulefi healot vegomer, veachare chen hu sheyyihyu nosim vegomer, vechevan shekken al pi Adonai vegomer, hare hem nosim al pi Adonai.

Od nitkavven lomar bederech ze, shezzulat ken im haya omer "achare chen yisu", hayta haggezera betevat "achare chen", vehaya hammashmaut shello hayu nosim kodem ella achare chen, veen bannishma shehayu al kol panim nosim keshehaya nosea heanan. laze amar veachare chen kede shettihye nirdefet lemala vetavo haggezera bemaamar "yisu bene yisrael", keillu amar "ulefi healot vegomer yisu". veim haya omer beseder ze "ulefi healot vegomer yisu", az haya nishma shebbaaloto hu shemmitchayyevim lissoa, veen bammuvan sheim yirtzu lissoa shettimnaem meniat aliyyat heanan, laze amar "ulefi healot vegomer veachare chen" lomar velo kodem.

rashi: Ushenayim zetim aleha. etzlah shene ilanot shehazzetim gedelim bahem:

Echad mimin haggulla veechad missemolah vegomer. vechan lo perash al shene tzanterot zahav haamurot lematta bapparasha, vehem kemin arevot vaadashim shel bet habbad, shehem omdim etzel hazzetim, vehazzetim nechbatim mealehem letoch hatztzanterot umitchammemot sham kevammaatan veneetzarim sham bevet habbad, vehashshemen nofel letoch hatztzanterot umehatztzanterot letoch haggulla, umehaggulla el hammutzakot, umehammutzakot el hannerot. vehammutzakot vehannerot arbaim vetesha hayu, remez laor shelleatid lavo, or hachamma yihye shivatayim keor shel shivat yamim (yeshaya 30:26), arbaim vetesha al or shel yom bereshit:
targum: Vetarten zetin daalah chad mimin guleta vechad al semalta:

rashi: Vegulla al roshah. kemo (Yehoshua 15:19) gullot illit, leshon mayan, kemin sefel gadol agol:
Veshiva neroteha. kemin bazichin shennotnin hashshemen vehappetila letochah:
Shiva veshiva mutzakot. lechol ner vaner bain shiva tzinnorot ketannim, shehashshemen zav min haggulla derech otan mutzakot lechol ner vaner:
targum: Vaamar li ma at chaze vaamaret chazeti veha menarta dedahava chulah veguletah al resha veshava votzinaha daalah shava veshava dimrikin minhon mishcha levotzinaya deal reshah:

ohc: Al pi Adonai yisu bene yisrael vegomer. veheanan yaggid asher pi Adonai yikkovennu.

Kol yeme vegomer uvehaarich vegomer. ba hakkatuv lesadder kol bechinot hanehagot heanan, ulelammed shivchan shel yisrael shehayu chafetzim baasher yachpotz Adonai. vehitchil beinyan arichut zeman hachaniyya veamar kol yeme asher yishkon heanan yachanu, perush yachanu – yachpetzu lachanot, velaze lo amar chanu bene yisrael sheyyihye nishma sheasu letzad hahechreach mehammanhig, vehosif lomar uvehaarich vegomer lomar sheafillu yaarich kol kach yamim rabbim af al pi chen yachanu, veamro veshamru vegomer lomar ki millevad shehayu chonim kol zeman vechulei od modia ki lo hayu osim haddavar letzad shehayu chafetzim beshevet velo behilluch ella letzad shemirat devar Adonai, vehu amro veshamru vegomer hagam shehem yamim rabbim. veamro velo yissau velo amar velo nasu, lishlol bechinat hachoshev keillu amar velo yachpetzu lissa.

rashi: Ki elef shanim beenecha. elef shanim shel bene adam hem keyom echad shel hakkadosh baruch hu veod min hallayla immo, ki yom echad shel hakkadosh baruch hu umeat min hallayla shel hakkadosh baruch hu hem elef shanim, shehare lo amar hakkatuv sheyyehe yomo shel hakkadosh baruch hu echad keelef shanim, aval kesheyyatza meat min hallayla immo az yomo shalem vahave elef shanim, ulechach met adam harishon toch elef, sheim haya chay elef haya yoter miyyomo shel hakkadosh baruch hu. veshemma shiur otah ashmura hu kemo sheyyesh mimmitat adam harishon ad elef shanim, vaanan lo yadinan kamma have otah ashmura ki im missevara (matzati). ki elef shanim beenecha vegomer. ucheshealta teshuva bedatecha mittechilla yafe danta uvarata otah, ureuyin hayu hashshanim lechach lefi (shello) hayu yeme bene adam rabbim shello hayu elef shanim beenecha ella keyom holech sheavar vechalaf umeat min hallayla immo, shehare amarta leadam harishon (Bereshit 2:17) "ki beyom achalcha mimmennu mot tamut" vechaya tesha meot usheloshim shana, nimtzeu elef shanim olim leyom shalem umeat min hallayla immo:
Keyom etmol ki yaavor. shekkevar avar:
targum: Arum alaf shenin beenach mitchashvin kodamach hech yoma deitmale arum yebar vehech matrat lelya:

rashi: Babboker yatzitz. miyyad chalaf, vead bo haerev yemolel veyavesh, lamma?
targum: Damyan ovadehon hech isba di vetzafra yenitz veyasge leramsha mitmolel umityabbesh min chureba:

rashi: Ki hinne haeven. yesod habbayit asher yesadtem bime koresh uvatlu al yedechem, veoto hayyesod veovi hachoma haya meat beenechem, kemo shemforash beezra (Ezra 3:12) uvinvuat chaggay (Chagai 2:3):

Al even achat shiva enayim. sofo leharechiv al echad shiva, vechen tirgem yonatan "al avna chada shiva enin chazyan lah", uleshon enayim leshon marot. veli nire: shiva enayim al shem ene hakkadosh baruch hu, shebbeenav uvelibbo lehosif alav al echad shiva, lefi sheddugmato binvua zo "verau et haeven habbedil beyad zerubbavel shiva elle ene Adonai hemma meshottim vegomer" (Zecharya 4:10). ella limmed, shennatan enav leharebot kevod habbayit bevinyano:
Hinni mefatteach pittuchah. mattir kishshureha, mefir atzat haoyvim asher katvu sitna levattel hammelacha (Ezra 4:6):
Umashti. vahasiroti:
Beyom echad. lo yadati eze yom. [tosefet: beyom asher hitchilu lehosif al habbinyan yamish avon haaretz vetihye beracha beferotav, ki achshav meera kemo shenneemar binvuat chaggay (Chagai 2:16)]:
targum: Are ha avna dihavet kodam yehoshua al avna chada shava aynin chezyan lah ha ana gale chezyataha amar Adonai tzevaot veaday yat chov ara hahi beyoma chad:

ohc: Ase lecha vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lachatzotzrot lemassa hammachanot, halo ene chol yisrael al heanan uchesheyyiruhu nosea nosim? veulay ki letzad shello hayu nosim yachad, ella yakdim degel yehuda veacharav bene gershon nose hammishkan veacharav degel reuven vechulei, laze haya tzarich lachatzotzrot kede shekkol echad yeda hazzeman bediyyuk sheyyissa bo baze achar ze. od nire bedikduk od amro tevat lecha shello haya tzarich lomar, veyitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha shekkatavnu besamuch shello haya mizdakkef heanan ad shehaya moshe omer lo "kuma" vegomer, vehaya haddavar taluy beyad moshe. umeatta nuchal lomar gam ken sheyyetzav Adonai shekkemo chen tihye nesiat yisrael al pi moshe lichvodo shel moshe, kederech shechalak lo kavod lemassa heanan shello yissa ad sheyyomar lo "kuma", vehu ma sheramaz bemaamar lecha, perush lirshutecha ulemaamarcha. verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (sifre kan) "ase lecha" – mishshellecha, gam darshu (Bamidbar Rabba 15,15) "lecha" – atta meshammesh velo acher yachol lehishtammesh bahem, veshivim panim lattora.

rashi: Vayyaad. leshon hateraa, kemo veaida vam et hashshamayim vegomer (Devarim 31:28):
targum: Veashed malacha dayya bihoshua lememar:

ohc: Vayyaas ken vegomer kaasher vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar el mul pene vegomer, velo hispik bemaamar "vayyaas ken" vegomer. od chazar lomar kaasher tzivva vegomer, vehu hammaamar atzmo sheamar "vayyaas ken" vegomer. yechavven lomar al ze hadderech: amro vayyaas ken keneged peruk hannerot vekinnucham kede shettihye kachadasha, shebbaze yutzdak hachinnuch kemo sheamarnu. veamro el mul pene vegomer keneged seder hannachatan sheyyihyu pifiyyotehem el mul pene vegomer. veamro kaasher tzivva letzad shehaddibbur haya bayyom, uva lomar sheaz bizman shennitztavva asa maase haamur. laze amar kaasher vegomer, lomar sheasa bizman shetztzivva Adonai shehi baerev. vahagam sheamarnu ki yeshnah lahadelaka bayyom bener maaravi, davar ze lo haya ella bizmanne yeridat am Adonai, shehaya kave ner maaravi (yoma lat:), lo bime aharon, uma gam bitchillat hakamat hammishkan. gam ramaz beamro kaasher tzivva vegomer lehodia shivcho shel aharon, ki ma sheasa aharon lo asao letzad hammaala vehakkavod asher heemir oto Adonai, ella letzad asot mitzvat Adonai, al derech amro (tehillim 40:9) "laasot retzoncha elohay chafatzti".

rashi: Yede zerubbavel yissedu habbayit hazze. mittechilla vead sof bime koresh harishon (Ezra 3:10):
Vidav tevatztzana. oto atta, tevatztzana leshon gemar hu, kemo "ki yevatztza Adonai kol maasehu" (yeshaya 10:12):
targum: Yede zerubbavel sheria lemivne veta haden vidohi yeshachleluneh vetedun are Adonai tzevaot shalchani leitnabbaa lechon:

rashi: Ki im betorat Adonai cheftzo. ha lamadta, shemmoshav letzim mevio lide bittul tora (avoda zara 18:):
Uvetorato yehge. bitchilla hi nikret torat Adonai, umishsheamal bah hi nikret torato (avoda zara 19.):
Yehge. kol leshon hege ballev hu, kema deat amar "vehegyon libbi" (tehillim 19:15), "libbecha yehge ema" (Yeshayahu 33:18), "ki shod yehge libbam" (Mishlei 24:2):
targum: Elahen benimusa dayya reuteh uveorayteh meranen yemam velele:

rashi: Shatul. pelanditz belaaz:
Palge. rauyeyarosh belaaz:
Vealehu lo yibbol. afillu happesolet shebbo letzorech hi. sichatan shel talmide chachamim letzorech hi utzericha limmud (avoda zara 19:):
Lo yibbol. leshon kamosh, pelishtir belaaz:
targum: Vihe keilan chaye dintziv al teyafe moy di inbeh mevashel beidaneh veatrefoy la natrin vechol lavlevoy dimlavlev megargar umatzlach:

ohc: Vayhi anashim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar leshon yachid al harabbim, veod lamma hutzrach lomar velo yachlu laasot happesach achar shehodia shehayu temeim? veulay ki letzad shetztzivva Adonai merosh chodesh al happesach kemo sheppershu bifsachim (daf 6.) shemmaamar "veyaasu bene yisrael et happasach" haya berosh chodesh nisan, umin harauy haya lahem lehishtammer mittuma, vetavo hassevara lehattil bahem dofi asher lo shamru et mitzvat Adonai venitmeu velo chashshu lemitzvat pesach, talmud lomar vayhi leshon yachid, lomar ki lo haya ella inyan tuma achat asher nitmeu haanashim bah, veinyan tuma ze atzmo lo haya beyadam lehishtammer mimmennu uveal karcham hayu nitmaim, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (socha ko:), ben lerabbi yose haggelili sheamar nose arono shel yosef hayu, ben lerabbi akiva, ben lerabbi yitzchak sheamar temee met mitzva hayu tzerichin littamme hagam sheyyadu shettumatam nimshechet ad arbaa asar, vehu ma sheramaz maamar velo yachlu laasot happesach lomar shello yachlu lishmor atzman mehattuma laasot happesach. veamro bayyom hahu, kevar dikdeku razal (fesachim 90:) lemar kedato ulemar kedato. od yirtze beamro leshon yachid, lomar ki letzad shehayu yechidim hu shello yachlu laasot happesach, aval im hayu tzibbur hayu yecholin laasot happesach ki ba betuma. shuv raiti besifre merazal sheddiyyeku chen.

Lenefesh adam. amro "lenefesh adam" lomar, aval litme sheretz yecholin hem, al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (fesachim 90.) sheamru shochatin vezorkin al teme sheretz vetovel veochel pischo laerev, aval teme met hagam shechal shevii shello beyom arbaa asar en shochatin alav, vehu amro "bayyom hahu". veamar rabbi akiva veze leshono: shechal shevii shellahem beerev happesach, ketiv "bayyom hahu" – hu sheenam yecholin, aval bayyom shelleacharav hayu yecholin. vegam lisvarat haomer "bayyom hahu" nitmeu, yeshno leferushenu bemaamar "lenefesh adam" lomar sheim haya sheretz shochatin alav.

Vayyikrevu lifne moshe vegomer. taam karvatam lifne moshe veaharon, lefi peshat hakkatuv kede shettavo hahoraa mimmoshe techef umiyyad lakkohen lehakeriv et karbenehem im ken yore. verabbotenu zichronam livracha bemassechet bava batra perek yesh nochalin (bava batra kayit.) amru veze leshonam: efshar amdu lifne moshe velo amar vechulei, ella sares hammikra vedarshehu, divre rabbi yoshiyya. abba chanan mishshum rabbi eliezer omer: bevet hammidrash hayu yoshvim uvau vechulei, ad kan. veamru baggemara veze leshonam: bemay ka mippalge? mar savar cholkin kavod lattalmid bimkom harav, umar savar en cholkin, vehilcheta cholkin, vehilcheta en cholkin, velo kashya – ha defalig leh rabbeh yekara, ha dela palig leh rabbeh yekara, ad kan leshonam. hinne mimma sheamru hilcheta cholkin vehilcheta en cholkin, veheemidu amram hilcheta cholkin bidfalig leh rabbeh yekara vehilcheta en cholkin bidla palig leh rabbeh yekara, haddevarim mochichim shecholkin rabbi yoshiyya veabba chanan bakketzavot – mar savar cholkin afillu en rabbo cholek lo kavod, umar savar en cholkin afillu cholek lo rabbo kavod, shebbaze yutzdak lomar hilcheta vechulei vehilcheta vechulei mikkelal difligi.

Veyesh lanu lachkor zot: minnayin lo lashshas lehaamid machloket zo shecholkin bakketzavot, uma gam heyot hefech hakkelal sheanu omrim sheen lehaamid machloket razal bakketzavot? veim letzad shello noda machlaktam im beshecholek vechulei im besheen cholek vechulei, en hechrea lomar sheen cholkin ella besheen cholek lo rabbo vechulei, aval keshecholek lo rabbo vechulei modim shecholkin, o nelech letzad ze sheen cholkin hattannaim ella keshecholek lo rabbo vechulei, aval kesheen rabbo cholek modim sheen cholkim lo kavod, vaasher al ken heemid hashshas machloket bakketzavot? ze dochak, shehaya lo lehashshas laamod al mashmaut divre hattannaim kodem keminhag hashshas, vigalle machlaktam, veachar kach yomar hilcheta vechulei.

Vehaya nire lomar ki hashshas diyyek shecholkin bakketzavot mittoch machlaktam mimma shecholkin, ki bishlama i amrinan shecholkin bakketzavot shappir, ella im enam cholkin ella bachalukka achat veshavim bachavertah, lamma palig tanna al divre chavero kevan sheyyachol lehaamid devarav bachalukka sheyyode bah hu? gam ze eno maspik, ki ze hattaam tzodek bedivre abba chanan shecholek bakketzavot afillu dela palig leh rabbeh yekara, aval rabbi yoshiyya mi yomar shessover en cholkin afillu palig leh rabbeh yekara? veod, gam al hacholek ani dan mi gilla lo shettanna kamma bechol hakketzavot hu omer?

Achen hattaam hu, ki mimma shehutzrach rabbi yoshiyya lesares hammikra uledarsho, vehu hefech peshat hakkatuv, hare ze maggid ki lo matza lo derech lehaamido belo serus. veim haya sover rabbi yoshiyya shecholkin kavod lattalmid bimkom harav, haya lo lehanniach hakkatuv kifshuto ulehaamido keshecholek lo rabbo kavod. veyutzdeku haddevarim behaish moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom shehaya anav meod, shehaya cholek kavod leaharon achiv, uma gam shehaya gadol mimmennu. od metzanuhu shehaya cholek lo kavod, keamram zichronam livracha (mechilta parashat ba 12) sheamru keshehayu omdim lifne paro, moshe cholek kavod leaharon sheyyakdim baddibbur veaharon lemoshe, vehaya haddibbur yotze mibben shenehem. hinne hu cholek lo kavod.

Umimma shesseres hammikra gilla dato shessover sheen cholkin vechulei afilu cholek lo rabbo kavod, umimma shemmatzinu shennechleku gam ken beinyan benot tzelafchad dichtiv "vattaamodna lifne moshe velifne elazar" vegomer (Bamidbar 27:2), veze leshonam: efshar amdu lifne moshe vechulei velifne elazar velo amar vechulei vayyaamdu lifne hannesiim baeda vehaeda vechulei, ella sares hammikra vedarshehu, divre rabbi yoshiyya. abba chanan omer mishshum rabbi eliezer: bevet hammidrash hayu yoshvim vechulei, umevi hashshas hainyan atzmo shehevenu lemala. vehinne mimma sherainu shechalak abba chanan baamidat benot tzelafchad lifne hannesiim vehaeda, min hassetam lo hayu hannesiim cholkin kavod lechol haeda, veen tzarich lomar moshe melech yisrael, veaf al pi chen amar abba chanan shechalku lahem kavod. ha lamadta shessover shecholkin kavod afilu en rabbo cholek lo kavod, umeatta hirvachnu taam nachon lamma nechleku shete peamim rabbi yoshiyya veabba chanan.

Vaettena et haleviyyim netunim leaharon vegomer. kafal lomar tevat "netunim", yechavven lechayyev hammekabbel lekabbel hammattana, shello lomar i efshi lekabbel mattana zo. vahagam shebbemishpete ish lachavero yachol lemaen kol od shello higgia leyado velo zacha bah, kan mechayyevam lekabbel mattana zo hagam sheyyesh lahem tzad lemaen bemattana zo, ki beemtzaut ze yeaser al hakkohanim avodat haleviyyim veyitchayyevu mita aleha, keamram zichronam livracha besifre (Bamidbar 18:3) veze leshonam: "gam hem gam attem", attem beshellahem vehem beshellachem bemita. vahagam sheharambam beferek 3 mehilchot kele hammikdash katav veze leshono: leviyyim sheavdu avodat hakkohanim vechulei chayyavim mita bide shamayim, aval hakkohen sheavad avodat hallevi eno bemita ella belo taase, ad kan, al kol panim yeshno laonesh venigra meavodatam baavodat hakkodesh. uletaam ze yesh makom lemaen, laze kafal lomar "netunim" beal karcham.

Mittoch bene yisrael. amar hakkatuv Adonai peamim "bene yisrael" befasuk ze lelo tzorech. razal darshu (Vayikra Rabba 2:1) shehu mare hachibba kafal zichron shemotam chamesh peamim befasuk echad keneged chamishsha chumeshe tora, vehu derech derash. ulefi peshat hakkatuv nire ki bediyyuk neemru hazekarot bene yisrael. amro mittoch bene yisrael yechavven el hakkelalut, vechammaamar hakkodem: "kach et haleviyyim mittoch bene yisrael", veamro laavod avodat bene yisrael yechavven el habbechorot sheavoda zo shellahem hayta vehaleviyyim ovdim avodatam, velaze hutzrach lomar "bene yisrael" velo amar "avodatam", sheaz hayta neevedet hakkavvana asher kivven lah hakkatuv. veamro ulechapper al bene yisrael chozer el hakkelalut, vechash lomar "lechapper alehem" sheaz tihye hakkavvana shechozer el hakkodem shehem habbechorot levad, laze neemar "bene yisrael" lomar sheal hakkelalut hu omer. veamro velo yihye bivne yisrael vegomer velo amar "velo yihye vachem negef", nitchakkem lehodia ki amro "ulechapper" vegomer "velo yihye vachem negef" en achat gezerat chavertah al ze hadderech lechapper vegomer kede shello yihye bahem negef, ella hem shete haderagot hattova al ze hadderech: lechapper al nafshotechem mittachalue hannefesh hammesubbavim mehachataim, veod, lo yihye bivne yisrael negef begishtam, vechavvana zo muvenet mimma sheamar "bivne yisrael" shezze yaggid hevdel hammaamar sheeno kashur lemala. veamro begeshet bene yisrael nitkavven lomar shehagam shello yiggeshu ella hayyechidim, al kol bene yisrael yiktzof al haddavar. umatzinu kayyotze baze sheyyiktzof Adonai al hakkelalut bishvil happerat, vetze ulemad meadat korach maamar Adonai sham (Bamidbar 16,21): "hibbadlu mittoch haeda" vegomer, vehutzrach moshe lehitpallel laAdonai al haddavar. veayyen sham hattaam.

Al na taazov otanu vegomer. ledivre rabbi eliezer yitbaer al ze hadderech shemmevakkesh mimmennu shello yelech afillu lefi shaa, hagam sheddato lachzor, vehu ma sheramaz betevat "na". ucheneged taanat sheraga betihara shello kibbelah mimmennu, amar hattaam ki al ken yadata chanotenu bammidbar, veal yadcha heiru derachenu baatzatcha, dichtiv (Shemot 18:21) "veatta techeze mikkol haam" vegomer vehiskim Adonai al atzatcha, uchetiv "vayyivchar moshe" vegomer, im ken yachol atta lehair afillu lifne chamma ulevana.

Uledivre rabbi yehoshua yitbaer al ze hadderech: al na, perush en nachon atta laazov otanu, vehattaam – ki al ken yadata vegomer, perush: bishlama im lo bata etzlenu kol ikkar en ani choshesh lecha, aval atta shebbata veyadata chanotenu bammidbar, perush letzad sheyyisrael mechussim baananim veen adam yodea mekomam, kemaamaram zichronam livracha (bammidbar Rabba 99, rosh hashshana 3.) bappasuk "ki gava aharon vegomer vayyishma hakkenaani ki ba yisrael" vegomer, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha ki letzad shennistalleku anne chavod hukkar mekoman shel yisrael, emor meatta: kodem lachen lo noda tachanotam, vechovav hodio Adonai chanotam shel yisrael. veod lo shehiskim Adonai lema sheheir enehem baatzato, vehu amro vehayita lanu vegomer, veen nachon laazov otam achar kol ze, ki yesh baze chillul hashshem, ki yomru sheamad al emunatam vehechshivuhu kol kach veazav otam – en ze ella shello hutzdeku etzlo mofte haemuna, veen nachon asot ken. ucheshello kibbel, gersho moshe mikkevodo shel olam.

rashi: Asher beyad shene tzanterot. kelomar: etzel shene hatztzanterot, kemo "reu chelkat yoav el yadi" (Shmuel 2 14:30):
Hammerikim mealehem. et hashshemen hazze hatztzalul vetov lehair kezahav, kemo (iyyov 37:22) "mitztzafon zahav yeete":
targum: Vaativet tinyanut vaamaret leh ma teren shuvele zetaya divyad teren iskeritvan didhav dimrikin minhon mishcha levotzine dahava:

rashi: Vaomar. ani zecharya:
Yasimu tzanif tahor vegomer. bikkashti rachamim alav:
targum: Vaamaret shavu mitznefa dachya al resheh veshaviu mitznefa dachya al reshe veasvuhi itteta dechashra lichhuneta umalacha dayya kaim:

ohc: Bashshana hashshenit vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma shinna hakkatuv seder haragil lehakedim zichron hachodesh veachar kach zichron hashshana, shekken timtza bitchillat hassefer sheamar "beechad lachodesh hashsheni bashshana hashshenit". gam ki beseder ze shekkatav nitchayyev hakkatuv lehafesik beemtza zichron hazzeman bemaamar letzetam meeretz mitzrayim, ma shello haya ose chen im haya makdim zichron hachodesh veachar kach zichron hashshana, sheaz yomar "letzetam meeretz mitzrayim" achare chen. od yesh lehair lamma nishtannet parasha zo shello neemar bah "dabber el bene yisrael" kechol hattora kullah. achen yitbaer behair od amro vayyaasu betosefet vav bitchillat inyan. od kashe lamma hutzrach Adonai letzauot bene yisrael al happesach, vahalo kevar tzivva kaamur befarashat bo el paro (Shemot 12:43). vehaya nire lomar laze ki chash hakkatuv lomar sheen mitzvat pesach ella beeretz mitzrayim uvevoam el eretz noshavet velo bammidbar, laze ba lomar bammidbar veyaasu bene yisrael et happasach, veze davar rachok.

Venire ki kavvanat hakkatuv hi, letzad sheamra tora (Shemot 12:43) "kol ben nechar lo yochal bo", vetanya bammechilta veze leshonam: "kol ben nechar" – echad yisrael mumar veechad goy bemashma, ad kan leshonam. uletzad shemmatzinu sheyyisrael asu haegel vechulei, veamru zichronam livracha (chullin 5.) kol hammode baavoda zara kechofer bechol hattora kullah veyeamer alav ben nechar, meatta yesh makom ladun beyisrael sheenam yecholin laasot happesach. vahagam shennitratztza Adonai lemoshe bitfillotav uvemishpatav asher asa beyisrael, im kol ze odam lo nitbasseru shennitkapper avon haegel veyesh safek baddavar. laze ba hakkadosh baruch hu venatan reshut veamar lahem veyaasu vene yisrael et happasach, vedikdek lomar veyaasu lomar millevad ma shehuvtechu shennicham Adonai al haraa asher dibber laasot, od lahem shehuchsheru lihyot reuyim laasot happesach.

Umeatta banu lehasekil lehetiv shinnuy hakedamat zichron hashshana, ki chevan shekkol atzmo lo ba hammaamar kan ella lehacheshiram laasot happesach, laze petach devarav hizkir shana hashshenit, lehasekil sovev hammaamar, shehu letzad shehaya ze achar maase haegel, ma sheen haddavar muskol behazekarat zeman hachodesh sheeno mistayyem baze hearat haddavar. velaze lo amar "dabber el bene yisrael" shello ba letzauot laze ella lerishyon, veday behodaat hammishpat lemoshe shekken hu haddin. veulay lefi ma sheamru bifsachim (6.) shemmaamar ze haya berosh chodesh, nuchal lomar ki ze hammaamar haya kodem yeridat shechina lammishkan beyom rosh chodesh nisan, vehikdim Adonai maamar ze levasseram shekkesherim hem laasot pesach veachar yarda shechina. velaze timtza sheamar besamuch achare ze uveyom hakim et hammishkan kissa heanan.

Vattedabber vegomer bemoshe. ulay sheddibberu befanav shel moshe, vehaddaat maskemet baze gam ken, ki ma yoilu dabber lo tov benehem leven atzman, ella amru divrehem derech tochacha vehu shomea millatam. shuv raiti bedivre rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sifre) sheamru ken veramzuhu bemaamar "vayyishma Adonai vehaish moshe" vegomer perush, gam hu shama.

Vayyaas vegomer vechol adat vegomer ken asu lahem bene yisrael. yesh lehair lamma kafal lomar "ken asu", od shinna shehitchil lomar kol adat vegamar amro bene yisrael. venire shennitkavven bechefel "ken asu bene yisrael" al habbechorot, uva lehachezik tova labbechorot yoter, shehagam shennatlu mekoman baavodat bet elohenu asu kechol asher tzivva Adonai, hagam ki kefi hatteva enoshi yachiv libbam velo yedakdeku asot kechol perate hammitzva. velaze shinna bemaamaro millashon shehitchil ledabber bo "kol adat bene yisrael" veamar bene yisrael, ki lo al kullan medabber hakkatuv kan ella al perat echad kaamur.

Dabber vegomer veamarta. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar dabber veamarta, gam bemillot shonot. veyitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (tanchuma, Bamidbar perek 15) veze leshonam: lamma nismecha parashat menora lefarashat nesiim? lefi sheraa aharon chanukkat nesiim chalsha dato shello haya immahem bachanukka lo hu velo shivto. amar lo hakkadosh baruch hu: "chayyecha shellecha gedola mishshellahem, sheatta madlik umetiv et hannerot erev vavoker" vechulei, ad kan. hinne divrehem zichronam livracha tzerichin beur, ma nechama zo osa lachalishut dato shel aharon al chanukkat hannesiim shello haya bakkelal, halo en maase hammenora makbil lachanukka? gam lamma lo hinniach dato bechol hakkarbanot shehu makriv, temidin, umusafin, vehakketoret, gam behakeravat hachanukka atzmah shel kol hannesiim hare hu hammakriv, velamma lo ritztzahu ella bammenora?

Veyityashshev hainyan betet lev lema sheamru bimnachot beferek shete middot (menachot pach.) veze leshonam: ketzad ose? mesallekan umannichan baohel umekannechan bisfog venoten bahem shemen" vechulei, ad kan. velisvarat hacholek al sevara zo vesover dikvie nerot, sover gam ken shehayu kanim shebbahem nerot kevuim dakkim, vehaya koffam lematta ad shehaya metivam umekannecham vechozer vezokfam kevarishona, kidmuchach sham middivre Rashi dibbur hammatchil shel perakim vechulei:

Vaani omer, illu hayiti sham hayiti mochiach vedan lifnehem mehakketuvim dela kevie nerot. harishon, mimma shemmatzinu keshehizkir kol perate maase hammenora lo hizkir perat ze sheasa "lemul pene hammenora yairu", sheim hannerot kevuim keshehizkir hammaase chal zichron haddavar. veod reaya acheret, mimma sheamar hakkatuv befarashat bammidbar (Bamidbar 4:9): "velakchu beged techelet vechissu et menorat hammaor veet neroteha veet malkacheha veet machtoteha veet kol kele shamnah", hare ze mare baetzba sheen hannerot kevuim, sheim lo chen hare hannerot bichlal hammenora hem velo haya tzarich lefartam, ella vadday sheenam kevuim velaze hutzrach lefartam kemalkacheha uchemachtoteha shehem bifne atzmam.

Shuv raiti kaze bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 2 4:20) "veet hammenorot venerotehem", hare ze maggid ki bezichron menorot lo yikkallu nerotehem. vegam raiti lerashi zichrono livracha sham shekkatav veze leshono: lehotzi millev hammefarshim nerot hayu asuyim miggufah shel menora vaadukim bah, shehare ketiv "menorot venerotehem" vechulei, ad kan, yeuyyan sham devarav beorech. ha lamadta sheppashtiyyut hakketuvim yaggidu ki lo kevie nerot.

Uchefi ze naskil kavvanat teshuvat Adonai leaharon, ki aharon haya mitanneach al chanukkat hammizbeach, veheshivo hakkadosh baruch hu "chayyecha shellecha" vechulei, perush, maase hammenora shemmorid hannerot umannichan baohel umekannecham vechozer uvone otah mechadash umadlikah, hare kol yom keose maase chadash shemmechannech hu hammenora bechol hadelaka vehadelaka. veamro "madlik umetiv erev vavoker" velo matzinu hadelaka ella baerev, hare amru bemassechet tamid (perek 3 mishna 9) ki ner maaravi tzarich lihyot dolek yomam valayla, uvetorat kohanim amru veze leshonam: "lehaalot ner" – ner maaravi dolek tadir, metzao shekkava medashsheno umadliko mimmizbach haola, ad kan. hare sheyyeshnah lehadelaka vahatava layla vayom, venimtza shemmechannech bechol yom hammenora, vehem lo chanchu ella paam achat hammizbeach. vehu ma shekkafal hakkatuv bemaamaro dabber veamarta, "dabber" – dibbur hatztzarich lammitzva, "veamarta" – maane rach hameyashshev haddaat mechulshatah, sheamarnu shechalsha dato shel aharon veheshivo ki shello gadol vechulei. gam titparesh tevat veamarta leshon maala, al derech amro (Devarim 26:17) "et Adonai heemarta", sheheshivo shello meulle mikkullan.

Vegam lisvarat haomer kevie nerot, hinne hu omer shehayu hakkanim shebbo hannerot dakkim, shehaya yachol lichpof ulehorid hannerot lematta ad sheyyekannechem velachzor lehaalotam, uveemtzaut hakkinnuach vechulei yechashev kimchaddesh vahare hu mechannech bechol yom, veyityashshev erech hakkatuv atzmo kemo shekkatavti.

Behaalotcha et hannerot. tzarich ladaat lamma lo amar behadelikcha. verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (Bamidbar Rabba 95; sifre) bo derashot rabbot. gam tzarich ladaat lamma lo tzivva Adonai mitzva zo beyom rishon, ki hi mitzva hannoheget miyyom rishon baavoda. veod halo hi ketuva hammitzva atzmah shemmetzavve kan befarashat teruma (Shemot 25:37): "veheela et neroteha veheir al ever paneha", velamma chazar lishnotah. od lamma amar yairu velo tzivva lenocheach lammetzuvve: "tair", keshiur "behaalotcha", uchemo sheamar gam ken befarashat teruma: "veheir al ever" vegomer.

Achen bema shehikdamti bemaamar chazal (menachot tzach:) yityashshev hakkol al nachon. ki amro behaalotcha letzad shehannerot lo hayu kevuim, yetzav Adonai shebbechol et asher yoridem lekannecham veyaale otam lesadderam bimkomam, yesadderem bederech sheyyairu el mul pene hammenora vegomer, velaze lo amar gam ken "tair", ki en hammitzva bishat hadelaka sheyyutzdak lomar "tair", ella hammitzva hi al seder hannachatam sheyyannichem beseder sheyyairu el mul vegomer, vehaven:

Uvaze nityashshev lamma hutzrach lachzor letzauot laze, ki letzad shead atta haya moshe ose keseder ze beshivat yeme hammilluim, vechash Adonai sheyyadin aharon bedato sheen meakkev seder hannachatan, veadrabba yoter hu seder nachon sheyyihyu hannerot yesharim pifiyyotehem velo baalachson, laze tzivva Adonai sheyyomar leaharon sheddavar ze meakkev. uvachar lesadder mitzva zo kan velo sidderah im siddure hakkarbanot asher tzivva Adonai vaavoda hammeakkevet, lehodienu hakepadat aharon veritztzuyo, ma shennizkar bemaamaram zichronam livracha.

El mul pene hammenora vegomer. taam haddavar yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru bemassechet shabbat (22.) veze leshonam: "michutz lefarochet haedut" vegomer – vechi leorah hu tzarich? vahalo kol arbaim shana shehayu yisrael bammidbar lo halchu ella leoro! ella edut levae olam shehashshechina shora beyisrael. may edut? amar rav: zo ner maaravi shennoten bah shemen kemiddat chavroteha umimmenna haya madlik uvah haya mesayyem, ad kan. al pi haddevarim haelle yetzav Adonai lehair el mul pene hammenora shehu ner hammaaravi, lehareot kol ner vaner shello ba ella bishvil edut asher yaggid ner happonim elav kullam, lehareot nisso hannizkar.

Uma sheraiti sheddikdeku hattosafot hatam bitmihat "vechi leorah hu tzarich" vechulei, mittaam kol arbaim shana vechulei, velo amru "vahalo kol haolam kullo leoro shel makom", laaniyyut dati eno dikduk, ki tatzdik hattemiha mehammurgash lahem yoter middevarim habbaim beemuna ki Adonai bara shemesh veyareach hammeirim laolam, ulederech ze yityashshev im hahi sheheviu mishshilhe kol hakkarbanot vechulei (menachot 86:), yeuyyan sham divrehem.

Veyesh lanu lachkor zot meatta, shello ba hammenora ella lehaggid nissah shebbener maaravi haya maspik bener mitztziddah haechad vener mitztziddah hashsheni, veyesh lomar kefi happeshat shehu lenoy, sheachar shehutzercha biatah laremez hannizkar en nachon lehavi bet Adonai ella davar metukkan venachon shebbammenorot.

Uvederech remez yirmoz beshiva nerot leummot haolam shehem shivim ummot, kol echad yirmoz lichlal haasiri. yirmoz ki chullan meirim lenochach hammaaravi, shehem yisrael shehem bechinat hammaarav kayyadua leyode chen, veramaz gam ken shekkullan kalim vener yisrael lo yichbe. vetimtza shehearat hannerot eno ella ballayla, vehu sod haggalut shennikra layla, ma sheen ken bevo zeman hayyeshua hammityaches lah boker, ketiv (yeshaya 21:12) "ata voker" vegomer, yichbe ner haummot veyishshaer mikkelalutam ner yisrael shehu holech vaor ad nechon hayyom. gam ramaz bemitzvat hadelakat hannerot sheyyechavven hammadlik behadelakatam shettihye hearatam lemul pene hammenora, shehakkol yihyu letzarche yisrael hammityaches lahem shem panim, kayyadua lammevinim.

rashi: Lavush begadim tzoim. ketargumo: "havo leh benin denasvin lehon neshin dela chashrin lichhuneta", vehaya neenash hu al shello micha beyadam (sanhedrin 93.):
targum: Vihoshua havo leh benin denasvin lehon neshin dela chashran lichhuneta vekaem kodam malacha:

ohc: Vayyetze moshe vaydabber vegomer. hikdim haddevarim el haam, veachar kach asaf hazzekenim, asher lo chen matzinu beseder divre Adonai elav shehikdim asifat zekenim veachar kach "veel haam tomar" (Bamidbar 11:18), letzad sheddan bedato ki daat elyon hi lehakedim maamaro leyisrael, sheim hayta kavvanato lehakedim haasifa lo haya lo letzauot lo maamar haam, ella hare ze maggid sheyyakdim maamar laam veachar kach yeesof hazzekenim laohel veyaase kol haamur bainyan.

Vetaam asher hikdim Adonai maamar haasifa, letzad shebbaze hayta teshuva ledivre moshe sheamar "lo uchal levaddi laset et kol haam", laze hikdim lahashivo al devarav techilla, veachar kach tzivvahu ledabber el bene yisrael. veyada Adonai ki moshe chacham leda hatztzarich lehakedim, kemo shekken hiskil asot.

Od efshar lomar ki maamar vaydabber el haam et divre Adonai hem divre asifat hazzekenim levad, vechashav ad asher yigmor ma shetztzivva Adonai baasifat hazzekenim veyetze ledabber el haam maamar sheni "veel haam tomar", vegam middivre midrash tanchuma mashma ken.

rashi: Ki yodea Adonai vegomer. lefi shehu yodea derech tzaddikim, ulefanav hu lehakkirah tamid, vederech reshaim senua beenav umaavirah millefanav, al ken lo tehe hakamat regel larshaim leyom haddin, velachattaim likkatev baadat tzaddikim:
targum: Metul digle kodam Adonai orach tzadikaya veorchathon derashie tehoved:

rashi: Venachal Adonai et yehuda. lenachalato ulechelko:
targum: Veyachsin Adonai lidvet yehuda chulakhon al ara dekudesha veyitree od birushelem:

rashi: Tashev enosh ad dakka. mevi atta yissurin al haadam ad sheatta machaziro lihyot teshush koach vekarov lammavet, vattomer lo beyissurin shuvu vene adam middarchechem haraim:
targum: Tetev bar nash al choveh ad mota vaamaret tuvu vene nasha:

ohc: Veyesh asher vegomer meerev ad boker vegomer. mikkan vaelach ba hakkatuv lehodia hahadragot shehayu beshinnuy chaniyyatam, vehitchil mizzeman chaniyyat layla, vehu amro meerev ad boker, veamar samuch lah zeman chaniyyat yom valayla keamro yomam valayla, veamar samuch lah zeman shene yamim, keamro yomayim, vesamuch lah chodesh, vesamuch lah yamim shehu shana. vehodaa baze eno kahodaa bappesukim hakkodmin pasuk "uvehaarich" ufasuk "veyesh asher vegomer yamim mispar", sheim ken lo haya lo lehakedim zichron yamim mispar lezichron erev ad boker. veen lomar ki shene pesukim "uvehaarich" veyesh vegomer yamim mispar" hem zichron derech kelal ma shepperat achar kach, shehare en bakkelal ma shebbapperat shehu meerev ad boker veyomam valayla. ella vadday ki shene ketuvim harishonim yaggidu inyan echad kemo shekkatavnu, veshlosha ketuvim haacharonim yaggidu haderagot shinnuye haakkava shehayu mishtannim miggeder layla achat legeder shana achat. vehattaam baze lefi maamar anshe emet shettaam haavaratam bammidbar hu levarer nitzotze hakkedushsha hashshevuyot beyad shochen midbar tziyya, asher al ken hayyodea nistarot haya meshaer shiur asher yaspik leverur bammakom hahu im meat veim harebe, vehayu mitakkevim kefi hatztzorech, gam lo hayu chonim ella bemakom sheyyesh levarer velo bemakom sheyyaspik bo habberur bemeshech zeman hillucham bo.

Vayyaratz hannaar vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma nitraesh hammaggid lehaggid shennitnabbeu. veod lo sheraash alehem letittam bevet kele, vechi kol hammitnabbe neenash al shennibba? veze min hattema. veyesh latet taam lisvarat haomer shehayu shenayim shennisharu bappetakin, ki letzad sheamar moshe leyisrael al pi Adonai sheyyitten ruach nevua al shivim, veachshav nibbeu gam hashshenayim, yesh lachush leechad mishshene devarim: o lo yeamen moshe chas veshalom bemaamaro sheamar lo Adonai shivim, o hammitnabbeim nibbeu sheker. velisvarat haomer ki hayu mehashshivim, higgidu lemoshe hammaase habbilti hagun, shehu amar sheyyelchu leohel moed vehem amdu bammachane venibbeu sham, veyesh baze shetayim raot: achat shello kiyyemu devar moshe, vehashsheniyya shebbaze gillu datam shello ratzu shetteatzel alehem haruach merucho shel moshe ella mimmekor haruach umitnabbeim bammachane.

rashi: Matay avo veerae pene elohim. laalot laregel; venitnabbe kan churban habbayit. veneemar kan "ma tishtochachi" shalosh peamim (tehillim 42:6, 12; tehillim 43:5), keneged shalosh malchuyyot haatidot levattel avodat hammikdash, veyisrael tzoakim venigalim: malchut bavel veyavan veedom:
Tzama nafshi. keneset yisrael omeret ken begalut bavel:
targum: Tzechat lach nafshi lelaha takifa chaya vekayama emati eul veechme ziv shechinta dayya:

ohc: Esfa li vegomer mizzikne yisrael. velo amar "esfa li vegomer shivim zikne yisrael", yirmoz lema sheamru zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 15,21) shehashshivim zekenim sheasaf bemitzrayim nehergu kullan im chur, laze amar elav sheyyeesof shivim acherim mizzikne yisrael. veamar tevat li sheyyitkavven baddavar lishmo yitbarach, kede shello yatehu hassatan bezaken sheeno nachon, uchesheyyihye lishmo yitbarach, shomer mitzva lo yeda davar ra.

Od nitkavven sheasifatam tihye laAdonai, sheyyekabbelu hamminnuy vehasserara meAdonai al yisrael velo mimmoshe. od yirtze sheyyomar lahem, hagam shezzekenim harishonim nehergu, lo yimneu atzmam hem miggeshet el hamminnuy, hagam sheyyihyu neesafim, perush neheragim, li lishmi, kederech amro (Tehillim 44:23) "ki alecha horagnu".
Zikne haam veshotrav. perush, shehem beene haam nechshavim vicholin lirdot bahem veyecherdu lemaamaram, vehu maamar veshotrav.

Vayyomer moshe vegomer hatzon uvakar vegomer. nifleu mimmenni haddevarim mimmi sheamaram, sheen nachon leamer kaze afillu meadam shello hikkir gedullat elohe yisrael, umikkol shekken leish haelohim. verabbotenu zichronam livracha (sifre) mehem chashvu lo lechet, umehem amru ki al mappaltan shel yisrael yitpalle, lamma yumetu shesh meot elef vegomer bishvil habbasar. vehadderasha tiddaresh, aval al kol panim tzarich leyashshev peshatan shel devarim. od tzarich ladaat lamma chazar lomar haddevarim hanneemarim veatta amarta basar etten. od tzarich ladaat ma temiha hi zot hatzon uvakar vegomer, gam belo nes yesh lahem mikne lizzon mimmennu chodesh yamim, umikra male dibber hakkatuv (Shemot 12:38) "vegam erev rav vegomer vetzon uvakar" vegomer. od tzarich ladaat lamma higzim kol kach bechol dege hayyam shetztzarich kol dege hayyam lehistappek mehem chodesh yamim, vahalo kol haolam ochlim dagim shehem kiflayim kol kach peamim al shesh meot elef shehayu yisrael?

Achen yityashshevu hakketuvim bishne derachim. haechad, kesheamar Adonai elav sheyyitten lahem basar setam, hevin moshe mashmaut haddevarim ki min echad shel basar yitten lahem, laze amar lefanav shesh meot elef vegomer, perush uminyan rav kaze yimmatze bahem deot shonot, ze yachpotz besar tzon, veze yachpotz bakar, veze ayil utzevi, veze ofot, veze dagim, veatta amarta basar etten lahem mashma min basar echad, ma hi habbasar shettitten, hatzon uvakar vegomer umatza lahem, perush mevukkasham, im et kol dege perush mine dagim vegomer umatza lahem perush mevukkasham, halo keshettitten lahem besar tzon uvakar yomru chafetzim beayyal utzevi, ucheshettitten lahem ayyal utzevi yomru chafetzim bivsar ofot, ucheshettitten lahem ofot yomru dagim. verasham shene ketzavot habbasar, tzon uvakar, vekatze haacharon – besar dagim, vehadderagot emtzaiyyim shebben besar tzon uvakar livsar dagim muvanim. veamar kol dege hayyam perush, shello yoil beminim mehaddagim ella im yavi kol mine dagim shebbayyam, shezzulat ze – hammin hechaser yivku alav, umeatta en setimat pihem zulat kol mine basar behema vechayya vechol mine ofot vechol mine dagim hammaspikim lahem chodesh yamim. nimtzet omer sheikkar hafelaato hayta letzad shehevin middivre Adonai ki min echad shel basar, vein hache namme im haya omer sheyyitten lahem kol minim shebbaolam shel basar lo haya matmiah. uvaze nityashshevu kol haddikdukim vedivre moshe chen. veikkar kavvanat moshe baze ulay yimmana mittet habbasar velo yamutu bene yisrael, ki Adonai tala ze baze.

Vederech sheni al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (berachot noach.) sheamru en hakkadosh baruch hu ose nes lashsheker, uletzad sheamar Adonai elav shehabbasar hu charbam kemaamaram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar 11:20) beferush Rashi "vehaya lachem lezara" shekken korin vechulei lecherev zara, im ken lo al hannes medabber hakkatuv ella sheyyochlu mibbasar hannimtza. veal ze tama sheen nimtza lahem leechol sheloshim yom. umaamar basar etten lahem shennire sheyyittenu mechadash, perush hu sheyyitten lahem reshut leachlo, letzad shead atta lo haya lahem reshut leechol mimmiknehem vehayu laavodat Adonai, veamar Adonai ki yitten lahem reshut leechol basar. umaamar im et kol dege hayyam, perush letzad shehayu lahem dagim mehabbeer shehayta holechet immahem, aval lo haya lahem histappekut afillu leyom echad bachodesh, kesheshshier moshe davar hatztzarich leshishshim ribbo sheloshim yom shier shekkol dagim sheyyecholin lihyot sham bannimtza lo yaspiku. uvederech nes kevar amarnu shessavar shello yaase Adonai nes letachlit davar ra kemo shekkatavti. ulederech ze temihat moshe temiha veen alav ashmat davar, ki eno ose chesron bicholet Adonai chas veshalom.

rashi: Kammotz. leshon kash, kombela belaaz:
targum: La metul hechna rashie elahen kemoza di tashkefineh alola:

rashi: Tau vammidbar vegomer. veholche midbarot af hem tzerichin lehodot, shehare peamim shehem toim ureevim utzemeim (berachot ned:):
targum: Al ama devet yisrael itnabbe vaamar ama bet yisrael tau bemadbera bitzdi archa karta dimyatva la ashkachu:

ohc: Veim kacha at ose li vegomer. perush, chash ki yomar Adonai elav laset beal karcho, hagam shello yuchal, al menat ken yaavod Adonai ad yetziat neshama, dichtiv (Devarim 6:5) "bechol nafshecha". laze amar veim vegomer hargeni na, perush, atta masar nafsho velo yissa od hammassa levaddo. venatan hattaam veal ere beraati, perush, davar haggorem ra lannefesh shealav yakpidu hatztzaddikim. veharaa asher aleha tzaak libbo hi sheim yaharguhu yisrael yitchayyevu kelaya venimtza sheggarmu lo lehaanisham. gam laze yechashev tachalue hannefesh, al derech maamar (Mishlei 17:26) "gam anosh latztzaddik" vegomer.

Vechafal lomar hargeni na harog, lomar sheharug hu im lo yahargehu Adonai, ki vadday sheyyaharguhu yisrael, veim ken keshe horeg oto eno horeg ella adam harug, gavra ketila katil, vetevat "harog" nidreshet benikkud shuruk. verazal amru (yalkut Bamidbar 735; midrash tehillim 23) veze leshonam: im lo etten hem horgim oti, veim adabber kenegdecha atta horgeni. vehakkatuv yechavven lechol hadderachim.

El moshe vegomer. taam keriat moshe, ledivrehem zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni) sheamru shehayu temeim, kara lemoshe kede lehakkir toldot happerisha shepperash moshe, shennimtza muchan lidvar Adonai elav been monea, asher lo chen hem shekkeraam Adonai velo yachlu latzet. ulefi happeshat kede sheyyihye muchan moshe lehitpallel al miryam. od taam keriat moshe letzad shennitkavven Adonai legallot lahem techef umiyyad beseder hakkeria ki gadol moshe mehem mimma shehikdimo lahem bakkeria vehishmiam haddavar, uvaze yargishu setira lemachshavtam sheamru "harak bemoshe halo gam banu" vegomer:

Lo yom echad vegomer. taam arkan shel devarim, vehakkavvana bahem, lefi ma shepperashnu bemaamar "vaachaltem basar" ki mitzvat melech hu lechayyevam leechol, uletzad sheyyesh lecha adam shettashlim taavato baachilat basar beyom echad, veyesh bishnayim, veyesh bachamishsha, veyesh baasara, veyesh beesrim, veyomar haadam "hinne hishlamti taavati" velo yochal od, laze ba devar melech lehammashlim taavato beyom echad katav azhara "lo yom echad", ulehammashlim taavato bishnayim baa alav haazhara "velo yomayim", vechen kullam, vehigbil lahem sheloshim yom bechiyyuv haachila kede sheyyimasuhu vehaya lezara beteva enoshi temurat hattaava bo, umeatta kol hamevattel meachilato yom echad hare ze avar al lav uvittel mitzvat ase:

rashi: Ki en chartzubbot lemotam. leshon asira, kemo "patteach chartzubbot resha" (yeshaya 58:6), masgere kavle resha sheosrin bahen haaniyyim. af kan: en yissurin lemitatam, hammetim bahem mehem beriim keulam, belo yissurin. verabbotenu pershu chartzubbot notrikon: sheen charedin veatzvin miyyom hammita (shabbat lo:). davar acher: sheen hakkadosh baruch hu meacher tzivyonam (perush retzonam):
targum: Arum letehon tavhin umitztaarin metul yom mitathon itbaayan machshevathon ufatim vealim libbehon:

ohc: Heanochi hariti vegomer. dibber beseder ze, yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 19:) shekkol hamelammed ben chavero tora keillu yelado, gam amru zichronam livracha (Tikkunei Zohar 70) shekkol nishmot am bene yisrael dor hammidbar hayu anfe nishmato shel moshe rabbenu vehu haya lahem leav. laze lo amar haav ani laam hazze o im banay hem, ki chen hu kefi haemet, shehu haya av lenishmotam venikraim banav gam ken letzad shellimmedam tora, ella heanochi hariti perush keneged tzad heyotam anafav amar, ma bechach, kevan shello hora gever mehem lo yitchayyev betippulam, ucheneged shennikraim banav letzad shellimmedam tora amar, im anochi yelidtihu, ki davka ben habba derech leda lo habba meemtzaut limmud tora.

Od nitkavven bechefel hariti vilidtihu lomar shehammassa shealav shel haam hu kemassa shel av veshel em yachad, sheddome leven sheyyeladattu immo umeta, shehaav yaase maase haav vehaem. veulay gam ken sheramaz lishne zemannim shechayyav haav lissa ol habben, haechad hu devar tora shehu ad ben shesh ad ben sheva (ketuvot 65:), vehashsheni middivre sofrim ad ben shelosh esre shana (ketuvot mat.). vahagam sheadayin lo tikkenu chazal tosefet zeman ze, hu inyan muskol ledaat enosh, umikkol shekken moshe shehaya navi. vetimtza sheamru razal (yoma koach:) kiyyem avraham avinu afillu eruve tavshilin hagam sheadayin lo tikkenum, kemo chen yada nevi Adonai mittakkanat chazal. veamar al shene hazzemannim heanochi hariti keneged chiyyuv hattora, im anochi yelidtihu keneged chiyyuv divrehem.

Uferush tevat hei shel heanochi hi hei hahannacha, perush, shemmitratztze moshe lehitchayyev bema shechayyav haav labben vaafillu chiyyuv shel divrehem, veaf al pi chen hinne elle anashim gedolim hemma lemala mizzeman hakkatzuv, velamma atta omer elay "saehu vechekecha" leadam gadol beshanim? lu yehe shehem banay – hareni patur mehem. veod chozer vetoen: lu yehe sheyyadun bahem din katan letzad shehem mushelalim behassagat hammazon vedinam kekatan, af al pi chen lo mitchayyev laasot ma sheshshoalim mimmenni latet lahem basar. vehu amro meayin li basar, perush, bishlama im hayu shoalin mazon hatztzarich – yitchayyev middin av, aval hem shoalin motarot. veod, hagam shehem motarot, im haya lo al haav leshashea beno kefi yechalto, aval meayin li vegomer?
Veaviha yarok yarak vegomer. hilbish shiur haddevarim bah, velo amar haav im yarok bifne bitto vechulei, lomar shehi bemadregat bat shehi madregat hatztzaddikim.

Vechafal lomar yarok yarok, lomar sheim haya tzoek lo kodem lo haya rokek befaneha, veze hu shiur haddevarim: veaviha yarok perush kesheggarma sheyyarak befaneha velo haya mi sheyyeratztzehu shello larok ad sheyyarak, vehu amro yarak paam sheniyya vegomer, ha lamadta sheim haya ofen shehaya mitpallel moshe kodem lo hayta neeneshet.
