Tissager shivat yamim. nire shepparcha mimmenna tzaraat bitfillat moshe, uchemaamaro "refa na" perush atta, ella sheggazar Adonai shetteshev kimnudda, sheim lo chen lo haya tzarich hakkatuv lomar "tissager", peshita shettissager ad shettitrappe mitztzaratah, ella vadday shekkevar nitrappea, velaze gam ken lo hizkir taharat tzaratah beyom asifatah. uledivre razal (zevachim kav.; sifre) sheaharon lo raa tzaraat miryam mittaam kureva, yitbaer al nachon, ki letzad sheen kan tzaraat ki en kohen sheyyomar tame, im ken en kan ella segira levad kimnudda. o efshar shennisgera al pi Adonai elohenu shehu kohen, vehu amro tissager vegomer hare hasegara, venithara al pi Adonai dichtiv veachar teasef.

Veze maase hammenora vegomer. taam shehutzrach lomar pasuk ze paam acheret kan, velo hispik ma sheamar kevar befarashat teruma uvefarashat vayyakhel, yityashshev ben leman deamar la kevie nerot, shebba lehasir michshol hattaut hannimshach mimmaamar "behaalotcha" sheamarnu shehaya mefarek vechozer umaale otam, umizze tavo hassevara lomar ki gam shear hammenora en chiyyuv bekiyyumah miksha, shehare gam hannerot bichlal chelek mehammenora hem, umatzinu shehem meforakim, venadun mehem kedin davar shehaya bichlal veyatza vechulei lelammed al hakkelal, shehagam sheamar hakkatuv "miksha" ze haya bitchilla, aval achar kach yachol laasot kaasher yachpotz. laze amar veze maase hammenora miksha vegomer, shekken hi omedet, umimmotza davar atta lamed ki hannerot yatzu mehakkelal miksha shel hammenora velo tilmod mehem. uleman deamar kevie nerot gam ken ba lehodia sheamda hammenora bemaase miksha gam achar shehishtammeshu bah.

rashi: Lesitno. lehasetino, al shehayu banav nesuim nashim nachriyyot, kemo shekkatuv besefer ezra: "vayyimmatze mibbene hakkohanim asher hoshivu nashim nachriyyot mibbene yehoshua ben yehotzadak" (Ezra 10:18):
targum: Veachzeyani yat yehoshua kahana rabba kaem kodam malacha dayya vechataa kaem al yemineh leasatana leh:

ohc: Vayyichar af Adonai meod. taam meod, letzad shekkol ose risha letzad tigboret happittuy vaarevut haissur yesh ladun bo tzad haones, aval ellu shemmevakshim lashuv hare hem kimgarim bahem yetzer hara veen gader ra gadol baze.

Uveene moshe ra. ki yakpid haish al maase yadav, vetze ulemad mimma shenneemar bishmuel (taanit 5.) shechisseru miyyamav shello yire baraa asher timtza et shaul, uchemo chen ra al moshe maase bilti hagun shel yisrael. od yirtze al ze hadderech shera beene moshe ma shechara Adonai appo meod kol kach, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (sifre chelek 1 95) shehera Adonai lemoshe puranut sheatid lehavi veamar lefanav: "ribbono shel olam, vechi hagun hu shettitten lahem basar vetahargem" vechulei, ad kan:

Ki im el artzi vegomer elech. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar tevat elech, vahalo muvan hu meamro "lo elech ki im" vegomer? yitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (mechilta yitro) veze leshonam: "vayshallach moshe et chotno", rabbi yehoshua omer shillecho mikkevodo shel olam, rabbi elazar hammodai omer amar lo: kelum hanner mehanne ella bimkom hachoshech? ma ani mehanne ben chamma ulevana? ella ani holech leartzi umegayyer kol bene medina vaaviem lilmod vechulei. yachol halach velo asa chen? hare omer (Shoftim 1:16) "uvene keni" vegomer. mittoch divrehem mashma sherabbi yehoshua sover sheyyitro lo nitgayyer, veshillecho moshe mikkevodo shel olam, ulerabbi elazar nitgayyer. uledivre shenehem yityashshev yittur elech al nachon. lerabbi yehoshua nitkavven lomar al ze hadderech: lo elech ki im el artzi, velo letaam chavivut artzi levad, aval zulat ze hayiti yoshev, lo chen hu ella elech al kol panim. velisvarat rabbi elazar al ze hadderech: lo elech perush, lachalutin bahalicha zo, ki im el artzi veel moladti perush, el asher yeot livne artzi umoladti, elech legayyeram velashuv. vechafal lomar "artzi umoladti" lomar: im emtza makom agayyer kol bene medinati, ulefachot bene moladti.

Nosim anachnu vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar ze, halo yadua haya haddavar lahem? verabbotenu zichronam livracha hirgishu mizze veamru (sifre Bamidbar 10:29) shennitkavven bemaamar ze lomar shello nishar lahem ella nesia achat veyaggiu limchoz cheftzam. veyitbaer od hakkatuv behair bemaamar oto etten lachem shello haya lo lomar tevat "oto". achen letzad shello hivtiach Adonai behavetachotav laavotenu latet lanu ella eretz kenaan velo eretz sichon veog, uchemaamaram zichronam livracha (sifre Devarim 299) uchetavnuhu lemala (Bamidbar 7:42), uletzad shehayu az nosim leeretz sichon veog amar lechovav: "nosim anachnu el hammakom asher amar Adonai oto etten" gam ken "lachem", hagam shello netano laavotenu yitten oto lanu, ki yada binvua ma sheatid lihyot. vahagam sheamru besifre (sham) veze leshonam: perat leeretz sichon veog shennetaltem meatzmechem, ad kan, af al pi chen hiskim Adonai unetanah lahem.

Od nitkavven bemaamar oto etten lachem, ramaz ki eretz sichon veog yittenem Adonai lahem, bechinnuy, lirmoz gam el moshe ki hu lechadah vehorishah lishne hammattot vachatzi hammatte, vedikdek lomar "oto" lemaet eretz kenaan ki lo lemoshe yittenenna ella lihoshua.

Lecha ittanu vehetavnu lach vegomer. kavvanat haddevarim hu letzad sheamru zichronam livracha (sifre 9 132) eretz yisrael nitchalleka lashshevatim velo laggerim, umeatta en makom latet chelek venachala livne chovav toch yisrael zulat bederech mattana mechelkam, velaze keshebba moshe lehaveticho dikdek lomar lo vehetavnu lach perush mechelek yisrael yittenu lo betorat hatava. uletzad shechash moshe shello yachpetzu bemaamar moshe mechamesh sibbot asher yesubbevu mehaddavar, shalosh yesubbevu mibbechinat hammattana, ushetayim mibbechinat hahavtacha. shalosh mibbechinat hammattana: 1 letzad sheyyitbayyesh hannishpa mehammashpia, al derech amram (yerushalmi arla 1,3) man deachil delav dileh vechulei, 2 letzad sheyyitmaet kevod hammekabbel mattana beene hannoten velo yihye omed beenav bakkavod harishon, 3 letzad hameatat hammattana beerech adam gadol tihye lo lecherpa veyimas metziutah mehederah. shetayim mibbechinat hahavtacha: 1 mitztzad sheyyesh lachush sheyyinnachem middevaro hattov asher dibber laasot, o mitztzad tzarut ayin ki tera eno mittet mittuvo, o ki yitmaet ahavat hammuvtach mimmennu belibbo, vehav letzad shello tassig yado asot, uchemaamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 26) befasuk "imrot Adonai imrot tehorot", velaze nitchakkem moshe benoam devarav vehesir kol hechamesh chashashot hannizkarim.

Ufetach devarav heiru bemaamar lecha ittanu vehetavnu vegomer, perush bead halichatcha immanu hetavnu lach, umeatta hahatava enah bechinnam veyachol litboa ulehotzi bedayyanim, uvederech ze husar mechush habbusha deman deachil delav dileh, gam mechush hameatat bichvodo letzad shennehena mimmennu, gam mechush bittul hahavtacha ki yitnachem shehare eno holech immam veozev artzo venachalato ella bitnay ze. veamro vehetavnu lach kan peresh shiur hahatava sheyyihye chelek bene chovav muvchar vatov mikkol chelek am bene yisrael sheyyittenu lo chelek hammuvchar, vechen amru razal (sifre Bamidbar 10:29) shennatnu lo dashnah shel yericho.

Veamro ki Adonai dibber tov, baze satar shene hammechushim shennisharu mehammechushim sherashamnu, vehem: hameatat hahatava umeniat heseg yad lekayyem habbittachon, ki Adonai dibber tov vetovat Adonai muflet hi, uleshiur ze tihye hahatava gedolat haerech ureuya lehitkabbed, gam chazaka uveria veen bah chazara ki Adonai lo ish hu vegomer veyitnecham, uvifrat middevaro hattov, ki davka al haraa hu shennicham dichtiv (Shemot 32:14) "vayyinnachem Adonai al haraa". vedikdek lomar "al yisrael" letosefet chizzuk hattov, letzad shehu leyisrael velo leummot haolam, velo yinnachem al hattova lahem.

Hayad Adonai tiktzar vegomer hayikrecha devari vegomer. yitbaer al pi shene hadderachim shekkatavnu, ladderech harishon shepperashnu shettemihat moshe hayta ki lo yistappeku kullam bemin basar hannittan lahem vetaromtam omedet laad, hodio Adonai ki yesh yecholet beyado latet min basar sheyyemalle kol taavatam bo, vehu maamar hayad Adonai tiktzar, perush latet bemin basar echad de sippukam kol asher yitauu kol hammitavvim. veamro atta tire hayikrecha devari, perush davar echad sheani ose o dibbur echad sheamarti laasot yihye yakar kol kach sheyyesh bo histappekut lechol chelke hattaavot sheyyecholin lihyot, sheyyitten lahem min basar sheyyesh bo kol mine basar sheyyecholin lihyot baolam. veshiur tevat yikrecha hu yihye yakar etzlecha keshettire yekar happeulla. o yitparesh yikrecha yihye lecha mimmennu yekar kesheyyitten Adonai al yede moshe min habbasar sheen kamohu yihye lemoshe yekar ugedulla beene yisrael lehaamin bo uvinvuato veyityakker beenehem.

Ulederech sheni shekkatavnu shettemihat moshe hayta lechashvo shehabbasar shemmimmennu yisbeu bene yisrael hu mehannimtza, aval mehannes, lo yaase nes ledavar kaze, amar Adonai elav hayad Adonai tiktzar perush haim nachon sheyyad Adonai chas veshalom tiktzar, veim ken im lo naase hannes yomru ki lo taggia yad elyona asot mevukkasham, velaze yachpotz Adonai asot nes shello kesidro bishvil chillul hashshem, velaze gamar omer atta tire bema sheani ose tire hayikrecha devari vegomer, perush yihye yakar beenecha mikkan ulehala devari, perush davar hannogea li lichvodi, keshettire sheani mekalkel hashshura veose nes lashsheker bishvili shello yechallelu shemi, mizze teda shiur hakepadati al haddavar im gadol o katan hu. vetimtza razal (kiddushin 40.) shehifliu lomar beinyan chillul hashshem shehakepadato gedola.

Vehaish moshe anav. hodia hakkatuv zo kan, lefi ma shekkatavnu sheddibberu befanav natan hakkatuv taam shehutzrach Adonai laasot kol haamur bainyan, mittaam ki haish moshe anav meod uletzad anvetanuto nimna millehashiv lahem hatteshuva hammitchayyevet lavo bainyan kede sheyyedu hahefresh shebben nevuat moshe lishar neviim. vedikdek lomar mikkol haadam asher al pene haadama, lehachelit meniat hatteshuva mimmennu bainyan, ki adam shebbedato hu lematta chas veshalom mikkol asher al pene haadama, ech yeshuar chas veshalom sheyyomar teshuva sheyyetze mimmenna shehu gadol mikkol hanneviim. velaze ba maamar meAdonai veheshivam pitom. letzad sheinnu (leshon onaa) moshe bidvarim, uchetiv (Amos 7:7-8) "hinne Adonai nitztzav al chomat anach", verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (yalkut) pitom – samuch lezika vechulei:

Veyesh asher vegomer yamim mispar. gam ze mesapper beshevach yisrael, shehagam shello yachanu lafush ella yamim muatim – yisu behealot heanan. veamar al pi Adonai yachanu, veen shayyachut lezichron shenehem ella lemassa, nitkavven lehashevot hannesia lachaniyya, lomar: keshem sheal pi Adonai yachanu beratzon vehashelamat daat lanuach mehadderech, kemo chen baratzon hashshalem hayu nosim, hagam shehayu nochim zeman muat.

Veraiti shettirgem yonatan ben uziel "yamim mispar" – shivat yomin, ulefi devarav zichrono livracha en makom lidvarenu lomar shebba leshabbeach yisrael ki yesh bemeshech shiva yamim lanuach min hadderech. velidvarav zichrono livracha yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech, shebba lomar shebben beferek hachaniyya uven beferek hannesia, hagam shehaya lahem haratzon, lo hayu osim haddavar ella letzad heyot haddavar maamaro yitbarach, vehu amro al pi Adonai yachanu veal pi Adonai yissau:

rashi: Ashre haish. baasara leshonot shel zemer neemar sefer ze, benitztzuach, beniggun, bemizmor, beshir, behallel, bitfilla, bivracha, behodaa, beashre, behaleluyah, keneged asara bene adam sheamaruhu, adam, malki tzedek, avraham, moshe, david, shelomo, asaf, ushelosha bene korach, vachalukin al yedutun (Kohelet Rabba 7,39). yesh omrim: adam haya kemo shekkatuv bedivre hayyamim (divrei hayamim 1 16:38), veyesh omrim: en yedutun shebbesefer ze ella al shem haddatot vehaddinim shel gezerot sheavru alav veal yisrael:
Ashre haish. (940 109) ishshurav shel ish utehillotav shel adam ellu hem asher lo halach, ki mittoch shello halach lo amad, umittoch shello amad lo yashav:
Letzim. (512 109. milla nishnet gaabaaras 33 shapeatetaar:)
targum: Tuveh digvar dela halich bemilkat rashiin uveorchat chayavin la kam uvesiat memikne la istechar:

ohc: Vayyaan yehoshua vegomer kelaem. tzarich ladaat al mi samach yehoshua lehorot lifne rabbo, uma gam lehoroto ko vecho taase, veze mehazzarut. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (eruvin 63.) kol demotiv milla kodam rabbeh azel bela velad, shenneemar "vayyaan yehoshua" vegomer. veefshar latet taam lemaase yehoshua al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (sifre) sheamru veze leshonam: ma nevua amru? moshe met yehoshua machnis, ad kan. laze kesheshshama yehoshua haddevarim, bachar ledabber lifne rabbo kede sheyyegalle dato ki meusim haddevarim etzlo veomrehem, vechi sheker befihem. uvaze shalal hachashad ki yachpotz hu baddevarim hanneemarim lemaalato vegilla hahafkiyyut birtzono.

Vayyomer adoni moshe kelaem – perush, ten otam bammishmar ad asher yavo devar melech mishpat asot, o kallem min haolam. vetaam haddavar ben lisvarat haomer chutz mehashshivim ben lisvarat haomer mehashshivim, mehatteamim shekkatavnu. veulay sheramaz beamro adoni moshe, sheeno chafetz heyot hu adon ella heyot lo adono moshe, lishlol haratzon banneemar ki yamut moshe vehu yachnis. viduyyak gam ken maamar vayyaan sheasa teshuva laddevarim hanneemarim alav bannevua hahi, ki lo dibberu nechona utzerichin linnaten bevet kele. veaf al pi chen anasho hakkatuv, ki sof sof heshiv davar bifne rabbo (divrei hayamim 1 7:27).

Vayyered Adonai beammud anan. tzarich ladaat lamma lo yarad Adonai kodem keria rishona, shennire misseder hakketuvim shello yarad ella achar keria. gam mimma sheamar bakkeria "tzeu shelashtechem el ohel moed" ze yaid sheadayin lo yarad, sheim lo chen lo haya tzarich lirshom lahem hammakom, ki hem roim makom asher yishkon sham heanan. uledivrehem shekkatavnu shehayu temeim bishat hakkeria yesh taam nachon baddavar, ki lo ratza Adonai laredet kodem hakkeria veyihye yoshev umamtin lahem kivyachol letzetam, veeno mehakkavod. gam yimmashech lahem chas veshalom onesh lannikraim, veen hakkadosh baruch hu chafetz lehaanish ella lehetiv. vehattaam sheyyarad Adonai velo dibber mimmekomo keseder hakkeria, kede lefarsem haddavar kesheyyiru sheyyarad heanan veamad petach haohel, vehu pirsum veheara gedola, veyivvada lechol yisrael ki hikpid Adonai al asher nagu beneeman beto veheenisham al haddavar.

Hitkaddeshu lemachar vegomer. taam shello natan ad machar, lefi divrehem zichronam livracha (sifre kan) sheddarshu betevat "hitkaddeshu", veze leshonam: hazeminu atzmechem lefureanut, ad kan. laze lo ratza Adonai latet lahem techef umiyyad, ad shehodiam ki pureanut hu noten lahem bintinat habbasar, vehitra bahem veheerich lahem zeman veamar ad lemachar, uvaze yihye lahem hallayla lecheshbon hannefesh, ulay yashuvu bitshuva veyinnachem Adonai al haraa, ki lo yachpotz Adonai lehashechit ammo.

Vaachaltem basar. amar vaachaltem betosefet vav ledivrehem zichronam livracha (sifre) sheamar lahem hachinu atzmechem vechulei, kefi ze yutzdak lomar "vaachaltem", ki hu hodaat inyan nosaf al harishon: hitkaddeshu lefureanut, veod vaachaltem basar.

Ki bechitem vegomer. mashma ki yakpid Adonai al habbechi, vetzarich ladaat ma kiur yesh babbechi mitztzad atzmo. venire ki taam hahakpada hu letzad shehabbechi yore al chissaron hammuchlat bishlilat hahassaga, sheim lo chen haya lahem lishol meAdonai keven hashshoel meaviv et asher teavve nafsho, umimma shebbachu yore ki haddavar muchlat etzlam ki Adonai en lo koach chas veshalom latet sheelatam, vehu ma sheddikdek lomar mi yaachilenu, lomar en mi sheyyuchal asot davar ze. vechen timtza bo sheamru razal (sifre) sheamru yisrael en koach vechulei, vezo kefira bicholet hayyachol al kol baruch hu. veayyen bappasuk sheachare ze.

Beazne Adonai. perush, shello chashu ledabber kaddevarim haelle, hagam she shochen betocham, vehammedabberim margishim veyodim ki shomea shochen betocham, veyesh baze chatzifut gedola ad meod lomar divre kefira beazne Adonai, veayyen bappasuk sheachar ze:

Ki tov lanu vegomer. tzarich ladaat kavvanat amro tevat ki ki, gam en lah shiur nachon bekotev lashon hannishma. veulay sheyyodia hakkatuv ki kol kach atzma taavat habbasar ad shebbacharu bemitzrayim leechol bah basar. od yitbaer hakkatuv al ze hadderech ki bechitem beazne Adonai lemor, perush, taam habbechi shehishmatem leazne Adonai hu "mi yaachilenu basar", ze haya begeder hammaamar, aval ruach hakkodesh bochen libbotam yodea ki cheftzam betachlit haddevarim hu ki yoter tov lahem mitzrayim, ki bocharim eretz mitzrayim mishshevet bishchunat hashshechina, velaze chara af Adonai bahem veamar hazeminu atzmechem lefuranut. uvaze timtza nachat ruach bemaamar Adonai sheamar levassof yaan meastem et Adonai asher bekirbechem vegomer, velo matzinu shehuzkar ze bedivrehem, ulefi ma shepperashnu yityashshev al nachon. gam yeduyyak amro meastem et Adonai beyitron tevat "et", ki nitkavven lomar shemmaasu lihyot im Adonai hashshochen ittam vechoshkim beeretz mitzrayim.

Venatan Adonai lachem basar vaachaltem. tzarich ladaat lamma chazar lomar haddevarim sheamar besamuch. od shello hispik bemaamar "venatan" vegomer veamar vaachaltem, vahalo muvan hu haddavar sheyyochlu hannittan lahem. venire sheyyechavven hakkatuv lomar lahem shehagam sheamar "hitkaddeshu lemachar" vegomer uferashnuhu shebba lomar sheyyachzeru bitshuva velo yihye puranut, velaze natan lahem zeman ad machar, kol ze yihye kodem netinat habbasar lahem, aval achar sheyyitten lahem habbasar lo toil hacharata vehatteshuva lahem shello yochluhu, vehu maamar venatan Adonai lachem basar az vaachaltem, tzerichin attem leechol bechiyyuv. uvederech remez kafal lomar ken lirmoz lahem sheim yachzeru bitshuva gam ken al kol panim yochlu basar, ki yatza devar melech shilton, vehem lo hevinu haddevarim, o hevinu velo hitzdiku.

rashi: Hasiru habbegadim hatztzoim mealav. yavdilu banav et neshotehem, veyimchol lo:
Machalatzot. chalifot begadim naim, kelomar: zechuyyot. aval lefi sheddimma heavon livgadim tzoim, dimma hazzechuyyot lemachalatzot begadim naim ulevanim:
targum: Vaativ vaamar ledimshamshin kodamohi lememar vaamaru leh veyappek neshin dela chashrin lichhuneta mibbeteh vaamar leh chaze deadeti minach chovach vealbishat yatach zachvan:

ohc: Bashshana hashshenit bachodesh vegomer. hikdim zichron hashshana lezichron hachodesh, kede lehasemich maamar "naala heanan" lemaamar "beesrim lachodesh", ki chen hu yofi shiur haddibbur.

rashi: Tefilla lemoshe. achad asar mizmorim mikkan ad "ledavid mizmor" (tehillim 101:1), kullam moshe amaram. kenegdam berach achad asar berachot leachad asar shevatim bezot habberacha (Devarim 33:1):
Maon atta hayita lanu. maon mador umanos lavo sham hayita lanu:
Bedor vador. meolam, ki atta mikkedem hakkol hayita:
targum: Tzelota detzale moshe neviya dayya kad chavu ama vet yisrael bemadbera ane vechen amar Adonai demador bet shechintach bishmaya at haveta lana saed bechol dar vadar:

ohc: Vayyichar af Adonai. perush gera bahem hannecherim bahem shehem kat haaf, vayyelach kede sheyyaase haaf ma shehuresha. vahagam shebbassene amar hakkatuv (Shemot 4:14) "vayyichar af Adonai bemoshe", sham rasham shiur asher yifal bo haaf, vehu sheyyasur mimmennu koach hanneshama shehi bechinat hakkehuna vetinnaten leaharon, kemaamar rabbotenu zichronam livracha (zevachim kav.; Shemot Rabba 83) sheharoshem hu hasarat hakkehuna. vechan asa haaf mishpat gadol shehatztzaraat hi kemita kaamur bainyan, uvishnehem haya haonesh keamro bam. vechen amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sifre) "vayyifen" vegomer pana mitztzarato, ella shemmiryam lo nitrappea keaharon techef umiyyad, velo yada adam mitztzarato.

targum: Vahava pitgam nevua min kodam Adonai imi lememar:
Beleut gavrin demitaskin beorayta letehon lain veim bene nasha tzadike desachlin yesure la mitkatteshin:
Kafnim lechod tzachayan nafshathon tishtalhaya:
Vetav malacha dimmalel imi vaairani kegavra demitar mishnateh:
Vaativ malacha demalel imi vaamar li hala yedata man inun ilen vaamaret li ribboni:
Bui vachadi kenishta detzion are ha ana mitgele veashre shechinti vegavich amar Adonai:
Beidana hahi amar Adonai tzevaot tearun gevar lechavreh litchot pere gufenohi velitchot pere tenohi:
Umearata kanshinun mimadincha umimaarava mitzippuna umin yama daroma:

bart: Mane li veyadecha veamar lo hen. bifne edim. uchegon sheamar attem eday, deshuv eno yachol liton meshatte hayiti vecha:
Patur. mishshevua deorayta. aval mashbiin oto hesset:
En lecha veyadi. lo hayu devarim meolam:
Chayyav. leshallem. veeno neeman bishvua, shehare huchzak kafran. vehu shekkafar bevet din, aval shello vevet din lo huchzak kafran:
Seor. shello hechmitz kol tzarko: [saduk]. derech habbatzek keshemmachmitz naase sedakim sedakim:
Kekarne chagavim. sedek lechan vesedek lechan:

Ze vaze haochlo chayyav karet. dekarne chagavim nammi hu saduk. veezehu seor sheppatur, ze sheen bo shum sidduk, aval hichsifu fanav keadam sheamdu saarotav mittoch pachad [sheppanav machsifin]. vahalacha kachachamim:
Lo matzu mishsheva. mishshum daamaran demikkol chattaot shehayu sham mazzin alav, mishshum hachi kaamar deim lo matzu mishsheva, mazzin afillu meechat:
Vechamesh meezra vaelach. rabbi meir lo mane haarba sheasu shimon hatztzaddik veyochanan kohen gadol ella lishtayim, mishshum disvira leh sheal yede fesul sheera barishona naaset hashsheniyya:
Vachachamim omrim sheva meezra vaelach. disvira lehu shekkullan kesherot hayu:

Batzek shebbesidke areva. veasuy lechazzek shevareha usedakeha. im yesh kazzayit bemakom echad chayyav levaer, pachot mikkan batel bemiut. veim eno asuy lechazzek, afillu pachot mikkazzayit chayyav levaer, lefi sheeno mevattelo sham veefshar sheyyimmalech veyittelennu mishsham:

Vechen leinyan hattuma. im naga sheretz behay batzek befesach sheissuro choshvo, im yesh bo chazzayit chotzetz bifne hattuma velo have chaareva velo nachata la tuma laareva. uvefachot mikkazzayit, im eno makpid alav batel legabbe areva vehave keillu naga hashsheretz baareva atzmah vehi temea:

Im makpid alav chotzetz. hachi kaamar, uvishar yemot hashshana sheen issuro choshvo, en haddavar taluy beshiur im yesh bo chazzayit im lav, ella bikfeda talya milleta, im hikpid alav veatid littelo mishsham chotzetz bifne hattuma, ben yesh bo chazzayit ben en bo chazzayit, velo nachata tuma laareva, veim lo hikpid alav verotze vekiyyumo, afillu yesh bo kamma zetim hare hu chaareva, ucheshennogea hashsheretz babbatzek have keillu naga baareva mammash:
Batzek hacheresh. shemmakkin alav bayyad veeno mashmia kol vedome lecheresh shekkorin lo veeno meshiv. perush acher, batzek hacheres, shehu kashe checheres veeno nikkar im hechmitz:

Im yesh kayyotze vo shehechemitz. im yesh issa acheret shennillosha beshaa shezzo nillosha uchevar hechmitza, asur. veim en sham kayyotze vo, have shiurah kede sheyyehallech adam mil bahalicha venonit. veshiur ze kizman shene chumshe shaa:
Serafah shello veetzim. shehitztzit haur begufah shel para:
Keshera. shello nichtav battora etzim, ella vesaraf setam:
O vechol etzim. shello serafah baarazim oranim uveroshim vaatze teena hashshenuyim befirkin dilel:
Hifshitah venittechah keshera. deet orah veet besarah ketiv, ben behefshet venittuach ben bimchubbar:

Al menat leechol mibbesarah o lishtot middamah keshera. davka leechol velishtot hu demachshir tanna kamma, divchol hakkarbanot nammi ki hay gavna kasher, keditnan beferek kol happesulim [zevachim la] chashav leechol davar sheen darko leechol, kasher, kegon meachilat mizbeach leadam. aval chashav al menat lehazzot middamah lemachar, pasal tanna kamma, dechattat karya rachamana. verabbi eliezer savar deen machashava foselet bappara kelal, afillu vahazzaot. veazda letaameh divshello lishmah machshir beresh pirkin, sheen lah din middine kadashim, hoil vehi naaset bachutz. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Vechippa cheneged haotem. ragle hakkippa shehakkippa nishenet alehem nikrain otem. veen ragle hakkippa haelyona keneged ragle hattachtona, ella cheneged hakkippa atzmah, dichneged otem haelyona omed chalal hattachtona:
Mippene kever hattehom. shello tihye sham tuma retzutza shehi vokaat veola:
Ufara vechol mesaadeha. somcheha veozreha. leshon Adonai‏ yisadennu al eres devay (tehillim ma). veaf al gav defara enah mekabbelet tuma mechayyim, maala yetera asu vah:
Hemit shorcha et avdi. kenasa hu, dimshallem sheloshim selaim afillu eno shave ella dinar:
Amar lo avdo hippalta et shinni. kenasa hu sheyyotzi avdo lecherut bishvil echad meevarav:
Ad sheyyishmeu mippi hattovea. dichtiv (sham) im lo yaggid, male bevav vealef. lemidrash hachi, im lo lo yaggid, kelomar lattovea, venasa avono, ha im leacher lo yaggid patur:

Sheamar ish peloni litten li vechulei‏ peturim. dichtiv bishvuat haedut techeta, uchetiv bishvuat happikkadon techeta, ma shevuat happikkadon al teviat mamon sheyyesh lo al chavero, af shevuat haedut tzarich shettihye al teviat mamon sheyyesh lo alav, veze shettoen sheamar ish peloni litten li matayim zuz enah teviat mamon sheyyesh lo al chavero, sheafillu hu chidvarav sheamar lo chavero sheyyitten lo matayim zuz en chavero chayyav bo chelum bishvil amira zo:
Sheyyesh beyado besar kodesh. shennifsal beyotze. shechomat yerushalayim hi mechitztza lekadashim [kallim]:
Im avar tzofim. shem makom shemmishsham roim bet hammikdash:
Sorfo vimkomo. velo hitrichuhu lachazor:
Veim lav chozer vesorfo. dichtiv (Vayikra 6) bakkodesh lo teachel baesh tissaref, bimkom achilato serefato:
Ze vaze. chametz deamrinan leel venizkar sheyyesh lo chametz betoch beto vechulei, uvesar kodesh sheimmo:

Kabbetza. aval befachot, chametz mevattelo velibbo, uvesar kodesh sorfo vimkomo. vesavar rabbi meir chazarato chetumato, ma tumat ochalin bechabbetza sheen ochel mittamme befachot mikkabbetza, kach eno chozer al pachot mikkabbetza:
Rabbi yehuda omer ze vaze vechazzayit. savar chazarato cheissuro, ma issuro bechazzayit, sheal kazzayit chametz o besar kodesh chayyav, kach al kazzayit chozer:
Besar kodesh. mishshum chumra dekadashim chozer af al kazzayit, chametz dechullin eno chozer ella al kabbetza. vahalacha kachachamim:
Im lo raiti gamal poreach baavir. kelomar yeasru kol perot shebbaolam alay im lo raiti vechulei‏:
Nachash kekorat bet habbad. ketavnit korat bet habbad vetzuratah. deillu koovi korat bet habbad lo have shevuat shav, deikka tuva:
Shevua shello neidecha. bittul mitzva hi, deha chayyav lehaid shenneemar (Vayikra 5) im lo yaggid venasa avono:
Gerar atzmot aviv. mishshum kappara. velo kevaro lefi chevodo al mitta naa, kede sheyyitganne al risho veyivvasru harshaim:
Kittet nechash hannechoshet. kedichtiv bedivre hayyamim, lefi shehayu toin acharav:

Veganaz sefer refuot. lefi shello haya libbam nichna al cholyam ella mitrappeim miyyad. veharambam peresh, sefer refuot, sefer modia meinyene tzurot hakkochavim vehattelesmaot, shetztzura felonit haasuya bizman veet yadua merappet mecholi feloni, veze haya karov lehateot habberiyyot achar avodat kochavim ulechach genazo:

Ibber nisan benisan. leachar shennichnas nisan nimlach veasa adar sheni. vehakkatuv omer (Shemot 12) hachodesh hazze lachem, ze nisan, veen acher nisan. velo ibber chizkiyya leachar shennichnas nisan mammash, ella yom sheloshim shel adar ibber et hashshana, veanan kayma lan en meabberin et hashshana bishloshim shel adar, hoil verauy lekavo nisan:
Hammevi keli cheres lachattat. sheholech etzel hayyotzer liknot mimmennu keli cheres lehanniach bo efer chattat o me chattat:
Tovel velan al hakkivshan. matchil leshamran betohora shello yigga bahen am haaretz mikkodem sheyyetzarfo vakkivshan, dehu gemar melachtan lekabbel tuma:

Rabbi yehuda omer af min habbayit hu mevi vechasher. dimhemninan leh leam haaretz im omer sheshshemaro al tohorat chattat, kidamrinan beferek chomer bakkodesh deamme haaretz neemanim al tohorat yayin linsachim veshemen limnachot, shello yehe chol echad veechad bone vama leatzmo vesoref para adumma leatzmo. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Uvatteruma. im mevi cheli cheres lehanniach bo teruma:
Poteach et hakkivshan venotel. af al gav shennigmar tzerufan velo shemaran. dechevan daadayin lo niftach umale avak al gabbav, lo chayshinan shemma naga bo am haaretz, delo hechmiru vatteruma:

Rabbi shimon omer misseder hashsheni. im patach am haaretz et hakkivshan venatal mimmennu kelim, en notel misseder harishon, deyad hakkol memashmeshin bo, aval misseder hashsheni shettachat harishon share. verabbi yose machmir veasar af misseder hashsheni. veen halacha lo kerabbi shimon velo kerabbi yose, ella af al pi shemmatza hakkivshan patuach hare hakkol bechezkat tohora, velokeach af misseder harishon:
Baanashim uvenashim. ayde devae lemitne shevuat haedut noheget baanashim velo venashim kulei‏ tana vishvuat bittuy shennoheget bechol ellu:
Birchokim uvikrovim. kegon sheetten lifloni, ben rachok ben karov:
Bichsherim uvifsulim. bechasher leedut ufasul:

Mippi atzmo. shehotzi hu shevua mippiv. aval im hishbiuhu acherim achalta velo achalta, veamar lo achalti veachal o lehefech, patur im lo ana amen. veim ana amen achar shehishbio chavero, have chenishba mippi atzmo vechayyav:
Chutz miggittah. makom hayu osim lisrefatah kemin gat keneged pitcho shel hechol, veim shechatah shello cheneged pitcho shel hechol, pesula:
O vishte gittot. kegon shechillekah lishtayim vesaraf chetzyah begat zo vechetzyah begat zo:
O shessaraf shetayim begat achat. af al pi shehotzi chol achat bifne atzmah mippasla mechamat melacha, shezzo poselet et zo. aval bezo achar zo, keshera:
Velo chivven keneged happetach pesula. deel nochach pene ohel moed ketiv:

Mishshishshit sheviit. desheva peamim ketiv, kesidran, vehu mana sheviit kodem shishshit, vechazar vehizza sheviit, pesula, devainan sheyyikra lashshishshit shishshit velashsheviit sheviit. aval mishsheviit sheminit, keshera, deen sheminit behazzaot shel para veze taa bedibbur dealma:

Vechazar vehizza sheminit. lav davka, divchol inyan keshera, ben chazar vehizza ben lo chazar vehizza. veaggav resha nakteh. i nammi ha kamashma lan deaf al gav dehosif bahazzaot lo fasal, demikki gamrinhu lesheva hazzaot nigmera mitzvatah, vetu lo chayshinan lema shehu mosif:
Vehem yodim lo edut ed mippi ed vechulei‏ peturim. sheim heiduhu lo hayta edutan moelet lo kelum:
Mekom shennahagu ad chatzot. ad chatzi hayyom:
Shello laasot. kede shello yehe tarud bimlacha veyishkach biur chametz ushechitat pesach vetikkun matztza shel mitzva:

Veal yeshanne adam. hachi kaamar, haholech mimmakom sheen osin lemakom sheosin notnin alav chumre makom sheyyatza mishsham velo yaase, deha dekayma lan al yeshanne adam mimminhag hair eno ella mippene hammachaloket, vechan en machaloket, demay ka amart haroe oto vatel omer ze shebbatel choshev shehammelacha asura vecholek al kullanu, lo amar hachi, ella amar en lo melacha, shehare kamma vatlanim ikka veshuka kol yemot hashshana. veha ditnan notnim alav chumre makom sheyyatza mishsham, eno ella bizman sheddato lachzor limkomo, aval en dato lachzor limkomo noheg keminhag anshe makom shehalach lesham, ben lekulla ben lechumra:

Hashshoket shebbassela. shoket hi even chalula sheal sefat hammayan, vehammayim nichnasim lah derech chor shebbedafnah, umashkin bah habbehemot. vehacha mayre vesela mechubbar shechakako, en nechshav keli hoil velo haya alav shem keli betalush. vaafillu haya talush [ella] shechibbero ulevassof chakako:

Veenah tzericha tzamid patil. im hayta veohel hammet matztzelet al ma shebbetochan bechissuy levad belo tzamid patil, lefi sheenah chashuva cheli ella chevor vedut shemmatztzilin al ma shebbetochah bechissuy belo tzamid patil, keditnan beferek Adonai‏ deohalot [mishna 6]:
Veenah poselet et hammikve. im [naflu] me geshamim mittochah lammikve, en nechshavim mayim sheuvim lifsol et hammikve:
Ufekakah. setamah:

Mippene sheenam agullim keli. kelomar sheen keli mesabbev et hammayim, denekev shellematta mevattelo mittorat keli, distima shel semartut lo meshavve leh keli. aval keshehannekev min hatztzad, yesh torat keli alav umekaddeshim bammayim shebbetocham, shehare hakkeli mesabbevan. vehayenu agullim keli:

Asa lah atara. shoket telusha shechibberah besid, shehi chashuva cheli, veasa safa shel tit lefiha saviv venitmallea hashshoket mayim ad shennitmallet gam hassafa, hammayim pesulim lekaddesh, lefi sheen hattosefet nechshevet keli:
Veim haya vari. kelomar im hassafa hazzot chazaka umehuddeket bashshoket ad sheillu tinnatel hashshoket tinnatel gam hassafa immah, kesherim:
Happesach nishchat beshalosh kittot. [ben shehatztzibbur merubbim], ben shehatztzibbur muatim vicholim kullan lishchot bevat achat, mitzva lechalek leshalosh kittot zo achar zo:
Shenneemar veshachatu oto kol kehal adat yisrael. kahal, veeda, veyisrael. hare shalosh kittot:
Baziche. kappot gedolot lekabbel bahem haddam:
Shura shekkullah kesef kesef. dehachi shappir tefe:
Velo hayu labbazichim shulayim. rechavim hayu milmala vetachtehem chaddim, kede shello yuchelu leshev al hakkarka:
Shemma yannichum. hakkohanim leshev al hakkarka ad sheyyekabbel dam acher, mechamat shehem merubbim, veyishkechum veyikrash haddam velo yihye rauy lizzarek:
Hashshochet et happesach al hechametz. kelomar uvishat shechita haya chametz birshut hashshochet o echad mibbene chavura, afillu lo haya hechametz baazara:
Over belo taase. delo tishchat al chametz dam zivchi (Shemot 34). veen hazzevach nifsal:

Af hattamid. shel ben haarbayim dearve fesachim sheshshechato al chametz, shehaya chametz birshut hashshochet o hammakriv, over belav, dedaresh zivchi, hameyuchad li, vehu hattamid. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Rabbi shimon omer happesach bearbaa asar. sheshshechato al chametz, lishmo chayyav, mishshum lo tishchat al chametz, defesach kasher hu ushechita reuya hi ushemah shechita:
Shello lishmo patur. defasul hu, ushechita sheenah reuya hi velav shemah shechita:
Ushear kol hazzevachim. shennishchatu vearbaa asar achar chatzot al hechametz:

Ben lishman ben shello lishman patur. veaf al pi shekkesherim hen, keditnan kol hazzevachim shennizbechu shello lishman kesherim vechulei, af al pi chen patur, dichtiv zivchi zivchi shete feamim, lo tishchat al chametz dam zivchi velo tizbach al chametz dam zivchi (sham 23), ulemay hilcheta palginhu rachamana velo chetav zevachay bechad kera vehakkol bemashma ben pesach ben shear zevachim, lomar lecha bizman deikka zevach, dehaynu bearbaa asar deikka fesach, lo michayyav ashshear zevachim, uvizman delekka zevach, kegon betoch happesach, michayyav ashshear zevachim im shechatan al chametz:
Uvammoed. betoch happesach, im lishmo shechato lappesach al hechametz:
Patur. millo tishchat, defesach shello vizmanno lishmo pasul, vehaveya la shechita sheenah reuya:
Shello lishmo. ella leshem shelamim:
Chayyav. dilhachi kae, vehaveya la shechita reuya, vechayyav mishshum lo tishchat, bahade lav delo yerae velo yimmatze:
Ushear kol hazzevachim. shennizbechu betoch hammoed al chametz:
Ben lishman ben shello lishman chayyav. dikra ashshear zevachim nammi azhar:
Chutz min hachattat sheshshechatah shello lishmah. difsula hi, mishshum dichtiv bishchitatah chattat hi, hi velo hannishchata shello lishmah:

Shevua shello ochal kikkar zo shevua shello ochalenna. taama deamar shello ochal vahadar amar shello ochalenna hu deeno chayyav ella achat, sheen shevua chala al shevua. aval amar techilla shello ochalenna vahadar amar shello ochal vaachalah kullah chayyav shetayim, dechi amar shello ochalenna eno chayyav ad sheyyochal kullah, vechi hadar amar shello ochal kevan sheachal mimmenna chazzayit chayyav, hilkach hashshevua haacharona chayla, umichayyav ki achel minna kazzayit, vechi hadar achal kullah michayyav mishshum shevua rishona:

Shevua shello ochalenna shevua shello ochalenna. af al gav demishshevua shello ochalenna sheniyya shaminan deen shevua chala al shevua, tana lan shevua shelishit leashmoinan dechiyyuva hu delekka ashshevuot batrayta, ha shevuot hen velo yatzu levattala, veim yimtzeu makom yachulu, sheim nishal lechacham al harishona alta sheniyya tachteha veneesar baddavar mishshum shevua sheniyya, vechen im nishal al hashshetayim chala hashshelishit. lefi shehechacham oker hanneder meikkaro vehave kemi shello nadar vechala hashsheniyya lemafrea, shehare harishona kemi sheenah hoil venishal aleha, vechen keshennishal al hashshetayim hare cheillu enam vechala hashshelishit lemafrea:
Betzat hayyotzrim. kol keli shemmatchil yotzer cheres laasot, ose techilla hachomer agol ketzurat betza veose lah bet kibbul:
Keshera. lekaddesh bah me chattat:
Verabbi yose fosel. dela chashiv leh keli. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Betzat hattarnegolet. kelippatah hachitzona:
Vachachamim poslim. sheenah chashuva cheli. vahalacha kachachamim:

Benuyot al gabbe hassela. tzur hachallamish shennikkar shehaya sham mittechillat beriyyato shel olam. veaf al pi chen hechmiru laasot tachtav chalal, mippene kever hattehom, shemma yesh tachtav kever veen lo lammet ohel chalal tefach, vetuma shehi retzutza bokaat veola, lefichach hayu vonim oto al gabbe chippin, sheafillu yesh kever tachtehen hechalal mafsiko. vechol leshon tumat hattehom shebbaggemara, leshon safek umechusse hu, kattehom hazze sheeno galuy:
Umeviim nashim meubbarot veyoldot sham. kol ellu maalot yeterot asu vah ki hechi dela lezalzole vah, mippene shehayu osim otah bitvul yom:
Umegaddelot sham et benehen. ad sheyyihyu ven shemone [shanim], velo yoter, shello yiru keri:
Umeviim shevarim. shekkeresan rechava kede shello yihyu raglav shel tinok hayyoshev alehen maahilot al haaretz mippene kever hattehom:
Veal gabbehen delatot. veod zot maala yetera kede shello yihyu raglav shel tinok maahilot al haaretz:
Vechosot shel even beyadam. shekkol maase happara bichle gelalim uchele avanim uchele adama sheen mekabbelin tuma:
Yardu. tinokot hallalu letoch nehar shilloach:
Umilum. mimmennu mayim lekaddesh me chattat shemmazzin al hassoref et happara kol shiva. uvetoch hannahar lekka lesappoke lekever hattehom, dela avide dekavre vanneharot:
Rabbi yose omer. meal gabbe hashshevarim hayu meshalshelim chevel umemalleim mayim, velo hayu yordim letoch hashshilloach. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Uvau levet din vehodu peturim. vaafillu chafru chutz levet din al kol shevua. sheen kefira chutz levet din chashuva chefira:
Kafru bevet din chayyavin al kol achat veechat. deamar kera (Vayikra 5) vehaya chi yesham leachat meelle, lechayyev al kol achat veachat:
Ma taam. en chayyavim ella achat afillu shatku vechafru levassof, velo amrinan kefira kayma akkullehu lechayyevam al kol achat veachat:

Hoil. veillu chafru vevet din befaam rishona shuv lo hayu yecholin lachazor ulehodot, shekkevar higgidu sheenam yodim lo shum edut veshuv en chozrim umaggidim. hilkach af al gav delo chafru ella levassof, kol hashshevuot hayu levattala chutz min harishona. deim ma sheshshatku varishona kefira hi, shuv enam reuyim lehashebian, veim enah kefira hare mushbain veomdin, uma zo shevua al shevua. al karchacha ki chetiv leachat lechayyev al kol achat veachat, ashshevuat chutz levet din vechafru vevet din ketiv, dishvuot chutz levet din shehaya mashbian sheyyavou levet din veyaidu lo yatzu levattala, ureuyot lechalek, sheim kafru sham barishona haya rauy lachazor ulehashbian:
Im yodim attem li edut vechulei‏ peturin. dichtiv vehu ed, ad sheyyeyached et edav:
Bau lehar habbayit. hattinokot sheal gabbe hashshevarim im hakkosot meleim mayim:
Befetach haazara. shel nashim, hassemucha lachel:
Haya metukkan kalal shel chattat. keli shemmunnach bo efer chattat mikkol para shehayu sorfim, kedichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vehayta laadat bene yisrael lemishmeret:
Kalal. kad katan. targum vechaddah al shichmah (Bereshit 24) vekuleta al katpa:

Vezorko letoch hakkalal. umittoch kach keshehaya hazzachar nirta laachorav vehaya hammakkel yotze min hakkalal kolet min haefer immo venishpach al gabbe hashshevarim vehattinok notlo veeno tzarich lehotzi yado lachutz. uvattosefta mashma shello hutzrechu laasot ken ella cheshealu min haggola shehayu kullam temein veen yecholim ligga, sheim hayu nogim beefer happara hayu metammein oto. uma shehayu zorkim hammakkel letoch hakkalal velo vederech hannacha, shello yittamma haefer behesset mishshum safek ziva:

Al tittenu makom latztzedokim lirdot. limshol banu bedivre sechok vehittul, desavar rabbi yose keshealu vene haggola hayu vahem tehorim shettiharum beefer happara shehoridu immahem levavel veheelu mimmennu immam, velo nitmeu mishshum eretz haammim delo gazru tuma al eretz haammim ella leachar shealu min haggola. lefichach haya efshar sheish tahor yihye notel et efer happara, velo hutzrechu lezachar shel rechelim. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Mekom shennahagu shello leechol. shennire cheochel pesachim bechutza laaretz:
Shennahagu lehadelik et hanner beyom hakkippurim. mippene sheyyom hakkippurim asur betashmish hammitta, vechol zeman shehanner dolek lo yeshammesh sheasur laadam leshammesh mittato leor hanner:
Shennahagu shello lehadelik. shemma yire ishto vetissa chen beenav vishammesh:
Umadlikin bevatte chenesiyyot. uvechol makom sheen ish veishto mityachadim sham:

Shevuat haedut. noheget baanashim velo venashim. dichtiv (Vayikra 5) vehu ed, berauy lehaid hakkatuv medabber, veishsha enah reuya lehaid, dichtiv (Devarim 19) veamdu shene haanashim, anashim velo nashim. vehahu kera beedim hu dichtiv, neemar kan shenayim veneemar lehallan shenayim, al pi shenayim edim (sham 17):
Velo vikrovim. difsule edut ninhu, dichtiv (sham 24) lo yumetu avot al banim, beedut banim. vehu haddin lishar kerovim:
Velo vifsulim. kegon chayyave mitot vechayyave malkuyyot vegazlan, deikkeru reshaim, vehattora amra al tashet rasha ed:
Veenah noheget ella varuyin lehaid. laafoke melech sheeno meid, vehappesulim leedut midderabbanan kegon mesachake vekuvya umafriche yona:
Bifne vet din veshello vifne vet din mippi atzmo. im mippi atzmo nishba shevua sheeni yodea lecha edut, chayyav, ben nishba bifne vet din ben shello bifne vet din:
Umippi acherim. kegon mashbia ani alechem shettavou uteiduni, veamru lo en anu yodim lecha edut:
Enam chayyavin ad sheyyichperu bevet din. dichtiv (Vayikra 5) im lo yaggid venasa avono, bemakom sheillu haya maggid haya moil. ukera bemushba mippi acherim ketiv. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Unkelayot. masmerim sherashehen kefufim lemala:
Uvaammudim. shehayu kevuin bevet hammitbachayim baazara ammudim ketannim nikraim nannasim:
Chalakim. mefutztzelet kelippatan:
Shechal lihyot beshabbat. veen yachol letaltel hammaklot:
Yado al ketef chavero. vetole oto begide arkubbotav bizroo. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer, shemmuttar letaltel otan hammaklot, deen shevut bammikdash:
Mekom shennahagu shello limkor. dehechmiru al atzman dilma ate limkor gassa:

Uvechol makom en mochrin lahem behema gassa. degazur rabbanan shemma yashil o yaskir behemto leoved kochavim, veadam metzuvve al shevitat behemto. i nammi, peamim shemmochrah lo erev shabbat im chashecha, vetzoek lah hayyisrael kede shettelech lifne hakkone, vehi makkeret kolo veholechet mechamato, venimtza mechammer achar behemto beshabbat:
Agalim useyachin. ketannim, af al gav delav bene melacha ninhu, michallefe bimchirat gedolim. ushevurim michallefe bimchirat shelemim:
Rabbi yehuda mattir bishvura. deenah bat melacha leolam. aval baagalim useyachim mode, kevan dilchi gadle havu vene melacha. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:

Ben betera mattir besus. hoil velirchiva omed, vehachay nose et atzmo. veen halacha keven betera. veal yede sarsur share limkor behema leoved kochavim bizman sheen habbealim metzuyin sham beet hammechira, delekka lemechash shemma yashilenna veyaskirenna, shehare enah shello. veshemma telech mechamat kolo venimtza mechammer leha nammi lekka lemechash, sheenah makkeret et kolo:
Shevua vaacharona. en lecha veyadi velo lecha velo lecha vishvua. vehasheta kayma shevua akkullehu. veen halacha lo kerabbi eliezer velo kerabbi shimon:

Afillu amar chitta useora vechussemet. desavar rabbi meir hattoen et chavero chitta, min chitta kaamar. vechen seora, vechen kussemet, dichtiv (Shemot 9) vehachitta vehakkussemet. vehave cheillu teano chittin useorin vechussemin. verabbanan savre, gargir echad shel chitta veshel seora veshel kussemet kaamar. veen halacha kerabbi meir:

Kerachan. leetz erez veezov bishyare lashon shel tzemer shehu tzavua bishni tolaat shehayta arukka, uvema shehaya odef mimmenna al etz haerez veezov haya chorech shelashtan yachad, kede sheyyehe lahen koved veyippelu letoch serefat happara velo tiklot hashshalhevet et hallashon. veim lo cherachan vehishlich kol echad bifne atzmo, keshera:
Bichvarot shel even. avanim hamenukkavim nekavim dakkim kichvara. veen halacha kerabbi yishmael:
Shachor sheyyesh bo efer. pecham sheim yichteshu oto yease efer:
Kotshin oto. veim lo yachazor kemo efer, mannichin oto:
Ben kach uven kach. ben sheyyachazor efer ben shello yachazor efer:
Cholkin oto lishlosha chalakim. leachar shekkavru et kol haefer, ben efer happara ben efer etzim shennisrefu immah, cholkin et haefer lishlosha chalakim:
Echad nittan bachel. lemishmeret, kedichtiv vehayta laadat bene yisrael lemishmeret:
Veechad nittan behar hammishcha. uvah hayu hakkohanim mekaddeshin:
Veechad haya mitchallek lechol hammishmarot. umimmennu hayu mazzin kol yisrael:
Velo adumma. lo hayu motziin para adumma acheret immah bakkevesh:
Shello yomru shetayim shachatu. verachamana amar veshachat otah, velo otah veet chavertah:
Uvet hattevila haya sham. veoto vet hattevila nammi chalul haya al gabbe chippin mippene kever hattehom. veaf mekom maarachtah vegittah hashshenuyin lekamman, kullan al gabbe chippin hayu:

Umetammeim hayu et hakkohen. bema shehayu somchim yedehem alav keditnan lekamman, bechach haya mittamme, devigde ochle kodesh midras lefarat chattat. veharambam peresh, shehayu metammein oto vesheretz o vishar tumot shemmetammeim tumat erev:

Bimorve shemesh hayta naaset. shehayu dorshim veasaf ish tahor, en tahor ella sheheeriv shimsho, vechen hu omer (Vayikra 22) uva hashshemesh vetaher. vachachamim kibbelu detahor haamur befarashat chattat, tahor lemaaser kaamar, dehaynu tevul yom:
Tesumet yad. halevaa. shessam beyado mamon:
Vaaveda. shemmatza avedati:
Chittin useorin vechussemin. resha ashmoinan min echad uteviot chalukot. vesefa ashmoinan tevia achat kullam pikkadon, uminin chalukim:
Bechevel shel megeg. chevel asuy mimmin shel gemi, kede sheyyihyu chol maaseha bedavar sheeno mekabbel tuma:
Ufaneha lammaarav. letzad hammikdash:

Rabbi yehuda omer bimino haya mekabbel. kishar kabbalat haddam shel kadashim sheim kibbel bismol pasul. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda, shekkevan sheen damah nizrak al gabbe hammizbeach enah kishar kadashim leinyan ze:
Umazze vimino. dichtiv [bemidbar 19] velakach elazar hakkohen middamah beetzbao. hargila shebbaetzbaot, kelomar etzba hayyad hayemanit sheadam memashmesh bah tamid:
Keneged bet kodesh hakkodashim. kedichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vehizza el nochach pene ohel moed:
Al kol hazzaya tevila. al kol hazzaya shehaya mazze haya tovel etzbao baddam, dishyare haddam shebbaetzba pesulin lehazzaya:

Gamar millehazzot kinnach yado begufah shel para. kede sheyyissaref haddam immah, kedichtiv [sham] vesaraf et happara et orah veet besarah veet damah. uven hazzaa lehazzaa mekanneach etzbao visfat hammizrak velo vegufah shel para, mishshum nimin hannidbakin beetzbao dignay laasot bahen hazzaya:
Alitot. etzim ketannim shemmalhivin bahem atze hammaaracha. alitot, leshon alya. kemo zanvot haudim [yeshaya 7]:
Bachariyyot. zemorot shel dekel. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Mippene sheyyachol lachazor ulehodot. achar kefira. nimtza shebbechol shevua hu chofer mamon:
Hammatbil keli lechattat. keli shetef shehitbilo kede lemalleot bo mayim ulekaddesham baefer, im hitbilo vemayim sheen reuyin lekaddesh, kegon beme mikve sheenam mayim chayyim:
Tzarich lenaggev. hakkeli. shemma yitarvu sheenam reuyim baruyin. aval im hitbilo vemayim chayyim haruyin lekaddesh, en tzarich lenaggev:

Veim leesof letocho mayim mekuddashim. veim hitbilo lehachenis letocho mayim shekkevar natan alehem et haefer, afillu hitbilo vemayim chayyim, tzarich lenaggev, shello yitarvu sheenam mekuddashim bamkuddashim, utenan lekamman tzelochit shel chattat shennafal letochah mayim pasul:
Mevaarim et hakkol. ben chullin ben teruma, chutz mikkede achilato leshabbat:

Teruma millifne hashshabbat. sheen yachol lehaachilah lo lezarim velo livhema, ulehashhotah i efshar. aval chullin en tzarich levaer ella vizmanno, sheyyachol limtzo lahem ochlim harebe. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer berabbi tzadok:
Shechato shello leochlav. chole vezaken vekatan sheen yecholin leechol kazzayit basar, veen bo menuyin acherim ella hen, pasul, dilfi achlo ketiv (sham), harauy leechol:
Shello limnuyav. nimnu alav chavura zo ushechato leshem chavura acheret:
Laarelim. leyisreelim shemmetu achehem mechamat mila, vehane pesulim leechol pesach, dichtiv (sham) vechol arel lo yochal bo. utemeim nammi asurin bekadashim, uvecharet hen al achilatan:

Leochlav veshello leochlav kasher. velo dami lishmo veshello lishmo defasul, dehatam pesulo vegufo, shehammachashava shepposalto hayta vegufo shel karban, aval leochlav veshello leochlav en hammachashava happoselet begufo shel karban ella vedavar shehu chutz mimmennu:
Memares bedamo. shello yikrash, kede sheyyehe rauy lizrika:
Veim zarak kodem lattamid kasher. deaf al gav defesach meuchar lattamid, mishshum dichtiv beh baerev uven haarbayim, lo mifsal behachi:
Keruya. delaat yevesha chalula sheshshoavim bah mayim:
Shehitbiluha. maala vealma lechattat, velo mishshum tuma. deha vachadasha mayre shello nitmet meolam:
Bemayim sheen reuyin lekaddesh mekaddeshim bah. leachar shenniggevah. velo chayshinan shemma vala mayim sheen reuyin lekaddesh vetachazor vetiflot:

Nitmea en mekaddeshim bah. veaf al pi shechazar vehitbilah, dechayshinan shemma tiflot mashkin temeim habbeluim bah. dekasavre rabbanan demachmerinan tefe bemayim temeim yoter mibbemayim sheenan reuyin lekaddesh. verabbi yehoshua mashve middotav. dei chayshat, hacha vehacha techush. vei lo chayshat, hacha vehacha lo techush. ella ben kach uven kach, ben battechilla im hitbilah bemayim sheen reuyin lekaddesh veniggevah, ben bassof keshennitmet vehitbilah afillu viruyin lekaddesh veniggevah, lo yosif letochah mayim mekuddashim, dechayshinan shemma tiflot. veen halacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Shehakkohanim hayu medichin et haazara. mippene shehaddamim merubbim hayu medichin otah beshabbat. sheammat hammayim hayta mehallechet baazara, ucheshehen rotzim lehadiach pokkim et nekev yetziatah vehammayim poshtim al kol gedoteha umedichin kol haazara [shehaazara ritzpa shel shayish hayta chullah], veachar kach potchin hannekev vehammayim yotzim:
Middam hattaarovot. hammuttal al haritzpa. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Mippene shekkadma shevua laedut. verachamana amar (Vayikra 5) veshama kol ala vehu ed o raa o yada, shekkadma haedut lashshevua velo shekkadma shevua laedut:
Vechayyavin. karban ole veyored:
Al zedon hashshevua. shehare lo neemar bah venelam:
Veal shiggatah im zedon haedut. sheyyodim sheshshevua zo asura aval en yodim shechayyavim aleha karban:
Veen chayyavim al shiggatah. im shoggim hem legamre, kisvurim sheen yodin lo edut veachar kach nizkeru. shehare hen anusim velo karinan behu venishba al shaker:

Sheshshechato shello lishmo. kegon sheshshechato leshem shelamim, o kibbel haddam bammizrak, o holich haddam lammizbeach, o zarak haddam al gabbe hammizbeach, shello lishmo. shebbearba avodot hallalu hammachashava foselet hazzevach:
O lishmo veshello lishmo. kegon sheshshachat lishmo vekibbel haddam shello lishmo:

O shello lishmo. hach sefa ashmeinan dimchashshevim meavoda laavoda, sheim chashav bishat avoda zo al chavertah laasotah bemachashava fesula, kegon deamar hareni shochet lishmo al menat lizrok damo shello lishmo, nifsal hazzevach miyyad, vaafillu lo asa hashsheniyya bemachashava fesula kemo shechashav. vehachi mashmauta dematnitin, o shechashav bishat shechita lizrok haddam shello lishmo veshachat lishmo, pasul. ufesach defasul shello lishmo nafka lan mikkera, dichtiv (Shemot 12) vaamartem zevach pesach hu, ad sheyyihye hazzevach leshem pesach, vehu mashma leakkev:
Nezek vachatzi nezek. bachatzi nezek tzerorot demamona hu velo kenasa. deamrinan beedut shel kenas en chayyavin:
Tashlume chefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha. mishshum karna:
Vesheanas ish peloni ufitta et bitti. mishshum boshet ufegam demamona hu:
Veshehikkani veni. hakkaa sheen bah chabbura, sheeno chayyav aleha mita. vechevan delekka mita ikka mamon:
Veshechaval bi chaveri beyom hakkippurim. venakat la, deaf al gav deanush karet chayyav mamon:
Sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo. vechevan dechi ode lo michayyav, ki chafar nammi lav mamona kafar leh:

Aval meshallem boshet ufegam. hilkach mamona chafar. ufelugta derabbanan verabbi shimon, derabbi shimon savar ki amar leh anasta o fittita et bitti, kenasa katava minneh sheddamav ketzuvin chamishshim kesef, velo ka tava minneh boshet ufegam sheen damav ketzuvim, delo shavek eynash mide dekitz vetava mide delo kitz, hilkach kenasa chafar leh ufatur. verabbanan savre boshet ufegam ka tava leh, delo shavek eynish mide dechi mode veh lo miftar vetava mide dechi mode veh miftar, hilkach ki chafar leh, mamona chafar leh vechayyav. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Talmide chachamim betelim. mimmelachtan kol oto hayyom, kede shello yassichu datam meavelut:
Leolam yaase adam atzmo ketalmid chacham. velo mechaze cheyuhara, sheharoe oto vatel omer en lo melacha laasot velo mippene shennoheg bo issur:
Vachachamim omrim bihuda vechulei. chachamim sevira lehu daasiyyat melacha bearve fesachim lav beminhaga talya milleta, ella bihuda hayu mattirim uvaggalil osrim issur gamur, velo mikkoach minhag:
Hallayla. lel arbaa asar, leanshe galil sheosrim laasot melacha bearve fesachim:
Bet shammay osrim. lahem kechol shear yamim tovim sheasurim baasiyyat melacha, shehallayla holech achar hayyom:
Uvet hillel mattirim. mide dahava attaanit, shehayyom asur baachila vehallayla muttar:

Achalah avar al shevuat shav. hachi kaamar, achalah, avar al shevuat shav lechuda. lo achalah, avar af ashshevuat bittuy. demikki nishba sheochal kikkar zo chayyav leachlah, vechi hadar nishba shello yochalenna hare nishba levattel et hammitzva, veloke mishshum shevuat shav ben yochal ben lo yochal, vei lo achel lah chayyav shetayim, mishshum shevuat shav veaf mishshum shevuat bittuy:
Karu et hahallel. kol hashshalosh kittot:

Im gamru shanu. keshehayu matchilim lishchot hayu matchilim likrot, veim rabbu happesachim umashach zeman shechitatan ad sheggamru vaadayin rabbim lishchot, chozrim vekorin sheniyya. veim karu sheniyya vaadayin lo gamru shechitat happesachim shel otah hakkat, chozrin vekorin shelishit. vechen kat sheniyya ushelishit:
Af al pi shemmeolam lo shilleshu. shehakkohanim hayu rabbim uzerizin:
Lo higgiu leahavti. afillu paam rishona:
Metzavve ani alechem vechulei. vehu sheyyomar metzavve ani alechem bishvua, oserchem ani bishvua:
Hamekallel bechullam. mevarech et hashshem beechad mehem:
Rabbi meir mechayyev. sekila:

Vachachamim potrin. deal shem hameyuchad davka biskila, dichtiv (Vayikra 24) benakvo shem yumat. veal hakkinnuyim beazhara delohim lo tekallel (Shemot 22). uvishvuat haedut modim chachamim lerabbi meir dechayyav al hakkinnuyim kemo shechayyav al hashshem hameyuchad. devishvuat [edut] ketiv (Vayikra 5) veshama kol ala:
Hamekallel atzmo. dichtiv (Devarim 4) hishshamer lecha ushemor nafshecha meod, vechol hishshamer pen veal eno ella lo taase:
Vehamekallel chavero. dichtiv (Vayikra 19) lo tekallel cheresh, afillu cheresh sheeno shomea velo kafed akkillato lo tekallel, vechol shekken shear kol adam deshama vekafed:

Yakkecha elohim vechen yakkecha elohim. im amar laedim yakkecha elohim im lo teiduni. o sheshshama echad shekkore vakkelalot shebbattora yakkecha elohim, veamar hu laedim vechen yakkecha elohim im lo teiduni. o sheamar al yakkecha elohim im teiduni. o yevarechcha Adonai‏ im teiduni. veyetiv lecha elohim im teiduni. bechol ellu rabbi meir mechayyev, demikkelal lav atta shomea hen, al yakkecha elohim im teiduni, ha im lo teiduni yakkecha. vechen yevarechcha elohim im teiduni, ha im lo teiduni yekallelcha. uvechol ellu en halacha kerabbi meir:
Shachat yisrael. im yirtze, shehashshechita cheshera vezar bechol hakkarbanot:
Vekibbel kohen. haddam babbazech, shemmikkabbala vaelach mitzvat kehunna:
Notno lachavero. shehare keshura hen omdim:
Vachavero lachavero. ha ka mashma lan divrov am haderat melech:

Umekabbel et hammale. miyyad hannoten, techilla, veachar kach machazir et harekan. aval ippecha, machazir et harekan beresha lo, demikki moshit leh hay miyyad bae lekabbole, deen maavirin al hammitzvot:
Zerika achat. babbazech atzmo, velo mattana veetzba, sheen lecha karban shettaun etzba ella chattat levaddah dichtiv (Vayikra 4) beetzbao:

Keneged hayesod. baruchot shebbammizbeach shehayesod tachtehen, vezorek lizkifato shel mizbeach vehu nofel laysod. ulefi sheen hayesod makkif kol hammizbeach ella et hatztzafon veet hammaarav, veochel baddarom amma achat uvammizrach amma achat kemo shemmeforash bemassechet middot, lechach hutzrach lomar neged hayesod:
Haholech. bearbaa asar kae:
Im yachol. sheyyesh shehut bayyom:
Lehatztzil min haggayis. et yisrael hannirdafim:
Yevattel belibbo. velo yachzor vaafillu yesh shehut, demiddeorayta bevittul bealma saggi:

Velishbot shevitat harshut. shehaya holech lehacheshich al hattechum veliknot shevita lehallech mishsham vahala alpayim amma lidvar harshut, yachzor miyyad. aval liknot shevitat mitzva, kegon shetztzarich lelech lemachar levet haevel o levet hammishte, hayenu keholech lishchot et pischo:
Hamekaddesh. me chattat. habba litten meefer happara letoch hammayim. vehu kiddush haamur bechol mechiltin:
O al hatztzad. al tziddo shel keli:
Veachar kach nafal lashshoket. al hammayim shebbetoch hashshoket. pesulim otan hammayim lehazzaa, dichtiv [bemidbar 19] velakchu venatan, ad sheyyavo haefer betoch hammayim mikkoach adam:
Natal min hashshefoferet vechissa. natal efer min hashshefoferet vechissa hashshefoferet kodem sheyyekaddesh, dehaynu kodem sheyyitten haefer bammayim:
O shehegif et haddelet. kodem sheyyekaddesh:
Hakkiddush kasher. dehaynu haefer shebbeyado, lefi shemmelacha enah poselet baefer, kedaamaran:
Vehammayim pesulim. denaaset melacha im hammayim, uleel [sof] perek parat chattat shaninu shehammelacha poselet bammayim ad sheyyattilu et haefer:
Zekafah baaretz. leachar shennatal haefer min hashshefoferet hinniach hashshefoferet baaretz kodem sheyyitten haefer bammayim:

Pasul. hammilluy dehaynu hammayim, lefi sheasa melacha im hammayim. veim hinniach hashshefoferet beyado vechafa yado aleha kede shello yitpazzer haefer shebbetochah veachar kach natan haefer al hammayim, kasher hammilluy dehaynu hammayim, deen zo chashuva melacha:

Lefi shei efshar. lishmor haefer shebbetoch hashshefoferet im lo yachof yado al piha, shehare eno yachol lehashiv happekak al piha ad sheyyekaddesh. perush acher, zekafah baaretz, hinniach haefer baaretz, pasul haefer, dichtiv lemishmeret, [uvaaretz enah lemishmeret]. veim natan haefer letoch yado kasher, deefshar leshamro veshappir karinan beh lemishmeret. ulefi ze garsinan lefi sheefshar:
Kol haasukin bappara. adumma, beachat mikkol avodoteha, ben battechilla ben baemtza ben bassof:

Metammein begadim. dichtiv vehishlich el toch serefat happara usemich leh vechibbes begadav hakkohen, uvisrefatah ketiv vehassoref otah yechabbes begadav, veim hammashlich et haezov metamme vegadim, hassoref lo chol shekken, ella va hakkatuv velimmedcha al kol haoskim bappara mittechilla vead sof sheyyihyu teunim kibbus begadim:

Ufoslim otah bimlacha. dichtiv veshachat otah, velo sheyyaase melacha acheret immah bishat shechitatah. vechen bisrefatah ketiv vesaraf et happara, velo sheyyaase melacha acheret im serefatah, lamadnu shemmelacha poselet bah mishsheat shechita ad shettease efer:
Era bah pesul bishchitatah. lo shennitnabbela vashshechita, deim ken metammea vegadim mishshum nevela, ella fesul mechamat melacha, dumeya deera bah pesul behazzaatah:
Enah metammea vegadim. dechevan dishchitatah bifsul, im ken lo naasa vah adayin leshem para kelum bechashrut. aval era bah pesul bahazzaa, kevar naaset hashshechita behechsher:

Leolam moalin bah. hannehene mimmenna ben lifne serefatah ben leachar serefatah, chayyav karban meila, ad shettease efer. aval leachar shennaaset efer, en baefer mishshum meila, dichtiv chattat hi. chattat, melammed shemmoalin bah. hi, bah moalin, beefrah en moalin:
Umarbin lah etzim. nammi davka ad shettease efer:

Umaaseha vayyom. battosefta mefaresh, chutz measifat efrah vehammilluy vehakkiddush. sheyyecholim leesof efer happara ballayla, velishov hammayim min habbeer vehu hannikra milluy, velasim betochah haefer vehu hannikra kiddush, kol ze muttar laasot ballayla. vechol maase fara, bechohen, chutz measifat efrah vehammilluy vehakkiddush vehahazzaa, shehem kesherim bezar. asifat efrah, dichtiv veasaf ish tahor, melammed sheasifat haefer keshera vechol adam. uvahazzaa hu omer vehizza hattahor al hattame, ben shehu chohen ben sheeno chohen:

Vehammelacha foselet bammayim. dichtiv vehayta laadat bene yisrael lemishmeret leme nidda [chattat hi], ma chattat nifselet bimlacha kidchatvinan leel, kach hammayim nifsalim bimlacha mishsheat hammilluy:

Ad sheyyattilu et haefer. shemmattilim bammayim meefer happara keshiur shetterae haefer bammayim umehem mazzin al hattame, veim leachar shehittilu haefer bammayim asa melacha acheret immah bishat hazzaa, lo fasal:
Shevuat happikkadon. baanashim uvenashim. ayde detana vishvuat haedut baanashim velo venashim, tana nammi hacha lechullehu:
Bikrovim. shebbaal happikkadon karov laze shehappikkadon etzlo:
Bifne vet din veshello vifne vet din. im mippi atzmo nishba, shehotzi shevua mippiv o sheana amen achar hashshevua veachar kach hoda, chayyav karban. dichtiv (Vayikra 5) vechichesh baamito, kol dehu:
Umippi acherim. velo ana amen. kegon mashbia ani alecha shettachazir li fikdoni, veamar en lecha veyadi chelum, eno chayyav ad sheyyichpor bevet din:
Vachachamim omrim vechulei. vahalacha kachachamim:
Vechayyav al zedon hashshevua. delo chetiv bah venelam. zedon hashshevua, shezzachur al happikkadon veyodea shemmitchayyev al kefirato karban:
Veal shiggatah im zedon happikkadon. sheeno yodea shechayyav bishvua zo karban, aval zachur hu shehappikkadon etzlo:
Bechesef shekalim. hakkanuy bishne selaim. dehachi chetiv gabbe el asham (Vayikra 5), beerkecha kesef shekalim:

Bechol hakkelim mekaddeshim. ben shel etz ben shel etzem ben shel zechuchit, vaafillu vichle gelalim dela chashive cheli leinyan tuma lo middivre tora velo middivre sofrim, dichtiv mayim chayyim el keli velo chetiv el hakkeli:
Machatz. keli gadol shel cheres shekkorin baaravi 292. uvekatze haechad mimmennu asuy kidmut bet yad, vehu shule hammachatz. kach peresh harambam:
Veen mazzin ella vecheli. kelomar, shetztzarich sheyyihyu hammayim bichli bishat hahazzaa:
En matztzilin. kol ma shebbetochah mittumat ohel hammet al yede tzamid patil, ella chelim:

Sheen matztzilin meavir kele cheres ella chelim. sheim yippol sheretz baavir keli cheres, tame kol ma shebbetocho af al pi shello naga bahen, chutz mikkelim, sheen mittammein meavir keli cheres, dichtiv (Vayikra 11) kol asher betocho yitma mikkol haochel asher yeachel, ochalim umashkin mittammein meavir kele cheres, veen kelim mittammein meavir kele cheres:
Sheen matztzilin. kemo veen matztzilin. dugmato beresh perek kamma devetza, sheefer kira muchan hu, veamar rabba vaggemara [daf 8] hachi kaamar, veefer kira muchan hu:

Shivat yamim kulei‏ mafrishin kohen hassoref et happara. dichtiv befarashat milluim (Vayikra 8) kaasher asa bayyom hazze tzivva Adonai‏ laasot lechapper alechem, vedarshu rabbotenu, laasot, ze maase fara. lechapper alechem, ze maase yom hakkippurim. shehakkohen hassoref et happara vechohen gadol haoved beyom hakkippurim taun perisha shiva kemo shehayu teunim aharon uvanav beshivat yeme hammilluim, dichtiv (sham) umippetach ohel moed lo tetzu shivat yamim. vehayu mafrishin oto meishto shemma yavo al ishto vetimmatze nidda, vehabboel nidda tame shivat yamim velo yuchal lisrof happara:
Habbira. it deamre makom haya vehar habbayit uvira shemo. veit deamre kol hammikdash karuy bira, kemo shenneemar el habbira vegomer‏ [divre hayyamim 1 19]:

Tzafona mizracha. taama demafrishim hakkohen hassoref et happara lallishka shehi tzefonit mizrachit, kevan dechattat hi vechattat teuna tzafon, takkinu leh rabbanan betzafona mizracha ki hechi deleheve la hekkera:

Uvet even hayta nikret. lefi shekkol maaseha hayu vichle gelalim kele avanim kele adama sheenan mekabbelin tuma, uvahem bilvad haya mishtammesh kol shivat yeme happerisha, mishshum ditvul yom kasher befara, vehayu metammein hakkohen hassoref et happara umatbilin oto miyyad, lehotzi millibban shel tzedokim sheomrim bimorave shemesh hayta naaset, takkinu la rabbanan maalot yeterot kede shello yezalzelu bah:
Kol shivat hayyamim. shel yeme happerisha:

Mikkol chattaot shehayu sham. mikkol happarot shennaasu mimot moshe rabbenu vead oto zeman, shemmikkol para ufara hayu notnin ketzat lemishmeret, veyom rishon mazzin alav meefer para achat veyom sheni meacheret veyom shelishi meacheret:

Bashshelishi uvashshevii. lifrishato. uven tanna kamma uven rabbi yose tarvayhu sevira lehu tevila vizmannah mitzva, veka mippallegi vehazzaa i makkeshinan la litvila i lo. tanna kamma makkish hazzaa litvila, vehazzaa vizmannah mitzva, vechol yoma mishsheloshet yamim harishonim ikka lesappoke shemma hayyom yom shelishi letumato, vehashshelosha acharonim kol yoma mesappekinan shemma shevii. urevii lo vae hazzaa, delav bashshelishi ikka lesappoke velo vashshevii ikka lesappoke, sheen hazzaa vashshevii ola mishshum hazzaat shevii ad sheyyazze vashshelishi shellefanav. vechol shiva lav davka, deal karchacha ha kayma lan hazzaa shevut veen docha et hashshabbat. verabbi yose lo makkish hazzaa litvila, vehazzaa vizmannah lav mitzva, hilkach lo vae hazzaa ella shelishi ushevii bilvad. verabbi chanina segan hakkohanim nammi cherabbi yose sevira leh dehazzaa vizmannah enah mitzva, vehakkohen hassoref et happara maala vealma hu, ki hechi dela lizalzelu vah mippene shehi naaset bitvul yom:
Shalosh nashim lashot keachat. kol achat tannur male, veen kan chimmutz, af al pi [shehaachat] mamtenet ad sheyyofu hashshetayim:
Vachachamim omrim. en lehakel kol kach sheyyehu lashot keachat, ella shalosh nashim oskot kol achat babbatzek shellah:

Achat lasha. haacharona lasha keshechavertah haemtzait mekattefet, vehashshelishit shellasha techilla ofa, nimtzeu shelashtan oskot bevat achat, kol achat babbatzek shellah, achat lasha shellah, veachat mekattefet shellah, veachat ofa shellah:

Lo chol hannashim. rabbi akiva ammilleteh derabban gamliel ka mehaddar veamar sheen rauy laasot kidvarav, lefi sheyyesh nashim atzlaniyyot umachmitzot im shohot kol kach, veyesh tannur sheeno cham maher, veyesh etzim sheen nivarim maher. ella kedivre chachamim rauy laasot, laasok tamid babbatzek, shekkol zeman sheoskin babbatzek eno ba lide chimmutz. vechen halacha:
Ze hakkelal tafach. habbatzek shebbeyadah sheroa sherotze litpoach:
Tiltosh. yadah bemayim tzonnin utekattefenna vetitztannen:
Shefoferet. shel kane:
Shechatachah. tikkenah lasum bah me chattat o efer chattat, afillu chatachah chaver sheeno chashud al hattuma:

Rabbi eliezer omer yatbil miyyad. veikka hekkera. defara naaset bitvul yom, mishshum dechelim hannigmarim betohora tzerichin tevila lakkodesh, shemma nishar bakkeli rok hayyotze mippiv shel am haaretz vaadayin hu lach bishat gemaro shel keli umetammeo. veaf al gav detuma zo enah tzericha heerev shemesh ella tevila bilvad, mikkol makom ikka hekkera, mishshum dilgabbe farat chattat asauha chitme met bashshevii shello umetamme adam vechelim, vei ita defara hayta tzericha heerev shemesh, gam hi hayta tzericha:
Rabbi yehoshua omer yetamme veyatbil. divinyan acher lekka hekkera, kevan dechelim hannigmarim betohora lo vau heerev shemesh lakkodesh. vahalacha kerabbi yehoshua:

Hakkol kesherim lekaddesh. kol hattehorim kesherim lehashelich haefer al gabbe hammayim, vaafillu nashim. dichtiv gabbe asifat efer happara, veasaf ish tahor et efer happara vehinniach michutz lammachane, vedarshinan ish, lehacheshir et hazzar. tahor, vaafillu ishsha. vehinniach, mi sheyyesh bo daat lehanniach, perat lecheresh shote vekatan sheen bahen daat lehanniach. uvatar [asifat efrah] ketiva hach avoda dekiddush, veen avoda mafseket bentayim. lamadnu shekkol hakkasher laasifat efrah kasher lekiddush:

Rabbi yehuda machshir bekatan ufosel beishsha. deim ita dechol hakkasher baasifa kasher bekiddush, lichtov velakach leshon yachid bakkiddush, ki hechi dechatav veasaf leshon yachid baasifa, may velakchu, daafillu hanach difsulim hatam kesherim hacha, kegon katan. aval ishsha lo, dichtiv venatan, velo venatna:
Parat chattat. shello lishmah pesula. deamar kera chattat hi, umiddekarya rachamana chattat lamadnu shehi teuna shechita lishmah kechattat:
Verabbi eliezer machshir. hoil vehi nishchetet bachutz. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:

Veshello rechutz yadayim veraglayim pesula. dechattat karya rachamana. ulehachi nakat rechutz yadayim veraglayim velo tana kiddesh, delo shena kiddesh bifnim o vachutz, ben bichli sharet ben bichli chol yotze:
Verabbi eliezer machshir. divvoam el ohel moed vegomer‏ o vegishtam el hammizbeach yirchatzu ketiv. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Shello vechohen gadol pesula. dichtiv unetattem otah el elazar, otah el elazar, veen shear happarot naasot ella vechohen gadol:
Verabbi yehuda machshir. dedaresh, otah bisgan, ushear kol happarot ben bechohen gadol ben bechohen hedyot. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:

Uvevigde lavan hi naaset. dichtiv gabbe fara vehayta livne yisrael velagger haggar betocham lechukkat olam, uveyom hakkippurim ketiv (Vayikra 16) vehayta zot lachem lechukkat olam, ma avodat yom hakkippurim bevigde lavan, af maase fara bevigde lavan:

Shevuat haddayyanin. hashshevua shehaddayyanim mashbiim al yede hodaa vemiktzat hattaana, tzarich shello tehe hattaana pachot mishshete maot kesef, shehu shelish dinar, shehaddinar shesh maot vehu mishkal tishim veshesh seorot benoniyyot, nimtzeu shete maot mishkal sheloshim ushetayim seorot:

Vehahodaa. shemmechayyavto lishshava, lo tehe fachot mishshave feruta. sheim haya ma shekkafar lo pachot mishshete chesef, o ma shehoda pachot mishshave feruta, eno chayyav shevua deorayta. aval mashbiin oto shevuat hesset middivre sofrim. vehamechuyyav shevua deorayta naket cheftza beyadeh kegon sefer tora o tefillin keshennishba. vehamechuyyav shevuat hesset lo naket hannishba cheftza videh, ella chazzan hakkeneset o hammashbio naket cheftza videh beshaa shechavero nishba lo. ushelosha mine shevuot hen deorayta, velo yoter. hammode vemiktzat hattaana, umi sheed echad meid kenegdo shehu nishba lehachechish haed, ushevuat hashshomrim. vechol shear shevuot hannizkarim bammishna, hem betakkanat chachamim vehem keen shel tora binkitat chefetz. veen hefresh ben shevua deorayta lashshevuot hannizkarot bammishna, ella shehamechuyyav shevua deorayta velo ratza lishshava, bet din yordin linchasav venifraim mimmennu mishshalem. vehamechuyyav shevua middivrehem betakkanat chachamim velo ratza lishshava, meshammetin oto ad sheyyifra o ad sheyyishshava. veim amad benidduyo sheloshim yom velo ratza lishshava velo leshallem, makkin oto makkat mardut umattirin lo nidduyo veholech lo, veen yordin linchasav:

En lecha veyadi ella feruta patur. sheen hahodaa mimmin hattaana, shezze teano chesef veze hoda lo nechoshet. vedavka shello teano ella mishkal shete maot kesef o yoter, aval im teano matbea kesef, hare hoda lo vammatbea:
Shete chesef uferuta. ka savar teano chittim useorim vehoda lo al achat mehen chayyav:

Mippene shehu chemeshiv aveda. shehu fatur mishshevua, keditnan [gittin daf moach] hammotze metzia lo yishshava mippene tikkun haolam. vedavka kesheen habben toen vadday mane leabba veyadecha, ella shemma. aval teano vadday, veamar hu lo haya lo etzlo ella chamishshim, chayyav shevua deorayta, deen ze meshiv aveda:
Ellu ovrin. ellu mitbaarim min haolam. deaf al gav deen ovrim alehem al bal yerae, midderabbanan miha tzerichi viur, dehachi tenan lekamman (mishna 5) seor yissaref, veaf al gav dehaochlo fatur:
Kuttach habbavli. asuy mippat meuppash vechalav. uregilim letabbel bo et hammaachol:
Shechar hammadi. shechar shehayu osin bemaday mechittim o seorim sheruyim bemayim:
Vechometz haadomi. chometz sheasuy beeretz edom, shennotnim seorim [beyayin] umashhin otam sham kede sheyyachmitzu:

Vezetom hammitzri. tilta seare vetilta kuretme, hu karkom midbari venikra bearvi kartom, vetilta milcha, veosin oto lirfua. ad kan chametz harauy laachila al yede taarovet. mikkan veelach chametz nukshe beeneh:
Vezoman shel tzabbaim. mayim shennotnim bahem subbin, umishtammeshim bahem hatztzabbaim limlachtan:
Vaamilan shel tabbachim. [pat] sheosin mikkemach tevua shello hevia shelish bishshulah, umechassim bah et hakkedera lishov et hazzuhama:
Vekolan shel sofrim. afar harechayim megabbelin oto bemayim, vesofrim medabbekim bo neyarotehem:

Rabbi eliezer. mosif, deillu tanna kamma let leh ella chametz dagan gamur al yede taarovet o chametz nukshe beeneh, verabbi eliezer mosif af tachshite nashim shehen chametz nukshe al yede taarovet sammanim acherim. uvaggemara parech, tachshite nashim salka datach, ella ema af tefule nashim, solet shennashim toflot umechabberot al besaran im sammanin acherim lehashshir et hassear o lehalebin uleadden et habbasar. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Kol shehu min dagan. mechameshet hamminim, umeoravin bahen mayim. dei en bahem mayim ella me ferot kayma lan deme ferot en machmitzin:
Hare ellu veazhara. im achalan over belav:

Veen bahem karet. deal chametz gamur anush karet veeno anush karet al hattaarovet, aval loke al achilato im achal kazzayit chametz betoch hattaarovet bichde achilat peras. aval im lo achal kazzayit chametz betoch hattaarovet bichde achilat peras eno loke min hattora, mihu issura miha ikka, dechametz befesach oser betaaravto bechol shehu:

Tamid nishchat. tamid shel ben haarbayim nishchat kol shear yemot hashshana bishmone umechetza. dizman shechitat hattamid mikki yinnatu tzille erev shehu mishshesh shaot umechetza ulemala shechamma nota lammaarav, shechatzi shesh vachatzi sheva hi omedet beemtza harakia veen tzel note ella tzel kol adam tachtav. umeacharin shechitato shete shaot achar zemanno mippene nedarim unedavot, shei efshar lehakerivam achar tamid shel ben haarbayim, kedichtiv (Vayikra 6) vehiktir aleha chelve hashshelamim, al olat habboker hashelem kol hakkarbanot kullan, shello yehe davar meuchar letamid shel ben haarbayim. vaafillu veshabbat sheen kerevim nedarim unedavot, meacharim zeman shechitat tamid shel ben haarbayim mishshum serach nedarim unedavot dechol. uveerev pesach shehappesach karev achar tamid shel ben haarbayim, makdeminan leh shaa achat veavdinan leh besheva umechetza:
Chal lihyot beerev shabbat. deikka nammi tzeliyyat happesach delo dachya shabbat vetzarich litzloto mibbeod yom, makdeminan leh umotvinan leh addineh, sheyyihye nishchat beshesh umechetza:
Vekarev besheva umechetza. gemar hakeravato besheva umechetza, sheshshohin shaa achat baasiyyato:
Ishi chohen gadol. lefi sheppeamim naaset al yede chohen gadol. aval bechol kohen hi cheshera, ben bechohen gadol, ben bisgan ben behedyot:
Venistappeg. venitkannach:
Etzim. laasot mehen maaracha lasserefa, mesuddarim sham:
Vooranim. leshon nata oren vegeshem yegaddel haamur bishaya, umin erez hu, vechen beroshim. vechol hanach etzim dekachashiv, adife mishshear etzim letzorech serefatah:
Kemin migdal. rechava millematta vetzara milmala:
Potchin bah challonot. lehachenis bahen haesh lehaveir haetzim:
Vachazitah maarava. pene hammaaracha umaritah, vehu hammakom shemmaachizin bo et haur, haya fone letzad maarav dehaynu kelappe hammikdash, shehammikdash haya lemaaravo shel har hazzetim:
Moshivin shovachin. shovche yonim sheyyihyu yoshvim legaddel efrochim, moshivin otam lechattechilla bearbaa asar:

Vetarnegolet shebbarcha. bechullo shel moed. deillu bearbaa asar hasheta otove shovachin lechattechilla amart deshare, ahdore mibbaya. ella hattarnegolet shebbarcha bechullo shel moed kaamar demachazirin, vehu sheyyashva al habbetzim shelosha yamim kodem shebbarcha, deshuv en habbetzim reuyim laachila vedavar haaved hu, hilkach im meta moshiv acheret tachteha mishshum hefsed devetzim:
Gorfin. mashlichin lachutz:
Uvammoed. shechamur yoter, en mashlichin lachutz ella mesallekin latztzedadin:
Molichin umeviin kelim mibbet haumman. bearbaa asar. veaf al pi sheeno letzorech hammoed:
Asu anshe yericho. hayu nohagin laasot anshe yericho:
Markivin dekalim. anaf rach shel dekel zachar markivo vedekel nekeva, shehazzachar ose ferot vehannekeva enah osa ferot:
Kol hayyom. kelomar bearbaa asar:

Vechorchin et shema. shello hayu omrim baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed bikriat shema. perush acher shello hayu mafsikin ben echad livahavta, shetztzarich lehaarich beechad ulehafsik ben malchut shamayim lidvarim acherim:
Vekotzrin vegodshin. osin gadish min hechadash lifne haomer, velo chayshinan dilma ate lemechal minneh:
Velo michu veyadam. kol hashshishsha devarim sheasu, kullam shello virtzon chachamim hayu osin, ella sheal ellu hashshelosha lo michu veal shelosha haacharonim michu:

Mattirin leechol gimziyyot shel hekdesh. giddulim sheggadlu beilan shel hekdesh, dekasavre en issur ella happeri atzmo shehukdash. veit sefarim degarse mattezir, kelomar chotchim vechortim anfe ilanot shel hekdesh shetztzamchu achar shehikdishu hailan, lehanot mehen:
Veochlin. beshabbat veyom tov perot shennimtzeu tachat hailan, velo noda im nashru meemesh vehem muttarim, o nashru hayyom vaasurim:
Venotnim pea layyarak. vaanan kayma lan dechol davar sheen adam machniso lekiyyum eno chayyav befea, veyarak davar sheen machniso lekiyyum hu:
Umichu veyadam chachamim. mishshum deka mafkee la min hammaaser, vehaaniyyim ochlim otah betivlam, kisvurin shehu fea, ufea fetura min hammaaser mishshum dehefker hi:
Sheani chohen. peturin, sheen haedim chayyavin ella keshekkafru vedavar sheyyesh bo teviot mamon:

Sheanas ish peloni o fitta vitto shel peloni. uvitto dekatane, aish peloni chohen dilel kae, [detana leel minneh sheish peloni chohen o levi veeno ven gerusha, vaaleh kae], o shehishbian sheanas ish peloni et bitto shel oto feloni deayre veh ad hasheta. peturim, devainan sheyyishmeu mippi hattovea. uvaggemara moke la beva vehareshaa, vei teviat mamon acher have, hayu chayyavim. veashmoinan deen nechshav hammurshe baal din baze kishar mamon, dechevan demamon shehu shoel lo meta lideh meolam, lo matze lemichtav hareshaa aleh:
Veshechaval bi veni. chavala hi chabbura. peturin, sheim heiduhu haya mitchayyev mita velo mamon:
Veshechaval bi chaveri veshehidlik et gedishi veshabbat. detarvayhu chiyyuv mita ninhu ufeturim min hammamon:

Nivkea. happara mechamat haur. aval im lo nivkea lo, dichtiv [bemidbar 19] el toch serefat, lo kodem sheyyutztzat haur berubbah, velo achar shettease efer. vehu haddin im keraah besakkin achar sheyyutztzat haur berubbah:
Veamad. hakkohen:
Chutz miggittah. gumma shehayta vakkarka kemin gat asuya lisrefat happara, ucheshehaya mashlich etz erez veezov usheni tolaat tzarich sheyyaamod chutz leotah gumma:
Etz erez. agudda sheyyesh bah etz erez veezov keruchim im sheni tolaat:

Etz erez ze. lefi sheyyesh minim harebe sheddomin leerez veenan kesherin, lechach tzarich lehodia shezzehu shetztzivveta alav tora. vechen beezov. vechen bishni tolaat. veezov hu shekkorin lo vaaravi 760. usheni tolaat hu tzemer tzavua betzeva hannikra vaaravi 267 uvelaaz 357:
Hayu vah shete searot shechorot pesula. dichtiv adumma temima, i vemumin hare chevar amur asher en bah mum. ella shettehe temima veadmimut:

Rabbi yehuda omer betoch kos echad. garsinan, velo garsinan afillu. bemakom shehaya shone tanna kamma gumma, haya shone rabbi yehuda kos. gumma vechos echad hu, ella shechayyav adam lomar bilshon rabbo, sherabbo shel rabbi yehuda haya kore legumma kos. hachi muchach battosefta:
Mochichot. mechuvvanot usemuchot zo vetzad zo:
Rabbi eliezer omer afillu chamishshim. kelomar afillu tuva vehen mefuzzarot, yitlosh. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Achar hannire. hayenu achar roshan shel searot:
