Achar haikkar. veim ikkaran madim veroshan mashchir veyesh baikkar shemmadim kede sheyyinnatel befi hazzug, yigzoz roshan hammashchir vehi cheshera. aval im en baikkar hammadim shiur sheyyuchelu lehinnatel befi hazzug, pesula afillu ledivre chachamim. sheshshiur shete searot haamurot bechol makom, hu chede sheyyihyu nittalot befi hazzug. vechen halacha:
Shete shekatot shebbeeven. hacha mayre veeven hammittaltelet sheenah sela mechubbar, ushete shekatot hallalu torat keli yesh lahen:
Kiddesh achat mehen. shennatan efer para bemayim shebbeachat mehen:

Kishfoferet hannod. kemin kane shennatan al pi hannod shebbo merikim hayyayin o hammayim betoch hannod. veshiuro, kede sheyyihyu shete etzbaot harishonot shel pas hayyad chozrot bo verevach, lo haggudal, ella haetzbaot hassemuchot lo:
O shehayu mayim tzafin al gabbehen. kegon shekkotel haemtzai hammafsik ben shete hashshekatot namuch mishshear hakketalim:
Kiklippat hashshum. keshennitmalleu shetehen, tzafin hammayim al hammechitztza haemtzait kiklippat hashshum:

Challa vetuma. shennitmet haissa veshuv en hachalla hannittelet mimmenna reuya laachilat kohen, ketzad mafrishin otah beyom tov shel pesach, hare en yachol leefotah befesach meachar sheenah reuya laachila, velishhotah ulesarfah baerev i efshar shemma tachmitz, ulehaachilah lakkelavim i efshar, sheen mevaarin kadashim beyom tov:

Rabbi eliezer omer lo yikra lah shem challa ad shetteafe. deakkatti kol chada vachada chazya leh, demikkol chada vachada mafrish pureta, uleachar afiyyatah im ratza yafrish challa shelema al hakkol, dekasavar rabbi eliezer harode min hattannur venoten lassal, hassal metzarfan lechalla:

Lo zehu chametz shemmuzharim alav. delav dideh hu leachar shekkara aleha shem, ukera chetiv (Shemot 13) lo yerae lecha, shellecha i atta roe aval atta roe shel acherim veshel gavoah, veze eno shellecha velo shel chavercha, deakkatti lo meta leyad kohen. verabbi eliezer savar hoil i vae mitteshil ala haveya hekdesh betaut, veeno hekdesh, vechazya leh laachila, nimtza deshello hi vechametz shel yisrael hu. verabbi yehoshua savar lo amrinan hoil. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:

Kol melacha. shehi letzorech hammoed vehitchil bah kodem arbaa asar, gomrah bearbaa asar, vaafillu bemakom shennahagu shello laasot melacha. aval melacha sheenah letzorech hammoed, bemakom shennahagu laasot melacha osin, umakom shennahagu shello laasot, afillu hitchil bah kodem arbaa asar eno gomrah:

Chayyatim. share vearbaa asar bechol makom, shekken matzinu vahen bechullo shel moed kulla yoter mishshear ummanuyyot, shehedyot sheeno umman bechach tofer kedarko, hilkach bearbaa asar dekil mechol hammoed afillu umman nammi share:

Vehassapparim vehakkovsin. shekken habba mimmedinat hayyam vehayyotze mibbet haasurim mesapperim umechabbesim bechol hammoed, vechevan deashkechan bahen tzad hetter bechol hammoed, bearbaa asar dekil share lechulle alma:

Af haratzanim. shekken ole regalim metakkenin minalehen bechol hammoed. vachachamim savre en lemedin techillat melechet ratzanim sheosin minalim chadashim techilla, missof melacha tikkun minalim shel ole regalim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Lo hayu osim chattat al gabbe chattat. im tiharu atzman lefarat chattat achat veerah pesul, lo yaasu acheret al gabbe zo. ella tzericha shimmur kevattechilla:
Velo tinok al gabbe tinok. sheim hayu shene tinokot, echad nishmar lefarat chattat veechad nishmar setam aggav ze hattinok aval lo letzorech parat chattat, lo mitkashshar hay aggav hay:
Tzerichim hayu tinokot lehazzot. veaf al gav shennishmeru chol hashshemirot hallalu, chayshinan dilma ayte orev kazzayit min hammet usheda alayhu. vechol hane maalot yeterot ninhu:
Lo hayu tzerichim lehazzot. diltumat met lo chayshinan. aval tevila hayu tzerichim lechulle alma, shemma nitmeu vesheretz. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Hammolich perot sheviit mimmekom shekkalu. lachayya min hassade vechayyavin alav bene mekomo levaaran min habbayit. veholichan ze lemakom shello chalu, uvene oto makom adayin ochlin hen min hamechunnasim labbayit, chayyav levaer mishshum chumre hammakom sheyyatza mishsham:

Rabbi yehuda omar omrim lo tze vehave lecha af atta. pelugta derabbi yehuda vetanna kamma bechovesh shelosha mine yarak bechometz o vetzir lehitkayyem, ushenayim mehem kalu lachayya min hassade vehashshelishi lo chala, tanna kamma savar ochel meotan shekkalu al semach oto shello chala, hoil vehen bechavit achat. vehachi mishtema lemilleteh, mimmakom shello chalu lemakom shekkalu legamre chayyavin levaer, aval lo chalu chullan ella miktzatan ochel af mimmin hakkale kol zeman shello chalu chullan, deochlin al semach haacharon. verabbi yehuda omer omrim lo tze vehave lecha af atta meoto hammin shekkala kemo shehevi ze haish velo timtza, hilkach eno ochel ella mehammin shello chala, deen ochlin mehamminin shekkalu al semach hammin shello kala, vechayyav levaer hamminin shekkalu. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda, dekae veshitteh derabban gamliel shehalacha chemoto bemassechet sheviit perek happegam:
Kafru shenehem keechad. betoch kede dibbur:
Baze achar ze. shehaya ven ze laze yoter mikkede dibbur:
Harishon chayyav. aval hashsheni patur, shekkevan shekkafar harishon shuv en hashsheni rauy lehaid, shehu yechidi:

Shetehen chayyavot. baggemara farech, rishona ammay chayyevet, ha kayma kat sheniyya, uma hifsiduhu harishonim bichfiratam. umeshane, dematnitin ayre kegon shehayu haedim shel kat sheniyya kerovim binshotehen, shello hayu chesherim lehaid keshekkafra chat rishona, uneshotehen gossot. mahu detema kevan dekayma lan rov gossim lemita havu lehu keillu metu vetippater kat rishona deha kayma sheniyya, ka mashma lan hasheta miha lo shachuv, venimtza shello haya sham bishat kefira ella chat rishona vilvad, ulefichach chayyavin:
Shevuat shav kulei‏ birchokim uvikrovim. nishba al ish shehu ishsha, ben rachok ben karov:
Achat zo veachat zo. achat shevuat shav veachat shevuat bittuy, mushba mippi acherim chayyav bidane amen:
Shehikkifan. semachan zo etzel zo. leshon [veen] makkifin shete chaviyyot demassechet betza:
Hammayim shebbenehen. shebben shete arevot veshebben sedek shel shoket. aval shear hammayim mekuddashin. ella deotan shebbassedek lo nichnas bahen hakkiddush:
Gifsim. min sid hu velavan beyoter. vekorin lo belaaz 86 153:
